items.q: 川口先生はどうも授業に関係ない話をする（ ）。でも、そこがまた面白い。
items.qr: Kawaguchi-sensei wa doumo jugyou ni kankei nai hanashi o suru (___). Demo, soko ga mata omoshiroi.
items.en: Professor Kawaguchi does tend to talk about things unrelated to the lesson. But that's also what makes him interesting.
items.hi: कावागुची सर की आदत-सी है कि वे क्लास से असंबंधित बातें करने लगते हैं। पर यही बात उन्हें दिलचस्प भी बनाती है।
items.gu: કાવાગુચી સરને ટેવ જેવું છે કે તેઓ વર્ગ સાથે અસંબંધિત વાતો કરવા લાગે છે. પણ એ જ વાત તેમને રસપ્રદ પણ બનાવે છે.
items.why: 〜きらいがある (6課) = "has a tendency to ~", used for undesirable habits — wandering off-topic in class — and どうも is a natural partner. でも、そこがまた面白い then softens the criticism. 2) 〜ものがある expresses the speaker's emotional appraisal (心に響くものがある), not a habit. 3) 〜わけがある explains a reason. 4) ならい (custom) doesn't form this pattern.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第1部 問題（1課〜8課） · Review test

items.q: 本日は大雨の（ ）わざわざお越しいただきまして、恐縮でございます。
items.qr: Honjitsu wa ooame no (___) wazawaza okoshi itadakimashite, kyoushuku de gozaimasu.
items.en: We are truly grateful that you have taken the trouble to come today in spite of the heavy rain.
items.hi: आज इतनी तेज़ बारिश के बावजूद आप ख़ास तौर पर पधारे, इसके लिए हम आपके बहुत आभारी हैं।
items.gu: આજે આટલા ભારે વરસાદ છતાં આપ ખાસ પધાર્યા, એ બદલ અમે આપના ખૂબ આભારી છીએ.

opts.en: in spite of (the situation) — with thanks/apology

items.why: 〜ところを (8課) = "although you are in such a situation", typically followed by thanks or apology for troubling someone (お忙しいところを…, 大雨のところを…). 1) ところに marks the moment something else arrives/happens (出かけようとしたところに電話が来た). 2) ところが is a conjunction "however" and can't follow 大雨の. 4) ところで is "by the way", or 〜たところで "even if" (10課), which needs a た形.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第1部 問題（1課〜12課） · Review test

items.q: 期待の新人選手が初めて試合に出る（ ）、観客席は満員だった。
items.qr: Kitai no shinjin senshu ga hajimete shiai ni deru (___), kankyakuseki wa man'in datta.
items.en: With the much-anticipated rookie playing in a match for the first time, the stands were full.
items.hi: बहुप्रतीक्षित नया खिलाड़ी पहली बार मैच खेल रहा था, इसलिए दर्शक-दीर्घा खचाखच भरी थी।
items.gu: બહુપ્રતીક્ષિત નવો ખેલાડી પહેલી વાર મૅચ રમી રહ્યો હતો, એટલે પ્રેક્ષકગૅલરી ખીચોખીચ ભરેલી હતી.
items.why: A special situation (the star rookie's debut) → its natural, observed result (full stands), about third parties → 〜とあって (12課). 1) として marks a role/capacity and doesn't express a reason. 2) 〜ときて is used for listing (or ときたら "speaking of" with criticism), not for cause. 4) といって would mean "saying that he'd play", making the stands the speaker.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第1部 問題（1課〜12課） · Review test

items.q: 毎年年末に放送されるこの国民的な歌番組を（ ）年が越せないという人も多い。
items.qr: Maitoshi nenmatsu ni housou sareru kono kokuminteki na uta bangumi o (___) toshi ga kosenai to iu hito mo ooi.
items.en: Many people say they can't see the year out without watching this national song show broadcast every year-end.
items.hi: बहुत से लोग कहते हैं कि हर साल के अंत में आने वाला यह राष्ट्रीय गीत-कार्यक्रम देखे बिना उनका नया साल नहीं आता।
items.gu: ઘણા લોકો કહે છે કે દર વર્ષના અંતે આવતો આ રાષ્ટ્રીય ગીત-કાર્યક્રમ જોયા વિના તેમનું નવું વર્ષ નથી આવતું.

opts.hi: बिना ध्यान दिए यूँ ही देखते हुए
opts.gu: ધ્યાન આપ્યા વિના એમ જ જોતાં

items.why: "Without A, B can't happen" + a negative ending (年が越せない) → 動 辞書形 + こと + なしに(は) (9課). 1) 〜ともなく (6課) = doing something absent-mindedly — no condition. 3) 〜をよそに (5課) = ignoring others' worries/feelings and takes a noun (周囲の心配をよそに). 4) 〜をおいて (3課) = "no one but ~" with a person/thing noun, not 見るの.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第1部 問題（1課〜12課） · Review test

items.q: （ ）相手が偉い人物であろうと、わたしは記者として真実を新聞に書く。
items.qr: (___) aite ga erai jinbutsu de arou to, watashi wa kisha to shite shinjitsu o shinbun ni kaku.
items.en: Even if the other party is an important figure, as a journalist I will write the truth in the paper.
items.hi: सामने वाला चाहे कितना ही बड़ा आदमी क्यों न हो, पत्रकार होने के नाते मैं अख़बार में सच ही लिखूँगा।
items.gu: સામેવાળો ભલે ગમે તેટલો મોટો માણસ હોય, પત્રકાર તરીકે હું છાપામાં સત્ય જ લખીશ.
items.why: 〜であろうと ("even if it is ~", 10課【1】) is often introduced by たとえ・いかに・どんなに, as the book's ⚠ note says → たとえ. 2) たとえば means "for example". 3) どんな must sit right before the noun it asks about (どんな相手であろうと), so ×どんな相手が偉い人物であろうと is broken. 4) なにも pairs with a negative.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第1部 問題（1課〜12課） · Review test

items.q: 生物というものは、子孫を残すため（ ）、どんなことでもする。
items.qr: Seibutsu to iu mono wa, shison o nokosu tame (___), donna koto demo suru.
items.en: Living creatures will do anything if it is for the sake of leaving offspring.
items.hi: जीव-जंतु अपनी संतान छोड़ने के लिए हो, तो कुछ भी कर गुज़रते हैं।
items.gu: જીવો પોતાનાં સંતાન છોડવા માટે હોય, તો કંઈ પણ કરી છૂટે છે.

opts.en: if it's for (such a special reason)

items.why: "For a special condition like ~, (one will do anything)" → 〜ためとあれば (9課【1】: 子供のためとあれば…). 2) 〜とあって (12課) reports a fact caused by a special situation; it can't take a general "will do anything" and doesn't follow ため. 3) とすれば is a hypothetical "if we suppose" — no sense of a special condition. 4) ためとして is not a pattern.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第1部 問題（1課〜12課） · Review test

items.q: 祖父母は、人一倍の忍耐力（ ）困難な時代を生き抜いた。
items.qr: Sofubo wa, hitoichibai no nintairyoku (___) konnan na jidai o ikinuita.
items.en: My grandparents lived through hard times by means of patience far greater than most people's.
items.hi: मेरे दादा-दादी ने दूसरों से कहीं ज़्यादा धैर्य के बल पर कठिन दौर पार किया।
items.gu: મારાં દાદા-દાદીએ બીજાઓ કરતાં અનેકગણી ધીરજના બળે મુશ્કેલ સમય પાર કર્યો.
items.why: An abstract, admirable means (人一倍の忍耐力) used to achieve something → 〜をもって (11課【3】; compare 11課 [3] Q2 人一倍の努力をもって). 1) を通して marks a medium/intermediary (友人を通して) or a whole period, not one's inner strength. 3) にわたって needs a span (3年にわたって). 4) にかかわって means "being involved in" — no means relation.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第1部 問題（1課〜12課） · Review test

items.q: 親が何を（ ）、子供は親の言うとおりにはならないものだ。
items.qr: Oya ga nani o (___), kodomo wa oya no iu toori ni wa naranai mono da.
items.en: Whatever parents may wish for, children never turn out just as their parents tell them.
items.hi: माता-पिता कुछ भी चाहें, बच्चे वैसे नहीं बनते जैसा माता-पिता कहते हैं।
items.gu: માતા-પિતા ગમે તે ઇચ્છે, બાળકો માતા-પિતા કહે તેવાં બનતાં નથી.

opts.en: no matter what they wish (it's no use)
opts.hi: चाहे कुछ भी चाहें (कोई फ़ायदा नहीं)

opts.en: (×) whether or not they wish (half of a pair)

items.why: 何を + 〜たところで + negative judgement = "whatever you do, it's useless" (10課【4】: どんなに説明したところで…). 1) といっても and 2) とはいえ (8課) concede a fact ("they did wish, but…") and don't combine with the question word 何を. 4) 〜まいと only works in the pair 〜(よ)うと〜まいと (10課【2】), and still not with 何を.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第1部 問題（1課〜12課） · Review test

items.q: 面接試験では、難しい質問に（ ）、また別の質問が次々に出された。
items.qr: Mensetsu shiken de wa, muzukashii shitsumon ni (___), mata betsu no shitsumon ga tsugitsugi ni dasareta.
items.en: In the interview, no sooner had I answered one tough question than another was fired at me, one after another.
items.hi: इंटरव्यू में, एक कठिन सवाल का जवाब देते ही, फिर से एक के बाद एक नए सवाल पूछे जाते रहे।
items.gu: ઇન્ટરવ્યૂમાં, એક અઘરા સવાલનો જવાબ આપતાં જ, ફરી એક પછી એક નવા સવાલ પુછાતા રહ્યા.

opts.en: if I dared to answer (something terrible would follow)
opts.hi: अगर जवाब देने की हिम्मत करता तो (बुरा होता)
opts.gu: જો જવાબ આપવાની હિંમત કરત તો (ખરાબ થાત)

opts.en: if it's the case that I answered
opts.hi: अगर जवाब दे ही दिया हो तो
opts.gu: જો જવાબ આપી જ દીધો હોય તો

opts.en: no sooner had I answered than (again)

items.why: また and 次々に signal a repeating cycle where each finished action is immediately undone by the next → 〜そばから (1課). 1) 〜(よ)うものなら is a hypothetical with a dire result, not a past narration. 2) 〜(よ)うが (10課) = "no matter whether", which needs an unaffected conclusion. 3) 〜とあれば (9課) is a condition followed by the speaker's will.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第1部 問題（1課〜12課） · Review test

items.q: お互いの（ ）、この先一緒に仕事はできない。
items.qr: Otagai no (___), kono saki issho ni shigoto wa dekinai.
items.en: Without mutual understanding, we won't be able to work together from now on.
items.hi: आपसी समझ के बिना, आगे हम साथ काम नहीं कर सकते।
items.gu: પરસ્પર સમજણ વિના, આગળ આપણે સાથે કામ નહીં કરી શકીએ.

opts.en: (×) if there could be no understanding
opts.hi: (×) अगर समझ न हो सके तो
opts.gu: (×) જો સમજણ ન થઈ શકે તો

opts.t: 理解がなかったが最後
opts.en: (×) once there was no understanding, that's the end
opts.hi: (×) एक बार समझ न रही तो ख़त्म
opts.gu: (×) એક વાર સમજણ ન રહી તો ખતમ

items.why: "If something considered absolutely necessary is missing, B can't happen" + a negative (できない) → N + なくしては (9課【4】). 1) 〜ものなら goes with a potential verb (できるものなら) for an unlikely wish. 3) ばこそ (12課) stresses an unexpected reason, not a condition. 4) 〜たが最後 (9課) attaches to an action verb (飲み始めたが最後), and ×なかったが最後 is unnatural.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第1部 問題（1課〜12課） · Review test

items.q: あの大臣、あんなひどい発言を（ ）辞職に追い込まれるかもしれない。
items.qr: Ano daijin, anna hidoi hatsugen o (___) jishoku ni oikomareru kamo shirenai.
items.en: If that minister keeps making such awful remarks, he may well be forced to resign.
items.hi: वह मंत्री अगर ऐसे घटिया बयान दोहराता रहा, तो शायद उसे इस्तीफ़ा देने पर मजबूर होना पड़े।
items.gu: તે મંત્રી જો આવાં ખરાબ નિવેદનો વારંવાર કરતો રહેશે, તો કદાચ તેને રાજીનામું આપવાની ફરજ પડે.

opts.en: as if to say "I'll repeat it"
opts.hi: मानो कह रहा हो कि दोहराऊँगा

items.why: An undesirable state + a prediction of a bad outcome (〜かもしれない) → 〜ようでは (9課【3】). 1) とばかりに (6課) describes someone's manner "as if to say" — no condition. 2) くらいなら (9課) must be followed by "it would be better to…" (〜ほうがいい). 4) ものなら needs a potential verb or the 〜(よ)うものなら form.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第1部 問題（1課〜12課） · Review test

items.q: こんなところで財布を（ ）、絶対お金が入ったまま戻ってはこないと思う。
items.qr: Konna tokoro de saifu o (___), zettai okane ga haitta mama modotte wa konai to omou.
items.en: Drop your wallet in a place like this and that's it — I'm sure it will never come back with the money still in it.
items.hi: ऐसी जगह पर बटुआ गिरा दिया तो समझो गया — मुझे पक्का लगता है कि वह पैसों समेत कभी वापस नहीं आएगा।
items.gu: આવી જગ્યાએ પાકીટ પડી ગયું તો સમજો ગયું — મને પાકી ખાતરી છે કે તે પૈસા સાથે ક્યારેય પાછું નહીં આવે.

opts.en: (×) if you're the sort who dropped it
opts.hi: (×) अगर गिरा देने जैसी हालत हो
opts.gu: (×) જો પાડી દેવા જેવી હાલત હોય

opts.en: once you drop it, that's the end
opts.hi: एक बार गिरा दिया तो ख़त्म

opts.en: even if you drop it (it doesn't matter)
opts.hi: भले ही गिरा दो (कोई फ़र्क़ नहीं)

opts.t: 落としたら落としたで
opts.en: if you drop it, well then (that has its own issue)
opts.hi: गिरा दिया तो दिया, (फिर अलग बात)

items.why: "Once A happens, a terrible result is certain" (絶対…ない) → 〜たら最後 (9課【2】, also usable for hypotheticals). 1) 〜ようでは criticises a habit/state (すぐ落とすようでは) rather than one hypothetical act. 3) 〜たところで (10課) means the act is pointless — the opposite of "disaster". 4) 〜たら〜たで (10課) means "even then, there's another problem / it's fine" — it doesn't predict certain loss.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第1部 問題（1課〜12課） · Review test

items.q: 幼稚園（ ）、仕事中はおしゃべりはやめてください。
items.qr: Youchien (___), shigotochuu wa oshaberi wa yamete kudasai.
items.en: This isn't kindergarten — please stop chattering while you're working.
items.hi: यह कोई किंडरगार्टन तो है नहीं, काम के समय गपशप बंद कीजिए।
items.gu: આ કંઈ બાલમંદિર તો છે નહીં, કામ વખતે ગપસપ બંધ કરો.
items.why: "We're obviously not in a kindergarten, so stop it" — something clearly untrue + a request that rejects the current behaviour → 〜ではあるまいし (12課【3】). 2) 〜のことだし ("knowing ~, …") needs a person and supports, not rejects, the conclusion. 3) and 4) are concessive "even if" forms (cf. 10課) that make the request illogical ("even if this isn't a kindergarten, stop chatting").
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第1部 問題（1課〜12課） · Review test

items.q: あの議員は、マスコミにどんなに（ ）、平気な顔をしている。
items.qr: Ano giin wa, masukomi ni donna ni (___), heiki na kao o shite iru.
items.en: However harshly that politician is criticised by the media, he keeps a nonchalant face.
items.hi: मीडिया उस सांसद की कितनी भी आलोचना करे, वह बेफ़िक्र चेहरा बनाए रहता है।
items.gu: મીડિયા તે સાંસદની ગમે તેટલી ટીકા કરે, તે બેફિકર ચહેરો રાખે છે.

opts.t: 批判されようとされまいと
批判されればされたで
opts.hi: आलोचना हुई तो हुई (फिर अलग बात)
opts.gu: ટીકા થઈ તો થઈ (પછી અલગ વાત)

items.why: どんなに + 〜(よ)うと = "no matter how much ~, the result is unaffected" (10課【1】). 1) the paired 〜(よ)うと〜まいと (10課【2】) means "whether or not" and can't take どんなに (degree). 2) 〜ば〜たで (10課【5】) needs a following "that brings its own problem / it's fine". 3) "even if he isn't criticised, he looks unbothered" is pointless and also clashes with どんなに.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第1部 問題（1課〜12課） · Review test

items.q: 山田さんは、「だめ」（ ）怖い顔をしてわたしをにらんだ。
items.qr: Yamada-san wa, "dame" (___) kowai kao o shite watashi o niranda.
items.en: Mr. Yamada glared at me with a scary face, as if to say "No!"
items.hi: यामादा जी ने मानो "नहीं!" कह रहे हों, ऐसा डरावना चेहरा बनाकर मुझे घूरा।
items.gu: યામાદાજીએ જાણે "ના!" કહેતા હોય, એવો ડરામણો ચહેરો કરીને મારી સામે ઘૂરીને જોયું.
items.why: A manner of acting "almost as if saying ~" modifying a verb (にらんだ) → 〜んばかりに (6課 〜んばかりだ; adverbial form 〜んばかりに). 2) 〜んばかりで is not the standard adverbial link (use に before a verb, の before a noun). 3) 〜んがために (11課) is purpose — "glared in order to say 'no'" is not what the face does. 4) ×〜んがゆえに mixes the ん-volitional with ゆえ (12課) and isn't a pattern.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第1部 問題（1課〜12課） · Review test

items.q: みんなが（ ）、壊れた傘をさして外を歩くわけにはいかなかった。
items.qr: Minna ga (___), kowareta kasa o sashite soto o aruku wake ni wa ikanakatta.
items.en: With everyone watching, I couldn't very well walk outside holding a broken umbrella.
items.hi: सब लोग देख रहे थे, इसलिए मैं टूटा हुआ छाता लेकर बाहर नहीं घूम सकता था।
items.gu: બધા જોઈ રહ્યા હતા, એટલે હું તૂટેલી છત્રી લઈને બહાર ફરી શકું એમ નહોતો.

opts.t: 見ているからといって
opts.hi: सिर्फ़ इसलिए कि देख रहे हैं
opts.gu: માત્ર એટલા માટે કે જોઈ રહ્યા છે

opts.hi: चूँकि सब देख रहे हैं (इज़्ज़त के कारण)
opts.gu: કારણ કે બધા જોઈ રહ્યા છે (આબરૂને લીધે)

items.why: Others' eyes → the speaker restricts his own behaviour with 〜わけにはいかない → 〜手前 (12課【4】, ている形 + 手前). 1) 〜ながらにして (6課) is limited to fixed verbs (居ながらにして, 生まれながらにして). 2) 〜からといって needs a negative conclusion like "doesn't necessarily mean…". 3) 〜(よ)うと (10課) says the result is unaffected — the opposite of "I couldn't".
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第1部 問題（1課〜12課） · Review test

items.q: ノーベル賞受賞者（ ）、その後の言動が世界中のマスコミに注目される。
items.qr: Nooberu-shou jushousha (___), sono go no gendou ga sekaijuu no masukomi ni chuumoku sareru.
items.en: Once you become a Nobel Prize winner, everything you say and do afterwards is watched by the media around the world.
items.hi: नोबेल पुरस्कार विजेता बन जाने पर तो, उसके बाद की हर बात और हरकत पर दुनिया भर का मीडिया नज़र रखता है।
items.gu: નોબેલ પારિતોષિક વિજેતા બની જાઓ એટલે, ત્યાર પછીની દરેક વાત અને વર્તન પર દુનિયાભરનું મીડિયા નજર રાખે છે.
items.why: 〜ともなると (14課) attaches to a noun of an advanced stage or high position (受賞者, 部長, 中学生) and states the state that naturally follows — here, constant media attention. 1) ともすると is an adverb ("is prone to") and can't follow a noun as a topic. 2) and 3) are plain hypotheticals ("if he were a winner"), but the sentence is a general truth about anyone who reaches that status, not a supposition.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第1部 問題(1課〜16課) · Review test

items.q: うちの弟（ ）、夜中にすごいボリュームで音楽を聞くんだから、たまらないよ。
items.qr: Uchi no otouto (___), yonaka ni sugoi boryuumu de ongaku o kiku n da kara, tamaranai yo.
items.en: As for my little brother — he listens to music at full blast in the middle of the night. I can't stand it!
items.hi: मेरे छोटे भाई की तो बात ही मत करो — आधी रात को पूरी आवाज़ में गाने सुनता है, बर्दाश्त नहीं होता!
items.gu: મારા નાના ભાઈની તો વાત જ ન કરો — અડધી રાતે ફુલ અવાજે ગીતો સાંભળે છે, સહન નથી થતું!
items.why: 〜ときたら (14課) picks out someone/something close to the speaker (うちの弟) and is followed by complaint or criticism — たまらないよ is exactly that; it's also 話し言葉, matching the casual よ. 2) 〜といったら introduces an extreme degree with surprise (e.g. 弟のうるささといったら…) and needs a quality noun, not a person. 3) としたら is hypothetical. 4) となったら means "when it actually comes to doing X" (いざ試験となったら) and doesn't introduce a
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第1部 問題(1課〜16課) · Review test

items.q: 初戦で勝てたの（ ）、あの選手が点を入れたことがうれしい。
items.qr: Shosen de kateta no (___), ano senshu ga ten o ireta koto ga ureshii.
items.en: Even more than winning the first match, I'm happy that that player scored.
items.hi: पहला मैच जीतने से भी ज़्यादा, मुझे इस बात की ख़ुशी है कि उस खिलाड़ी ने गोल किया।
items.gu: પહેલી મેચ જીત્યા કરતાં પણ વધારે, મને એ વાતનો આનંદ છે કે તે ખેલાડીએ ગોલ કર્યો.
items.why: Both halves are happy things, and the second is happier → 〜にもまして (15課), "B even more than A". 1) 〜にひきかえ contrasts a good thing with a bad one (subjective good/bad evaluation), but both here are good. 3) 〜に伴い (N2) needs a change that drags another change along. 4) 〜に反して needs a noun like 予想・期待 ("contrary to expectation").
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第1部 問題(1課〜16課) · Review test

items.q: 高橋先生は、専門の経済論はもちろん、タレントのうわさ話に（ ）、どんな話題でも楽しそうに話す。
items.qr: Takahashi-sensei wa, senmon no keizairon wa mochiron, tarento no uwasabanashi ni (___), donna wadai demo tanoshisou ni hanasu.
items.en: Professor Takahashi happily talks about any topic — from his specialty, economics, of course, all the way down to celebrity gossip.
items.hi: ताकाहाशी सर अपने विषय अर्थशास्त्र से लेकर फ़िल्मी सितारों की गपशप तक, किसी भी विषय पर मज़े से बात करते हैं।
items.gu: તાકાહાશી સર પોતાના વિષય અર્થશાસ્ત્રથી માંડીને ફિલ્મી સિતારાઓની ગપસપ સુધી, કોઈ પણ વિષય પર મજાથી વાત કરે છે.
items.why: 〜に至るまで (2課) marks the far end of a range, stressing how wide it is: from serious economics "even to" gossip, then どんな話題でも sums it up. 2) 〜に至って (16課) = "only when things went as far as ~" — needs a turning-point event. 3) 〜に至っては (16課) singles out the worst example of a bad situation. 4) adding は makes it a contrast ("up to that point, but not beyond"), which breaks the "everything" meaning.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第1部 問題(1課〜16課) · Review test

items.q: 社長に反抗など（ ）、会社を辞めさせられるだろう。
items.qr: Shachou ni hankou nado (___), kaisha o yamesaserareru darou.
items.en: If you ever defy the company president, that'll be the end of you — you'll probably be forced to quit.
items.hi: अगर तुमने कभी अध्यक्ष का विरोध किया, तो बस, समझो ख़त्म — शायद तुम्हें नौकरी छोड़नी पड़ेगी।
items.gu: જો તમે ક્યારેય પ્રમુખનો વિરોધ કર્યો, તો બસ, ખતમ — કદાચ તમારે નોકરી છોડવી પડશે.

opts.en: having done it (I can't back out now)
opts.hi: कर चुकने के बाद (अब पीछे नहीं हट सकते)
opts.gu: કરી ચૂક્યા પછી (હવે પાછા ન હટાય)

opts.en: when it went as far as doing
once you do it, that's the end
opts.hi: एक बार किया तो बस ख़त्म
opts.gu: એક વાર કર્યું તો બસ ખતમ

items.why: 〜たら最後 (9課) = "once you do X, something terrible is bound to follow"; it works with a hypothetical (反抗など…), and the result (辞めさせられる) is the bad outcome the speaker fears. 1) 〜手前 (12課) explains why one feels obliged ("having said it in front of others"), not a dire consequence. 2) 〜に至って (16課) narrates a turning point that already happened, clashing with だろう. 3) 〜ばこそ (12課) gives a surprising reason,
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第1部 問題(1課〜16課) · Review test

items.q: 以上がわたしからの忠告だ。後は君（ ）考えて、結論を出してほしい。
items.qr: Ijou ga watashi kara no chuukoku da. Ato wa kimi (___) kangaete, ketsuron o dashite hoshii.
items.en: That's my advice. The rest is up to you — think it over in your own way and reach a conclusion.
items.hi: यह रही मेरी सलाह। आगे तुम अपने ढंग से सोचकर कोई निष्कर्ष निकालो।
items.gu: આ મારી સલાહ છે. હવે તમે તમારી રીતે વિચારીને કોઈ નિષ્કર્ષ પર આવો.

opts.en: in one's own way (within one's limits)
opts.hi: अपने ढंग से / अपनी हैसियत के मुताबिक़

items.why: 〜なりに (14課) = "doing one's best within the limits of who/what one is" — 君なりに考えて ("think it over as best you can, your way"). 1) 〜ながらに (6課) only attaches to a few fixed words (生まれながらに, 涙ながらに), not a person. 3) 〜いかんで (5課) and 4) 〜次第で (N2) mean "depending on", which need a variable noun (結果, 努力) — "depending on you, think" makes no sense.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第1部 問題(1課〜16課) · Review test

items.q: 今日の講演会は満員と（ ）、半分近くが空席だった。
items.qr: Kyou no kouenkai wa man'in to (___), hanbun chikaku ga kuuseki datta.
items.en: I thought today's lecture would be packed, but nearly half the seats were empty.
items.hi: सोचा था आज का व्याख्यान खचाखच भरा होगा, पर लगभग आधी सीटें ख़ाली थीं।
items.gu: ધાર્યું હતું કે આજનું વ્યાખ્યાન ખીચોખીચ ભરેલું હશે, પણ લગભગ અડધી બેઠકો ખાલી હતી.

opts.en: even if one can't call it ~
opts.hi: भले ही ~ न कहा जा सके

items.why: 〜と思いきや (8課) = "I expected X, but the opposite happened" — expected 満員, got half-empty seats. 2) 思わず means "involuntarily" and doesn't take a と-quote of an expectation. 3) と言わず needs the paired form 〜といわず…といわず (4課). 4) 満員とは言えないまでも ("not full, but…") would need とは and a result only slightly below the ideal, e.g. ほぼ埋まっていた — "half empty" is far below.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第1部 問題(1課〜16課) · Review test

items.q: 前回優勝の林選手（ ）が、あんなつまらないミスで負けるなんて。
items.qr: Zenkai yuushou no Hayashi senshu (___) ga, anna tsumaranai misu de makeru nante.
items.en: To think that someone like Hayashi, last time's champion, would lose over such a silly mistake!
items.hi: पिछली बार के विजेता हयाशी जैसे खिलाड़ी का ऐसी मामूली ग़लती से हार जाना — यक़ीन नहीं होता!
items.gu: ગયા વખતના વિજેતા હયાશી જેવા ખેલાડીનું આવી મામૂલી ભૂલથી હારી જવું — માન્યામાં નથી આવતું!

opts.en: (not a set form) a thing that is also ~

items.why: 〜ともあろう + N (14課) expresses surprise/disapproval that a person of high standing did something unworthy of it — exactly 〜が…負けるなんて. 1) 〜たるもの (14課) is followed by what such a person ought to do (〜べきだ／なければならない), not by a specific lapse, and it isn't followed by が here. 3) ともなろう is a blend of ともなると and ともあろう that doesn't exist. 4) でもあるもの is not a fixed expression.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第1部 問題(1課〜16課) · Review test

items.q: 母は夕飯を（ ）、電話で長話をしている。
items.qr: Haha wa yuuhan o (___), denwa de nagabanashi o shite iru.
items.en: My mother has left dinner half-made and is having a long chat on the phone.
items.hi: माँ रात का खाना आधा बनाकर छोड़े हुए फ़ोन पर लंबी बातें कर रही हैं।
items.gu: મમ્મી રાતનું જમવાનું અડધું બનાવીને છોડી દઈ ફોન પર લાંબી વાતો કરી રહ્યાં છે.

opts.en: once she starts making it, that's the end
opts.hi: एक बार बनाना शुरू किया तो बस
opts.gu: એક વાર બનાવવાનું શરૂ કર્યું તો બસ

items.why: The plain form 〜たまま ("leaving things in that state") fits: 作りかけた (half-made) + まま + a second action. 2) 〜っぱなし (16課) attaches to a ます-stem of an ordinary verb (つけっぱなし, 置きっぱなし); stacking it on 〜かけ ("half-done") is not natural Japanese. 3) 〜つつ needs a ます-stem of a continuing action; 作りかけ is a resultant state, so "while half-making" is broken. 4) 〜たが最後 (9課) predicts a terrible outcome; chatting on the
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第1部 問題(1課〜16課) · Review test

items.q: 同じような故障が3度続くに（ ）、メーカーは製品に重要な欠陥があるのではないかと調査し始めた。
items.qr: Onaji you na koshou ga sando tsuzuku ni (___), meekaa wa seihin ni juuyou na kekkan ga aru no de wa nai ka to chousa shihajimeta.
items.en: Only when the same kind of breakdown had happened three times in a row did the manufacturer start investigating whether the product had a serious defect.
items.hi: एक जैसी ख़राबी लगातार तीन बार होने पर ही निर्माता ने जाँच शुरू की कि कहीं उत्पाद में कोई गंभीर दोष तो नहीं।
items.gu: એક જેવી ખામી સતત ત્રણ વાર થઈ ત્યારે જ ઉત્પાદકે તપાસ શરૂ કરી કે ક્યાંક ઉત્પાદનમાં કોઈ ગંભીર ખામી તો નથી ને.

opts.t: 至ってからというものは
opts.r: itatte kara to iu mono wa

opts.hi: उस हद तक पहुँचने पर ही

items.why: 〜に至って (16課) = "only when things went as far as ~ did …", and the book's own example pairs it with 初めて (死者が出るに至って、国は初めて…気がついた). 〜に至ってはじめて stresses how late the reaction came. 1), 2) and 3) are all "ever since" forms; they need a continuing state afterwards (〜ている), but 調査し始めた is a single starting event — and "since 3 breakdowns" is not the point; the point is that it took 3.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第1部 問題(1課〜16課) · Review test

items.q: 彼の発言は（ ）、事実から遠く離れた偏った意見だと思う。
items.qr: Kare no hatsugen wa (___), jijitsu kara tooku hanareta katayotta iken da to omou.
items.en: His remarks may not quite be lies, but I think they're a biased opinion far removed from the facts.
items.hi: उसकी बात को झूठ भले न कहा जा सके, पर मुझे लगता है वह तथ्यों से बहुत दूर एक पक्षपाती राय है।
items.gu: તેની વાતને જૂઠ ભલે ન કહી શકાય, પણ મને લાગે છે કે તે તથ્યોથી ઘણો દૂર એક પક્ષપાતી અભિપ્રાય છે.

opts.en: it's not as if it's a lie, so…
opts.hi: कोई झूठ थोड़े ही है, इसलिए…

opts.t: うそとは言えないまでも
opts.r: uso to wa ienai made mo
opts.en: even if it can't be called a lie
opts.hi: भले ही झूठ न कहा जा सके

opts.en: whether or not it's a lie
(unnatural) one can hardly call it a lie, and…
opts.hi: (अस्वाभाविक) झूठ तो कह नहीं सकते, और…
opts.gu: (અસ્વાભાવિક) જૂઠ તો કહી ન શકાય, અને…

items.why: 〜ないまでも (15課) = "not as far as the extreme X, but a level just below it" — not a full lie, but still far from the truth. The book notes the noun version 〜とは言わないまでも／とはいかないまでも; とは言えないまでも works the same way. 1) 〜ではあるまいし (12課) is a colloquial "it's not as if…" used to scold someone (子供ではあるまいし、自分でやりなさい), not a concession before an evaluation. 3) 〜(よ)うと means "regardless", which doesn't lead to a judgeme
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第1部 問題(1課〜16課) · Review test

items.q: もらったチョコレートを（ ）帰宅してしまった。
items.qr: Moratta chokoreeto o (___) kitaku shite shimatta.
items.en: I went home and left the chocolates I'd been given just sitting at the office.
items.hi: मुझे जो चॉकलेट मिली थी, उसे दफ़्तर में ही छोड़कर मैं घर चला आया।
items.gu: મને જે ચૉકલેટ મળી હતી, તે ઑફિસમાં જ મૂકી રાખીને હું ઘરે આવી ગયો.

opts.t: 会社に置きながらにして
opts.r: kaisha ni oki nagara ni shite

opts.t: 会社に置きっぱなしにして
会社から持ち帰らない始末で
opts.en: (misused) ending up not taking them home
opts.hi: (ग़लत प्रयोग) आख़िरकार घर न ले जाकर
opts.gu: (ખોટો પ્રયોગ) આખરે ઘરે ન લઈ જઈને

opts.t: 会社から持ち帰らずじまいで
opts.hi: (ग़लत प्रयोग) कभी घर न ले जा पाकर
opts.gu: (ખોટો પ્રયોગ) ક્યારેય ઘરે ન લઈ જઈ શકીને

items.why: 〜っぱなし (16課) = "a state that normally shouldn't continue is left as is", usually with a note of carelessness or regret — matches 〜てしまった. 置きっぱなしにして links smoothly to 帰宅した. 1) 〜ながらにして (6課) only follows fixed words (生まれ, 居) — 置きながらにして isn't used. 3) 〜始末だ (16課) closes a sentence describing a bad ending after a chain of bad events; it doesn't work as a mid-sentence 〜で link. 4) 〜ずじまい (N2) means "ended up
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第1部 問題(1課〜16課) · Review test

items.q: 今日は飲むまいと思っていたが、上司が勧める酒を（ ）。
items.qr: Kyou wa nomumai to omotte ita ga, joushi ga susumeru sake o (___).
items.en: I'd decided not to drink today, but when my boss offered me a drink, I just couldn't refuse, however much I wanted to.
items.hi: मैंने सोचा था आज नहीं पिऊँगा, पर बॉस ने जो शराब पेश की, उसे चाहकर भी मना नहीं कर सका।
items.gu: મેં વિચાર્યું હતું કે આજે નહીં પીઉં, પણ બૉસે જે દારૂ આપ્યો, તેને ઇચ્છવા છતાં ના પાડી ન શક્યો.

opts.hi: चाहकर भी मना न कर सका
opts.gu: ઇચ્છવા છતાં ના ન પાડી શક્યો

opts.t: 断らないわけにはいかなかった
opts.en: had no choice but to refuse

opts.t: 断らずにはいられなかった
opts.hi: मना किए बिना न रह सका
opts.gu: ના પાડ્યા વિના રહી ન શક્યો

opts.en: (misused) there was no way to refuse
opts.hi: (ग़लत प्रयोग) मना करने का सवाल ही न था
opts.gu: (ખોટો પ્રયોગ) ના પાડવાનો સવાલ જ નહોતો

items.why: 〜に〜ない (13課): the same verb twice, dictionary form + に + its potential negative = "I wanted to, but circumstances (here, psychological ones — he's the boss) prevented me". The book notes 〜に〜ない often expresses such 心理的事情. 2) and 3) both mean he did refuse — the opposite of the story (he had planned not to drink, so refusing would be no conflict). 4) 〜べくもない (13課) attaches to verbs of thinking/knowing
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第1部 問題(1課〜16課) · Review test

items.q: 高校生の演劇にはプロのようなうまさは（ ）、若者の純粋さが感じられ、楽しめる。
items.qr: Koukousei no engeki ni wa puro no you na umasa wa (___), wakamono no junsuisa ga kanjirare, tanoshimeru.
items.en: You naturally can't expect professional-level skill from a high-school play, but you can feel the young people's sincerity, and it's enjoyable.
items.hi: हाई-स्कूल के नाटक से पेशेवर जैसी कुशलता की उम्मीद तो की ही नहीं जा सकती, पर उसमें युवाओं की सच्चाई महसूस होती है और मज़ा आता है।
items.gu: હાઈસ્કૂલના નાટક પાસેથી વ્યાવસાયિક જેવી કુશળતાની અપેક્ષા તો રાખી જ ન શકાય, પણ તેમાં યુવાનોની નિર્દોષતા અનુભવાય છે અને મજા આવે છે.

opts.t: 期待するどころではないが
opts.r: kitai suru dokoro de wa nai ga
opts.en: (I'm) in no situation to expect it, but
opts.hi: उम्मीद करने की हालत में नहीं, पर

opts.t: 期待するべくもないが
opts.r: kitai suru beku mo nai ga
opts.hi: उम्मीद की ही नहीं जा सकती, पर
opts.gu: અપેક્ષા રાખી જ ન શકાય, પણ

items.why: 〜べくもない (13課) = "in that situation, it is naturally impossible to ~", on a verb of mental activity — 期待する fits, and the high-school context is the "situation". 1) 〜どころではない (N2) means the speaker is too busy/troubled to do something, not that the play can't meet a standard. 2) 〜べからず (13課) is only for signs and notices (掲示・注意書き) and can't take が mid-sentence. 4) 〜どころか needs an opposite second half ("
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第1部 問題(1課〜16課) · Review test

items.q: 原稿の締め切りの日が迫っているので、（ ）。
items.qr: Genkou no shimekiri no hi ga sematte iru node, (___).
items.en: My manuscript deadline is closing in, so I can't afford to be dozing off.
items.hi: पांडुलिपि की अंतिम तिथि सिर पर है, इसलिए मैं झपकी लेने जैसा कुछ नहीं कर सकता।
items.gu: હસ્તપ્રતની છેલ્લી તારીખ માથે છે, તેથી હું ઝોકાં ખાવા જેવું કંઈ કરી શકું તેમ નથી.

opts.t: 居眠りぐらいするに越したことはない
opts.r: inemuri gurai suru ni koshita koto wa nai
opts.en: it's best to at least have a doze
opts.hi: कम से कम झपकी लेना ही सबसे अच्छा है
opts.gu: ઓછામાં ઓછું ઝોકું ખાવું એ જ શ્રેષ્ઠ છે

opts.t: 居眠りぐらいするよりほかない
opts.r: inemuri gurai suru yori hoka nai
opts.en: there's nothing to do but doze
opts.hi: झपकी लेने के सिवा कोई चारा नहीं
opts.gu: ઝોકું ખાવા સિવાય કોઈ ઉપાય નથી

opts.t: 居眠りなどしてはいられない
opts.en: can't afford to doze or anything

opts.t: 居眠りなどしないではいられない
opts.r: inemuri nado shinai de wa irarenai
opts.hi: झपकी लिए बिना रह नहीं सकता
opts.gu: ઝોકું ખાધા વિના રહી શકતો નથી

items.why: 〜て(は)いられない (13課) = "with no time or mental leeway, I can't stay in this state" — first-person subject, a feeling of having to get moving. The deadline is the lack of leeway. 1) and 2) recommend or resign oneself to dozing — the opposite of what a looming deadline implies. 4) 〜ないではいられない (N2) means "can't help doing it" — it flips the meaning and clashes with the dismissive など.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第1部 問題(1課〜16課) · Review test

items.q: 10年前に一度行っただけのあの店の店主が、わたしの顔を覚えていた（ ）驚いた。
items.qr: Juunen mae ni ichido itta dake no ano mise no tenshu ga, watashi no kao o oboete ita (___) odoroita.
items.en: I was amazed that the owner of that shop — which I'd visited only once, ten years ago — remembered my face.
items.hi: जिस दुकान पर मैं दस साल पहले सिर्फ़ एक बार गया था, उसके मालिक को मेरा चेहरा याद था — यह देखकर मैं हैरान रह गया।
items.gu: જે દુકાને હું દસ વર્ષ પહેલાં ફક્ત એક વાર ગયો હતો, તેના માલિકને મારો ચહેરો યાદ હતો — એ જોઈને હું નવાઈ પામ્યો.
items.why: 〜とは (19課) marks something unexpected that the speaker is reacting to — very often followed by 驚いた／思わなかった. 1) とか is vague hearsay/listing. 3) 覚えていたほど驚いた ("I was surprised to the extent he remembered") is nonsense. 4) など would trivialise the clause and doesn't link to 驚いた.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第1部 問題（1課〜20課）

items.q: 成人式の会場は騒がしいこと（ ）、市長のあいさつが聞こえなかった。
items.qr: Seijinshiki no kaijou wa sawagashii koto (___), shichou no aisatsu ga kikoenakatta.
items.en: The coming-of-age ceremony hall was so extremely noisy that the mayor's speech couldn't be heard.
items.hi: वयस्कता समारोह का हॉल बेहद शोरगुल वाला था, इसलिए मेयर का भाषण सुनाई नहीं दिया।
items.gu: પુખ્તવય સમારોહનો હૉલ અત્યંત ઘોંઘાટિયો હતો, તેથી મેયરનું ભાષણ સંભળાયું નહીં.

opts.en: to the limit / only as far as

items.why: 〜こと極まりない (19課) = "extremely ~", and its 連用形 極まりなく links to the next clause. 3) 極まる attaches directly to a な-adjective stem (失礼極まる), not to 〜こと, and 極まり alone can't link the clauses. 1) 限りで and 2) 限らず are range expressions that make no sense after 騒がしいこと.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第1部 問題（1課〜20課）

items.q: こちらの予算を言ってあるのに、不動産屋は5,000万円（ ）マンションばかり紹介する。
items.qr: Kochira no yosan o itte aru noni, fudousan'ya wa gosenman'en (___) manshon bakari shoukai suru.
items.en: Even though I've told them my budget, the estate agent keeps showing me only flats that cost 50 million yen or more.
items.hi: मैंने अपना बजट बता रखा है, फिर भी प्रॉपर्टी एजेंट सिर्फ़ 5 करोड़ येन से ज़्यादा के फ़्लैट दिखाता है।
items.gu: મેં મારું બજેટ કહી રાખ્યું છે, છતાં પ્રૉપર્ટી એજન્ટ ફક્ત 5 કરોડ યેનથી વધુના ફ્લૅટ જ બતાવે છે.
items.why: In 17課, 〜からする is for price (値段), 〜からある for size/weight/length/distance, and 〜からの for numbers of people or with a noun after it. 5,000万円 is a price → からする. 2) からいう is not a form. 4) 〜からなる means "is made up of" (5人からなるチーム).
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第1部 問題（1課〜20課）

items.q: 初めてあのコンサートホールで演奏したときの感動（ ）……。今思い出しても胸が高鳴る。
items.qr: Hajimete ano konsaato hooru de ensou shita toki no kandou (___)…… Ima omoidashite mo mune ga takanaru.
items.en: The thrill I felt the first time I performed in that concert hall… Even remembering it now, my heart races.
items.hi: पहली बार उस कॉन्सर्ट हॉल में बजाते समय जो रोमांच हुआ था, उसका तो क्या कहना……। आज याद करके भी दिल धड़क उठता है।
items.gu: પહેલી વાર એ કૉન્સર્ટ હૉલમાં વગાડતી વખતે જે રોમાંચ થયો હતો, તેની તો વાત જ શી……. આજે યાદ કરું તોય દિલ ધબકી ઊઠે છે.

opts.en: if it's for ~ / if it's the case
when it comes to (a higher level)

items.why: 〜といったらない (19課) = "indescribably ~", and the book shows it can trail off as 〜といったら…… with ない left unsaid. 1) とあれば (9課) needs a consequent clause ("if it's for ~, I'll…"). 3) ともなると (14課) needs a noun of status/stage and a consequence. 4) ときたら (14課) introduces a criticism, wrong for a fond memory.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第1部 問題（1課〜20課）

items.q: ベテランの設計士（ ）、時にはこのように間違うこともあるのだ。
items.qr: Beteran no sekkeishi (___), toki ni wa kono you ni machigau koto mo aru no da.
items.en: Even a veteran architect sometimes makes mistakes like this.
items.hi: एक अनुभवी आर्किटेक्ट से भी कभी-कभी ऐसी ग़लती हो जाती है।
items.gu: એક અનુભવી આર્કિટેક્ટથી પણ ક્યારેક આવી ભૂલ થઈ જાય છે.
items.why: N + にして (17課) = "even someone of such high level ~" — typically followed by 〜こともある／〜できない. 1) とあって (12課) gives a reason ("being a veteran, so…"), contradicting 間違う. 2) として ("as an architect") lacks the "even" sense. 3) にあって (1課) needs a situation/position noun, not a person.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第1部 問題（1課〜20課）

items.q: 子供が大きく（ ）また別の心配事が増える。
items.qr: Kodomo ga ookiku (___) mata betsu no shinpaigoto ga fueru.
items.en: Once the children grow up, that just brings a whole new set of worries.
items.hi: बच्चे बड़े हो जाएँ तो भी, फिर कोई और नई चिंता बढ़ जाती है।
items.gu: બાળકો મોટાં થઈ જાય તો થઈ ગયાં, પણ પછી બીજી નવી ચિંતા વધી જાય છે.

opts.en: if it becomes so, that's the end
once it does become so, then (in turn)
opts.hi: हो गया तो हो गया, पर फिर

items.why: 〜ば〜たで (10課) = "if X happens, then X brings its own (problems)" — the また別の… is the giveaway. 1) てはじめて ("only once they grow up do I realise…") doesn't fit 増える. 2) ばそれまで(だ) (18課) means "then it's all over", not "new worries". 4) てこのかた ("ever since") would need a continuing state and doesn't match the general-truth present tense with また.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第1部 問題（1課〜20課）

items.q: 試験が目前に迫っている今、1分（ ）時間を無駄にしたくない。
items.qr: Shiken ga mokuzen ni sematte iru ima, ippun (___) jikan o muda ni shitakunai.
items.en: Now that the exam is right around the corner, I don't want to waste even a single minute.
items.hi: अब जब परीक्षा सिर पर है, मैं एक मिनट भी बर्बाद नहीं करना चाहता।
items.gu: હવે જ્યારે પરીક્ષા માથે છે, હું એક મિનિટ પણ બગાડવા માગતો નથી.
items.why: 1 + counter + たりとも…ない (17課) = "not even one ~" — 1分 and the negative 〜たくない are the textbook frame. 1) どころか needs a contrast clause. 3) たるもの (14課) attaches to a role noun (教師たるもの). 4) からの (17課) is for a large number (1万人からの人).
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第1部 問題（1課〜20課）

items.q: （ ）ホテル業が成り立つのですから、ホテルはサービスが基本です。
items.qr: (___) hoteru-gyou ga naritatsu no desu kara, hoteru wa saabisu ga kihon desu.
items.en: It is precisely because there are guests that the hotel business can exist, so for a hotel, service is everything.
items.hi: मेहमान हैं, इसीलिए होटल का कारोबार चलता है; इसलिए होटल के लिए सेवा ही बुनियाद है।
items.gu: મહેમાનો છે એટલે જ હોટલનો ધંધો ચાલે છે; તેથી હોટલ માટે સેવા જ પાયો છે.

opts.en: (N) that exists only thanks to guests

opts.t: お客様がいるとあれば
opts.en: if (it's a case where) there are guests

items.why: 〜ばこそ (12課) = "precisely because ~" and leads to a positive result (成り立つ). 1) Nあっての (17課) is the tempting N1 answer, but it must be followed directly by a noun (お客様あってのホテル業だ) — here it would modify ホテル業 that is then the subject of 成り立つ, which is redundant and unnatural. 2) いての is not a form. 4) とあれば (9課) is hypothetical ("if it's the case that…"), clashing with the general truth stated by のですから.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第1部 問題（1課〜20課）

items.q: 借りた本を汚してしまったとあれば、買って（ ）だろう。
items.qr: Karita hon o yogoshite shimatta to areba, katte (___) darou.
items.en: If you've stained a book you borrowed, you probably can't get away without buying a new one to return.
items.hi: अगर उधार ली किताब गंदी कर दी है, तो शायद नई ख़रीदकर लौटाए बिना काम नहीं चलेगा।
items.gu: જો ઉછીનું લીધેલું પુસ્તક ગંદું કરી નાખ્યું હોય, તો કદાચ નવું ખરીદીને પાછું આપ્યા વગર નહીં ચાલે.

opts.t: 返さずにはいられない
opts.gu: પાછું આપ્યા વગર રહી ન શકું

opts.t: 返さずじまいではない
opts.en: (×) it's not that I never returned
opts.hi: (×) ऐसा नहीं कि कभी नहीं लौटाया
opts.gu: (×) એવું નથી કે ક્યારેય પાછું ન આપ્યું

items.why: Replacing a damaged borrowed book is what social common sense demands → 〜ずにはすまない (20課 【3】). 1) ずにはいられない (N2) is an inner impulse, not an obligation. 2) ずにはおかない (20課 【4】) is determination/inevitability, odd with だろう about an obligation. 4) 〜ずじまい (N2, "ended up never doing") is for past regrets and ではない doesn't attach naturally.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第1部 問題（1課〜20課）

items.q: 地震の被害に遭った地域の1日も早い復興を（ ）。
items.qr: Jishin no higai ni atta chiiki no ichinichi mo hayai fukkou o (___).
items.en: I sincerely hope for the speediest possible recovery of the areas hit by the earthquake.
items.hi: भूकंप प्रभावित इलाक़ों के जल्द से जल्द पुनर्निर्माण की मैं दिल से कामना करता हूँ।
items.gu: ભૂકંપગ્રસ્ત વિસ્તારોના વહેલામાં વહેલા પુનર્નિર્માણની હું દિલથી કામના કરું છું.

opts.t: 願わずにはおきません

opts.en: I have no choice but to wish

opts.t: 願わずにはすみません
opts.en: I can't get away without wishing
opts.hi: कामना किए बिना काम नहीं चलेगा

items.why: 願う is the model verb for 〜てやまない (20課 【1】), the set phrase of formal good wishes. 2) おかない is for determination about an action/effect, not for a wish. 3) ざるをえない (N2) makes the wish sound reluctant. 4) すまない makes it a social duty — cold and wrong in a message of sympathy.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第1部 問題（1課〜20課）

items.q: わたしはただ本当のことを（ ）。なぜ非難されるのかわからない。
items.qr: Watashi wa tada hontou no koto o (___). Naze hinan sareru no ka wakaranai.
items.en: I merely told the truth. I don't understand why I'm being criticised.
items.hi: मैंने तो बस सच कहा था। समझ नहीं आता कि मेरी आलोचना क्यों हो रही है।
items.gu: મેં તો બસ સાચું કહ્યું હતું. સમજાતું નથી કે મારી ટીકા કેમ થાય છે.
items.why: V-た + までだ (18課) = "I only did ~, nothing more" — a self-justification, which ただ and "why am I criticised" confirm. 1) and 3) are about timing ("just now"). 2) 〜かぎりだ (19課) attaches to emotion adjectives (うれしいかぎりだ), not to a verb た-form.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第1部 問題（1課〜20課）

items.q: 事故の現場は（ ）ひどさだった。
items.qr: Jiko no genba wa (___) hidosa datta.
items.en: The accident scene was so horrific it was unbearable to look at.
items.hi: दुर्घटना की जगह इतनी भयानक थी कि देखी नहीं जा रही थी।
items.gu: અકસ્માતનું સ્થળ એટલું ભયાનક હતું કે જોઈ શકાતું ન હતું.

opts.t: 見ようにも見られない
opts.hi: देखना चाहूँ तो भी देख न सकूँ
opts.gu: જોવું હોય તોય જોઈ ન શકું

items.why: V-辞書形 + に堪えない (19課 【2】) = "too awful to ~" (見るに堪えない, 聞くに堪えない) — and it modifies ひどさ naturally. Note this is the other に堪えない: 20課's is N + に堪えない for strong emotion. 1) すまない is obligation. 3) べくもない (13課) is used with 望む/知る ("can't possibly hope/know"), not 見る. 4) (よ)うにも〜ない (13課) means something physically prevents you, not that it's too horrible.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第1部 問題（1課〜20課）

items.q: そんなに笑う（ ）でしょう。わたしは真面目に話しているんですよ。
items.qr: Sonna ni warau (___) deshou. Watashi wa majime ni hanashite iru n desu yo.
items.en: There's no need to laugh like that, is there? I'm being serious.
items.hi: इतना हँसने की ज़रूरत नहीं है न? मैं गंभीरता से बात कर रहा हूँ।
items.gu: આટલું હસવાની જરૂર નથી ને? હું ગંભીરતાથી વાત કરું છું.
items.why: V-辞書形 + ことはない (N2) = "there's no need to ~", here a mild reproach (でしょう). 1) までではない isn't a pattern (18課 has 〜までもない). 2) どころではない ("no time for laughing") needs a busy/serious situation, not a reproach. 3) わけはない is a denial of possibility ("there's no way he laughs") — contradicts the fact that the person is laughing.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第1部 問題（1課〜20課）

items.q: 今さら（ ）が、時間を守らないということは社会では大きなマイナスになるのです。
items.qr: Imasara (___) ga, jikan o mamoranai to iu koto wa shakai de wa ookina mainasu ni naru no desu.
items.en: It hardly needs saying at this point, but not being punctual is a big minus in society.
items.hi: अब यह कहने की ज़रूरत तो नहीं, फिर भी समय का पाबंद न होना समाज में बड़ा नुक़सान है।
items.gu: હવે આ કહેવાની જરૂર તો નથી, છતાં સમયનું પાલન ન કરવું સમાજમાં મોટું નુકસાન છે.

opts.t: 言うまでもないことです
opts.r: iu made mo nai koto desu

opts.t: 言うところではありません
opts.en: (×) is not the point to say

opts.t: 言うまでのことではありません
opts.r: iu made no koto de wa arimasen

items.why: 〜までもない (18課) — 言うまでもないことですが is the fixed preface "needless to say, but…", matching 今さら. 3) is a blend of 18課's two forms: the negative of 〜までのことだ is not used; you'd say 言うまでのこともない. 2) and 4) misuse ところ (a point in time/place).
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第1部 問題（1課〜20課）

items.q: 渡辺氏はある団体に多額の寄付をしたが、これは特に評価する（ ）と思う。彼には何か政治的意図があるのだ。
items.qr: Watanabe-shi wa aru dantai ni tagaku no kifu o shita ga, kore wa toku ni hyouka suru (___) to omou. Kare ni wa nanika seijiteki ito ga aru no da.
items.en: Mr. Watanabe made a large donation to a certain organisation, but I don't think it is anything particularly worth praising. He has some political motive.
items.hi: वातानाबे जी ने एक संस्था को बड़ा दान दिया, पर मुझे नहीं लगता कि यह कोई ख़ास तारीफ़ के लायक़ बात है। उनका कोई राजनीतिक मक़सद है।
items.gu: વાતાનાબેજીએ એક સંસ્થાને મોટું દાન આપ્યું, પણ મને નથી લાગતું કે આ કોઈ ખાસ વખાણવા જેવી વાત છે. તેમનો કોઈ રાજકીય હેતુ છે.

opts.r: hodo no koto de wa nai
made no koto de wa nai

items.why: V + ほどのことではない (N2) = "not significant enough to ~". The distractors are corrupted versions of 18課 forms: 〜には当たらない attaches directly to the verb (評価するには当たらない would be fine!), so inserting ほど or まで (2, 4) breaks it; and 〜までのことだ has no ではない negative (3).
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第1部 問題（1課〜20課）

items.q: この旅行で ＿＿＿ ＿＿＿ ＿★＿ ＿＿＿ でも気軽に話せたことだ。
items.qr: Kono ryokou de ___ ___ ★ ___ demo kigaru ni hanaseta koto da.
items.en: What was better than anything else on this trip was that I could talk casually with anyone.
items.hi: इस यात्रा में सबसे बढ़कर अच्छी बात यह थी कि मैं किसी से भी आराम से बात कर सका।
items.gu: આ પ્રવાસમાં સૌથી વધુ સારી વાત એ હતી કે હું કોઈની પણ સાથે સહેલાઈથી વાત કરી શક્યો.
items.why: Rule [2]: 何 + にもまして ("more than anything") is a fixed pair → 何にもまして. It modifies 良かった, giving 何にもまして良かったことは (topic). だれと must sit right before the printed でも: だれとでも "with anyone". ★ tile 4 confirmed from 別冊 p.5; full order 1 → 3 → 4 → 2 reasoned.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第2部 1課 · 文の組み立て-1 決まった形

items.qr: Kikokugo ___ ___ ★ ___ datta.
items.en: For a whole month after returning home, it was job hunting day after day.
items.hi: वतन लौटने के बाद पूरे एक महीने तक रोज़ नौकरी की तलाश ही चलती रही।
items.gu: વતન પાછા ફર્યા પછી આખો એક મહિનો રોજેરોજ નોકરીની શોધ જ ચાલી.
items.why: Rule [3]: period + というもの → 1か月というもの ("for a whole month"). What fills that period: 連日 (adverb) + 職探し + printed だった. 職探し must be last because only a noun can precede だった. ★ tile 2 confirmed from 別冊 p.5; full order 1 → 4 → 2 → 3 reasoned.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第2部 1課 · 文の組み立て-1 決まった形

items.q: 祖母が ＿＿＿ ＿＿＿ ＿★＿ ＿＿＿ 歌は、わたしが知らないものばかりだ。
items.qr: Sobo ga ___ ___ ★ ___ uta wa, watashi ga shiranai mono bakari da.
items.en: The songs my grandmother sings, not really for anyone in particular to hear, are all ones I don't know.
items.hi: दादी जो गीत किसी को सुनाने के इरादे के बिना यूँ ही गाती हैं, वे सब मेरे लिए अनजाने हैं।
items.gu: દાદી કોઈને સંભળાવવાના ઇરાદા વગર એમ જ જે ગીતો ગાય છે, તે બધાં મારા માટે અજાણ્યાં છે.
items.why: Rules [2]/[3] of 6課: question word + V-dictionary + ともなく → だれに聞かせるともなく ("not aiming it at anyone"). The whole clause modifies 歌う, and 歌う modifies the printed 歌. ★ tile 3 confirmed from 別冊 p.5; full order 4 → 1 → 3 → 2 reasoned.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第2部 1課 · 文の組み立て-1 決まった形

items.q: 父は釣ってきた ＿＿＿ ＿＿＿ ＿★＿ ＿＿＿ するなと言った。
items.qr: Chichi wa tsutte kita ___ ___ ★ ___ suru na to itta.
items.en: My father said not to waste even one of the fish he had caught.
items.hi: पिताजी ने कहा कि उनकी पकड़ी हुई एक भी मछली बर्बाद मत करना।
items.gu: પિતાજીએ કહ્યું કે તેમણે પકડેલી એક પણ માછલી બગાડવી નહીં.
items.why: Rule [3]: 1 + counter + たりとも, followed by a negative (here the prohibition 〜するな). 釣ってきた needs a noun → 魚は; 粗末に attaches to the printed する. ★ tile 4 confirmed from 別冊 p.5; full order 3 → 1 → 4 → 2 reasoned.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第2部 1課 · 文の組み立て-1 決まった形

items.q: ＿＿＿ ＿＿＿ ＿★＿ ＿＿＿ 時間は取り戻せない。
items.qr: ___ ___ ★ ___ jikan wa torimodosenai.
items.en: However much you regret it, you can't get back time that has passed.
items.hi: कितना भी पछताओ, बीता हुआ समय वापस नहीं आता।
items.gu: ગમે તેટલો પસ્તાવો કરો, વીતેલો સમય પાછો મળતો નથી.
items.why: Rules [1]+[2]: どんなに + V-た + ところで + negative (取り戻せない). 過ぎた modifies 時間 directly, so it must be the last tile. ★ tile 3 confirmed from 別冊 p.5; full order 4 → 1 → 3 → 2 reasoned.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第2部 1課 · 文の組み立て-1 決まった形

items.q: 彼女の ＿＿＿ ＿＿＿ ＿★＿ ＿＿＿ あるのだろうと思って、何も聞かなかった。
items.qr: Kanojo no ___ ___ ★ ___ aru no darou to omotte, nani mo kikanakatta.
items.en: I thought there must be circumstances behind her resignation that she couldn't bring herself to talk about, so I didn't ask anything.
items.hi: मुझे लगा कि उसके इस्तीफ़े के पीछे कोई ऐसी बात होगी जो वह चाहकर भी नहीं बता सकती, इसलिए मैंने कुछ नहीं पूछा।
items.gu: મને લાગ્યું કે તેના રાજીનામા પાછળ કોઈ એવી વાત હશે જે તે ઇચ્છે તોય કહી શકે નહીં, તેથી મેં કંઈ પૂછ્યું નહીં.
items.why: Rule [1]: V-dictionary + に + potential-negative of the same verb → 話すに話せない. It modifies 事情が, which pairs with the printed ある. 彼女の needs a noun → 退職には. ★ tile 1 confirmed from 別冊 p.5; full order 3 → 2 → 1 → 4 reasoned.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第2部 1課 · 文の組み立て-1 決まった形

items.q: 将来 ＿＿＿ ＿＿＿ ＿★＿ ＿＿＿ だけは大切にしたほうがいい。
items.qr: Shourai ___ ___ ★ ___ dake wa taisetsu ni shita hou ga ii.
items.en: Whatever kind of work you do in the future, you should treasure your relationships with people above all.
items.hi: भविष्य में तुम कैसा भी काम करो, आपसी संबंधों को ज़रूर संभालकर रखना चाहिए।
items.gu: ભવિષ્યમાં તમે ગમે તેવું કામ કરો, માનવીય સંબંધોને તો જરૂર સાચવવા જોઈએ.
items.why: Rule [2]: どんな + … + であれ ("whatever"). どんな modifies 仕事, so どんな仕事をするの + であれ. 人間関係 goes before the printed だけは. ★ tile 4 confirmed from 別冊 p.5; full order 3 → 2 → 4 → 1 reasoned.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第2部 1課 · 文の組み立て-1 決まった形

items.q: この案に不賛成なら代案を ＿＿＿ ＿＿＿ ＿★＿ ＿＿＿ 名案があるわけではない。
items.qr: Kono an ni fusansei nara daian o ___ ___ ★ ___ meian ga aru wake de wa nai.
items.en: Even if I'm told "if you oppose this plan, propose an alternative", I myself don't exactly have a brilliant idea either.
items.hi: अगर कहा जाए कि "इस प्रस्ताव से असहमत हो तो विकल्प दो", तो भी मेरे पास भी कोई बढ़िया उपाय नहीं है।
items.gu: જો કહેવામાં આવે કે "આ પ્રસ્તાવથી અસંમત હો તો વિકલ્પ આપો", તોય મારી પાસે પણ કોઈ સરસ ઉપાય નથી.
items.why: Rule [1]: N + にしたところで ("even for N") + negative (わけではない). 代案を needs a verb: 出せと言われても (quoted command + passive + ても). Then わたし＋にしたところで. ★ tile 1 confirmed from 別冊 p.5; full order 3 → 2 → 1 → 4 reasoned.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第2部 1課 · 文の組み立て-1 決まった形

items.q: 転職する ＿＿＿ ＿＿＿ ＿★＿ ＿＿＿ と思って決心した。
items.qr: Tenshoku suru ___ ___ ★ ___ to omotte kesshin shita.
items.en: I decided, thinking there could be no better time to change jobs than now.
items.hi: मैंने यह सोचकर फ़ैसला किया कि नौकरी बदलने का अभी के अलावा कोई और सही समय नहीं हो सकता।
items.gu: મેં એમ વિચારીને નિર્ણય લીધો કે નોકરી બદલવાનો અત્યાર સિવાય બીજો કોઈ યોગ્ય સમય નથી.
items.why: Rule [1]: N をおいて ほかに + negative ("no one/nothing but N"). 転職する modifies 時期は; then 今をおいて → ほかに → 考えられない before the printed と思って. ★ tile 3 confirmed from 別冊 p.5; full order 1 → 4 → 3 → 2 reasoned.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第2部 1課 · 文の組み立て-1 決まった形

items.q: 今晩中に戦後史について ＿＿＿ ＿＿＿ ＿★＿ ＿＿＿ を読まなければならない。
items.qr: Konbanjuu ni sengoshi ni tsuite ___ ___ ★ ___ o yomanakereba naranai.
items.en: By tonight I have to read material on post-war history that runs to a good 100 pages.
items.hi: आज रात तक मुझे युद्धोत्तर इतिहास पर लिखी 100 पन्नों जितनी लंबी सामग्री पढ़नी है।
items.gu: આજે રાત સુધીમાં મારે યુદ્ધ પછીના ઇતિહાસ પર લખાયેલી 100 પાનાં જેટલી લાંબી સામગ્રી વાંચવી પડશે.
items.why: Rule [3]: large number + からある + noun → 100ページからある資料. について needs a verb → 書かれた, which here modifies the whole "100ページからある資料". 資料 is last because it takes the printed を. ★ tile 4 confirmed from 別冊 p.5; full order 3 → 2 → 4 → 1 reasoned.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第2部 1課 · 文の組み立て-1 決まった形

items.q: 部品がない ＿＿＿ ＿＿＿ ＿★＿ ＿＿＿ 直せないではありませんか。
items.qr: Buhin ga nai ___ ___ ★ ___ naosenai de wa arimasen ka.
items.en: If there are no parts, then even if you say it's a precious sewing machine, there's no way to fix it however much you'd like to, is there?
items.hi: पुर्ज़े ही नहीं हैं तो, भले ही यह कीमती सिलाई मशीन हो, ठीक करना चाहकर भी ठीक नहीं की जा सकती, है न?
items.gu: પુરજા જ નથી તો, ભલે આ કીમતી સિલાઈ મશીન હોય, સુધારવી હોય તોય સુધારી શકાય નહીં, ખરું ને?

opts.en: because it's a precious sewing machine
opts.hi: क्योंकि यह कीमती सिलाई मशीन है
opts.gu: કારણ કે આ કીમતી સિલાઈ મશીન છે

items.why: Rule [1]: V-volitional + にも + potential-negative of the same verb → 直そうにも + printed 直せない, so 直そうにも is the last tile. 部品がない + のでは ("if there are no parts"); 〜だから + といっても is a set phrase ("even granting that…"). ★ tile 1 confirmed from 別冊 p.5; full order 2 → 4 → 1 → 3 reasoned.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第2部 1課 · 文の組み立て-1 決まった形

items.q: 責任者の ＿＿＿ ＿＿＿ ＿★＿ ＿＿＿ はできないんです。
items.qr: Sekininsha no ___ ___ ★ ___ wa dekinai n desu.
items.en: Without permission from the person in charge, outsiders cannot enter the room.
items.hi: ज़िम्मेदार व्यक्ति की अनुमति के बिना बाहरी लोग कमरे में नहीं आ सकते।
items.gu: જવાબદાર વ્યક્તિની પરવાનગી વગર બહારના લોકો રૂમમાં પ્રવેશી શકતા નથી.
items.why: Rule [1]: N + なしには + negative (できない). 責任者の needs a noun → 許可; 許可なしには; then 部外者の入室 before the printed は. ★ tile 3 confirmed from 別冊 p.5; full order 1 → 4 → 3 → 2 reasoned.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第2部 1課 · 文の組み立て-1 決まった形

items.q: 他人の功績を横取りする ＿＿＿ ＿＿＿ ＿★＿ ＿＿＿ することではない。
items.qr: Tanin no kouseki o yokodori suru ___ ___ ★ ___ suru koto de wa nai.
items.en: Stealing credit for others' achievements is not something a person in the position of university president should do.
items.hi: दूसरों की उपलब्धियों का श्रेय छीनना किसी विश्वविद्यालय के कुलपति जैसे व्यक्ति को शोभा नहीं देता।
items.gu: બીજાની સિદ્ધિઓનો શ્રેય છીનવી લેવો એ યુનિવર્સિટીના કુલપતિ જેવી વ્યક્તિને શોભે નહીં.
items.why: Rule [1]: status noun + ともあろう + 人 → 大学の学長ともあろう人の (の = subject marker inside the clause 人のすること). 横取りする + なんて is the topic ("such a thing as stealing credit"). ★ tile 3 confirmed from 別冊 p.5; full order 4 → 1 → 3 → 2 reasoned.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第2部 2課 · 文の組み立て-2 名詞を説明する形式

items.q: 原爆を落とす ＿＿＿ ＿＿＿ ＿★＿ ＿＿＿ してはならない。
items.qr: Genbaku o otosu ___ ___ ★ ___ shite wa naranai.
items.en: The unforgivable act of dropping an atomic bomb must never be committed again.
items.hi: परमाणु बम गिराने जैसा अक्षम्य कृत्य दोबारा कभी नहीं होना चाहिए।
items.gu: અણુબોમ્બ ફેંકવા જેવું અક્ષમ્ય કૃત્ય ફરી ક્યારેય ન થવું જોઈએ.
items.why: Rule [1]: べからざる must be followed by a noun → 許すべからざる行為を. Rule [2]d: plain form + などという + N names the content. 二度と pairs with the printed negative してはならない. ★ tile 1 confirmed from 別冊 p.5; full order 2 → 3 → 1 → 4 reasoned.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第2部 2課 · 文の組み立て-2 名詞を説明する形式

items.q: わいろを受け取る ＿＿＿ ＿＿＿ ＿★＿ ＿＿＿ ことだ。
items.qr: Wairo o uketoru ___ ___ ★ ___ koto da.
items.en: Taking bribes is something utterly unbecoming of a politician.
items.hi: रिश्वत लेना एक राजनेता के लिए बिल्कुल अशोभनीय बात है।
items.gu: લાંચ લેવી એ રાજકારણી માટે બિલકુલ અશોભનીય વાત છે.
items.why: Rule [1]: the set phrase N にあるまじき + N ("unbecoming of N"). まじき needs a noun after it — the printed こと — so it is the last tile, and ある comes right before it. 受け取る + とは is the topic. ★ tile 3 confirmed from 別冊 p.5; full order 4 → 1 → 3 → 2 reasoned.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第2部 2課 · 文の組み立て-2 名詞を説明する形式

items.q: 従業員の皆さんは、 ＿＿＿ ＿＿＿ ＿★＿ ＿＿＿ 姿勢を忘れないでください。
items.qr: Juugyouin no minasan wa, ___ ___ ★ ___ shisei o wasurenaide kudasai.
items.en: All staff, please never forget the attitude that a service business exists only because of its customers.
items.hi: सभी कर्मचारी यह रवैया न भूलें कि सेवा उद्योग ग्राहकों के कारण ही है।
items.gu: બધા કર્મચારીઓ આ વલણ ન ભૂલે કે સેવા ઉદ્યોગ ગ્રાહકોને કારણે જ છે.
items.why: Rule [1]: A あっての B ("B is only possible with A") → お客様あってのサービス業. Rule [2]d: that whole idea + という + 姿勢 (attitude = content of a belief). ★ tile 2 confirmed from 別冊 p.5; full order 1 → 4 → 2 → 3 reasoned.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第2部 2課 · 文の組み立て-2 名詞を説明する形式

items.q: 政府からの補助金が打ち切られる ＿＿＿ ＿＿＿ ＿★＿ ＿＿＿ 話ではないと楽観していた。
items.qr: Seifu kara no hojokin ga uchikirareru ___ ___ ★ ___ hanashi de wa nai to rakkan shite ita.
items.en: I was optimistic that even the situation of the government subsidy being cut off was not something that would happen right away.
items.hi: मैं आशावादी था कि सरकारी अनुदान बंद होने जैसी स्थिति भी अभी तुरंत की बात नहीं है।
items.gu: હું આશાવાદી હતો કે સરકારી અનુદાન બંધ થવાની સ્થિતિ પણ હમણાં તરતની વાત નથી.
items.why: Rule [2]b: adverb + の + N → 今すぐの話 ("a right-now matter"). Rule [2]d: 打ち切られる + という + 事態. So the tail is 今すぐ → の before the printed 話. ★ tile 4 confirmed from 別冊 p.5; full order 2 → 1 → 4 → 3 reasoned.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第2部 2課 · 文の組み立て-2 名詞を説明する形式

items.q: わが社の ＿＿＿ ＿＿＿ ＿★＿ ＿＿＿ 気がつくべきだった。
items.qr: Waga sha no ___ ___ ★ ___ ki ga tsuku beki datta.
items.en: We should have noticed much earlier the serious financial state that threatened our company's survival.
items.hi: हमें अपनी कंपनी के अस्तित्व से जुड़ी गंभीर आर्थिक स्थिति को बहुत पहले ही समझ लेना चाहिए था।
items.gu: અમારે કંપનીના અસ્તિત્વ સાથે સંકળાયેલી ગંભીર આર્થિક સ્થિતિ વિશે ઘણું વહેલું સમજી જવું જોઈતું હતું.
items.why: Rule [1]: にかかわる + (adjective +) noun, as in the book's 将来にかかわる大切な問題. わが社の → 存続にかかわる → 深刻な → 経済状態について; もっと早く modifies the printed 気がつく. ★ tile 1 confirmed from 別冊 p.5; full order 2 → 3 → 1 → 4 reasoned.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第2部 2課 · 文の組み立て-2 名詞を説明する形式

items.q: 昨日は ＿＿＿ ＿＿＿ ＿★＿ ＿＿＿ ので、かえって疲れた。
items.qr: Kinou wa ___ ___ ★ ___ node, kaette tsukareta.
items.en: Yesterday's hike was a slow walk along a bumpy mountain path, so it actually made me more tired.
items.hi: कल ऊबड़-खाबड़ पहाड़ी रास्ते पर धीरे-धीरे चलने वाली चढ़ाई थी, इसलिए उल्टा ज़्यादा थकान हुई।
items.gu: ગઈકાલે ખાડાટેકરાવાળા પહાડી રસ્તે ધીમે ધીમે ચાલવાનું પર્વતારોહણ હતું, તેથી ઊલટો વધુ થાક લાગ્યો.
items.why: Rule [2]c: plain form + N explains the content → (でこぼこした山道を)ゆっくり歩く登山. でこぼこした modifies 山道; 登山だった must precede the printed ので. ★ tile 3 confirmed from 別冊 p.5; full order 2 → 1 → 3 → 4 reasoned.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第2部 2課 · 文の組み立て-2 名詞を説明する形式

items.q: 江戸時代末期に、 ＿＿＿ ＿＿＿ ＿★＿ ＿＿＿ 高い若者が活躍した。
items.qr: Edo jidai makki ni, ___ ___ ★ ___ takai wakamono ga katsuyaku shita.
items.en: At the end of the Edo period, young people with the lofty aim of improving Japan's politics played an active role.
items.hi: एदो काल के अंत में, जापान की राजनीति सुधारने के ऊँचे इरादे वाले युवा सक्रिय रहे।
items.gu: એદો યુગના અંતે, જાપાનનું રાજકારણ સુધારવાના ઊંચા ઇરાદાવાળા યુવાનો સક્રિય રહ્યા.
items.why: Rule [2]d: the content of an aspiration is quoted with という → 良くしようという志. 志の高い若者 = "young people whose aspirations are high" (の as subject marker in the noun clause). ★ tile 3 confirmed from 別冊 p.5; full order 1 → 4 → 3 → 2 reasoned.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第2部 2課 · 文の組み立て-2 名詞を説明する形式

items.q: 値札に書いてある ＿＿＿ ＿＿＿ ＿★＿ ＿＿＿ 値段です。
items.qr: Nefuda ni kaite aru ___ ___ ★ ___ nedan desu.
items.en: The 36,540 yen written on the price tag is the price including consumption tax.
items.hi: प्राइस टैग पर लिखे 36,540 येन उपभोग कर सहित कीमत है।
items.gu: ભાવના લેબલ પર લખેલા 36,540 યેન વપરાશ કર સહિતની કિંમત છે.
items.why: 書いてある needs a noun → 36,540円; というのは marks it as the topic being explained. Then 消費税 + 込みの (N込み = including N) + printed 値段. ★ tile 2 confirmed from 別冊 p.5; full order 1 → 3 → 2 → 4 reasoned.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第2部 2課 · 文の組み立て-2 名詞を説明する形式

items.q: 日本へ来た ＿＿＿ ＿＿＿ ＿★＿ ＿＿＿ 友人が訪ねてきた。
items.qr: Nihon e kita ___ ___ ★ ___ yuujin ga tazunete kita.
items.en: The year after I came to Japan, a longtime friend who had found a job back home came to visit me.
items.hi: जापान आने के अगले साल, अपने देश में नौकरी पाने वाला एक पुराना दोस्त मिलने आया।
items.gu: જાપાન આવ્યાના પછીના વર્ષે, પોતાના દેશમાં નોકરી મેળવનાર એક જૂનો મિત્ર મળવા આવ્યો.
items.why: 来た + 翌年 ("the year after coming"). The friend is described twice: plain-form clause 国で就職した (Rule [2]c) and 昔からの (Rule [2]a-type "〜からの + N"). The plain clause comes first, then 昔からの right before 友人. ★ tile 4 confirmed from 別冊 p.5; full order 1 → 2 → 4 → 3 reasoned.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第2部 2課 · 文の組み立て-2 名詞を説明する形式

items.q: 話し合いの後、わたしは、言うべき ＿＿＿ ＿＿＿ ＿★＿ ＿＿＿ 満足感を持った。
items.qr: Hanashiai no ato, watashi wa, iu beki ___ ___ ★ ___ manzokukan o motta.
items.en: After the discussion, I felt a quiet satisfaction that I had said everything that needed saying.
items.hi: चर्चा के बाद, मुझे मन ही मन संतोष हुआ कि जो कहना था, सब कह दिया।
items.gu: ચર્ચા પછી, મને મનોમન સંતોષ થયો કે જે કહેવાનું હતું તે બધું કહી દીધું.
items.why: Rule [2]d: content of a feeling + という + 満足感. 言うべき needs a noun → ことは; すべて言った completes the quote; 密かな is an adjective on the printed 満足感, so it is last. ★ tile 3 confirmed from 別冊 p.5; full order 1 → 4 → 3 → 2 reasoned.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第2部 2課 · 文の組み立て-2 名詞を説明する形式

items.q: この作品を ＿＿＿ ＿＿＿ ＿★＿ ＿＿＿ 焦りのため、毎日いらいらしていた。
items.qr: Kono sakuhin o ___ ___ ★ ___ aseri no tame, mainichi iraira shite ita.
items.en: I was irritable every day, anxious to finish this work by the set deadline.
items.hi: इस कृति को निर्धारित समय-सीमा तक पूरा करने की बेचैनी के कारण मैं रोज़ चिड़चिड़ा रहता था।
items.gu: આ કૃતિ નક્કી કરેલી સમયમર્યાદામાં પૂરી કરવાની અધીરાઈને લીધે હું રોજ ચિડાયેલો રહેતો હતો.
items.why: Rule [2]d: wish + という + 焦り (the content of the impatience). 指定された modifies 期限; この作品を … 作り上げたい is the verb, so the chain ends 作り上げたい → という before the printed 焦り. ★ tile 4 confirmed from 別冊 p.5; full order 2 → 1 → 4 → 3 reasoned.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第2部 2課 · 文の組み立て-2 名詞を説明する形式

items.q: 珍しい ＿＿＿ ＿＿＿ ＿★＿ ＿＿＿ いいと思うよ。
items.qr: Mezurashii ___ ___ ★ ___ ii to omou yo.
items.en: It's not as if you're making some exotic dish — I think you can just shop at an ordinary supermarket.
items.hi: कोई अनोखा पकवान तो बना नहीं रहे, साधारण सुपरमार्केट से ख़रीदारी कर लो तो काफ़ी है।
items.gu: કોઈ અનોખી વાનગી તો બનાવતા નથી, સામાન્ય સુપરમાર્કેટમાંથી ખરીદી કરી લો તો ચાલે.

opts.r: ryouri o tsukuru no de wa
opts.en: (it's not as if) you're making a dish
opts.hi: (ऐसा तो नहीं कि) पकवान बना रहे हो
opts.gu: (એવું તો નથી કે) વાનગી બનાવો છો

items.why: Group [1]: N(のでは) + あるまいし — 料理を作るのでは + あるまいし is a split fixed form, so tiles 1 and 3 are adjacent. 普通のスーパーで + 買い物すれば joins the printed いい (〜ばいい). ★ tile 4 confirmed from 別冊 p.5; full order 1 → 3 → 4 → 2 reasoned.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第2部 3課 · 文の組み立て-3 接続に注意

items.q: 手術の後、両親が ＿＿＿ ＿＿＿ ＿★＿ ＿＿＿ すやすや眠っている。
items.qr: Shujutsu no ato, ryoushin ga ___ ___ ★ ___ suyasuya nemutte iru.
items.en: After the operation, oblivious to her parents fretting with worry, the baby is sleeping peacefully.
items.hi: ऑपरेशन के बाद, माता-पिता की घबराहट से बेख़बर, बच्चा चैन से सो रहा है।
items.gu: ઑપરેશન પછી, માતા-પિતાની ગભરામણથી બેખબર, બાળક શાંતિથી ઊંઘે છે.
items.why: Group [1]: 〜をよそに needs a noun — here the nominalised おろおろするのを. 両親が + 心配して describes the fretting. 赤ちゃんは is the subject of the printed 眠っている. ★ tile 4 confirmed from 別冊 p.5; full order 2 → 1 → 4 → 3 reasoned.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第2部 3課 · 文の組み立て-3 接続に注意

items.q: とても疲れていて、 ＿＿＿ ＿＿＿ ＿★＿ ＿＿＿ 面倒だった。
items.qr: Totemo tsukarete ite, ___ ___ ★ ___ mendou datta.
items.en: I was so tired that even getting up was a chore, let alone cooking a meal.
items.hi: मैं इतना थका था कि खाना बनाना तो दूर, उठना भी भारी लग रहा था।
items.gu: હું એટલો થાકેલો હતો કે જમવાનું બનાવવું તો દૂર, ઊઠવું પણ ભારે લાગતું હતું.
items.why: Group [1]: A(こと) + はおろか + B + さえ／も. The bigger task (cooking) goes before はおろか, the minimal one (getting up) with さえ — not the other way round, which would make no sense. ★ tile 2 confirmed from 別冊 p.5; full order 1 → 3 → 2 → 4 reasoned.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第2部 3課 · 文の組み立て-3 接続に注意

items.q: 命にかかわる ＿＿＿ ＿＿＿ ＿★＿ ＿＿＿ 病気でそんなに慌てることはない。
items.qr: Inochi ni kakawaru ___ ___ ★ ___ byouki de sonna ni awateru koto wa nai.
items.en: A life-threatening illness would be another matter, but there's no need to panic like that over an illness this minor.
items.hi: जानलेवा बीमारी हो तो बात अलग है, पर इतनी-सी बीमारी में इतना घबराने की ज़रूरत नहीं।
items.gu: જીવલેણ બીમારી હોય તો વાત જુદી, પણ આટલી અમથી બીમારીમાં આટલું ગભરાવાની જરૂર નથી.
items.why: Group [1]: N + ならいざしらず, split into tiles なら + いざしらず. にかかわる needs a noun → 病気; これぐらいの modifies the printed 病気. ★ tile 2 confirmed from 別冊 p.5; full order 1 → 4 → 2 → 3 reasoned.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第2部 3課 · 文の組み立て-3 接続に注意

items.q: リーさんのスピーチは ＿＿＿ ＿＿＿ ＿★＿ ＿＿＿ 魅力的だった。
items.qr: Rii-san no supiichi wa ___ ___ ★ ___ miryokuteki datta.
items.en: Mr. Lee's speech was appealing not only for its content but even more for his calm delivery.
items.hi: ली जी के भाषण की विषय-वस्तु तो अच्छी थी ही, उनका शांत बोलने का ढंग और भी आकर्षक था।
items.gu: લીજીના ભાષણની વિષયવસ્તુ તો સારી હતી જ, તેમની શાંત બોલવાની રીત વધુ આકર્ષક હતી.
items.why: Group [1]: N + もさることながら — 内容も + さることながら. 落ちついた modifies 話し方が, the subject of the printed 魅力的だった. ★ tile 1 confirmed from 別冊 p.5; full order 2 → 4 → 1 → 3 reasoned.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第2部 3課 · 文の組み立て-3 接続に注意

items.q: この道30年の ＿＿＿ ＿＿＿ ＿★＿ ＿＿＿ よく心得ている。
items.qr: Kono michi sanjuunen no ___ ___ ★ ___ yoku kokoroete iru.
items.en: Once you're a veteran with 30 years in this field, you know it thoroughly right down to the finest details.
items.hi: इस क्षेत्र में 30 साल के अनुभवी को तो बारीक से बारीक बात तक अच्छी तरह पता होती है।
items.gu: આ ક્ષેત્રમાં 30 વર્ષના અનુભવીને તો નાનામાં નાની બાબત સુધી બધું સારી રીતે ખબર હોય છે.
items.why: Group [1]: N + ともなると (split: ベテランとも + なると) and N + に至るまで (細部に + 至るまで). この道30年の must be followed by the noun ベテラン. ★ tile 4 confirmed from 別冊 p.5; full order 3 → 1 → 4 → 2 reasoned.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第2部 3課 · 文の組み立て-3 接続に注意

items.q: 改めて ＿＿＿ ＿＿＿ ＿★＿ ＿＿＿ なしには満足も得られないだろう。
items.qr: Aratamete ___ ___ ★ ___ nashi ni wa manzoku mo erarenai darou.
items.en: It goes without saying that without making an effort you won't gain satisfaction either.
items.hi: यह दोबारा कहने की ज़रूरत नहीं कि मेहनत किए बिना संतोष भी नहीं मिलेगा।
items.gu: ફરીથી કહેવાની જરૂર નથી કે મહેનત કર્યા વગર સંતોષ પણ નહીં મળે.
items.why: Group [3]: V-dict + までもなく → 言うまでもなく (with 改めて). Group [1]: なしには needs a noun → 努力すること + printed なしには. ★ tile 2 confirmed from 別冊 p.5; full order 1 → 3 → 2 → 4 reasoned.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第2部 3課 · 文の組み立て-3 接続に注意

items.q: この3連休は ＿＿＿ ＿＿＿ ＿★＿ ＿＿＿ 家にいるほうがいい。
items.qr: Kono sanrenkyuu wa ___ ___ ★ ___ ie ni iru hou ga ii.
items.en: This three-day weekend, rather than put up with the crowds at a resort, I'd sooner do nothing and stay home.
items.hi: इस तीन दिन की छुट्टी में भीड़ सहकर पर्यटन स्थल पर घूमने से तो अच्छा है कि कुछ न करके घर पर रहूँ।
items.gu: આ ત્રણ દિવસની રજામાં ભીડ સહન કરીને પર્યટન સ્થળે મોજ કરવા કરતાં તો કંઈ કર્યા વગર ઘરે રહેવું સારું.
items.why: Group [3]: V-dict + くらいなら → 遊ぶくらいなら. The rejected option (crowds + resort) comes first; the preferred one (何もしないで + printed 家にいるほうがいい) after. ★ tile 4 confirmed from 別冊 p.5; full order 1 → 3 → 4 → 2 reasoned.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第2部 3課 · 文の組み立て-3 接続に注意

items.qr: Kare no ___ ___ ★ ___ kansei o ageta.
items.en: The moment his acquittal was confirmed, his supporters let out a cheer.
items.hi: उसकी बेगुनाही पक्की होते ही, उसके समर्थकों ने जयकारा लगाया।
items.gu: તેની નિર્દોષતા નક્કી થતાં જ, તેના સમર્થકોએ હર્ષનાદ કર્યો.
items.why: Group [3]: V-dict + や ("the moment") → 確定するや. 彼の needs a noun → 無罪が. 支持する modifies 人たちが, subject of the printed 歓声を上げた. ★ tile 1 confirmed from 別冊 p.5; full order 2 → 4 → 1 → 3 reasoned.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第2部 3課 · 文の組み立て-3 接続に注意

items.qr: Oya kara no ___ ___ ★ ___ ie o deta.
items.en: Unable to wait for my parents' consent, I left home in order to live independently.
items.hi: माता-पिता की सहमति का इंतज़ार न कर पाकर, मैं स्वतंत्र रूप से रहने के लिए घर से निकल गया।
items.gu: માતા-પિતાની સંમતિની રાહ ન જોઈ શકતાં, હું સ્વતંત્ર રીતે રહેવા ઘર છોડી ગયો.
items.why: Group [3]: V-dict + べく ("in order to") → 暮らすべく + printed 家を出た. 親からの needs a noun → 承諾を + 待ちきれず. ★ tile 1 confirmed from 別冊 p.5; full order 2 → 3 → 1 → 4 reasoned.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第2部 3課 · 文の組み立て-3 接続に注意

items.q: うちの母と ＿＿＿ ＿＿＿ ＿★＿ ＿＿＿ できない。
items.qr: Uchi no haha to ___ ___ ★ ___ dekinai.
items.en: As for my mother — she can't even record a video, let alone use a computer.
items.hi: मेरी माँ का तो क्या कहें, कंप्यूटर तो दूर, वह वीडियो रिकॉर्ड करना भी नहीं जानतीं।
items.gu: મારી માની તો વાત જ શી કરવી, કમ્પ્યુટર તો દૂર, તે વીડિયો રેકોર્ડ કરવાનું પણ જાણતાં નથી.
items.why: Group [1]: N + ときたら (printed と + tile きたら, a critical topic) and N は + おろか + N も + negative. The harder thing (パソコン) goes with はおろか, the easier (録画) with も. ★ tile 4 confirmed from 別冊 p.5; full order 1 → 3 → 4 → 2 reasoned.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第2部 3課 · 文の組み立て-3 接続に注意

items.q: 納入がよく遅れるという理由で ＿＿＿ ＿＿＿ ＿★＿ ＿＿＿ 大切さがわかった。
items.qr: Nounyuu ga yoku okureru to iu riyuu de ___ ___ ★ ___ taisetsusa ga wakatta.
items.en: Only when it came to losing work because my deliveries were often late did I understand the importance of keeping deadlines.
items.hi: डिलीवरी अक्सर देर से होने के कारण काम छिन जाने की नौबत आने पर ही मुझे समय-सीमा का पालन करने का महत्व समझ आया।
items.gu: ડિલિવરી વારંવાર મોડી થવાને કારણે કામ ગુમાવવાની નોબત આવી ત્યારે જ મને સમયમર્યાદા પાળવાનું મહત્ત્વ સમજાયું.
items.why: Group [2]: V-dict／N + に至って ("only when it came to…") → 失うに至って. 理由で needs the event 仕事を失う; 期限を守る modifies the printed 大切さ. ★ tile 4 confirmed from 別冊 p.5; full order 3 → 1 → 4 → 2 reasoned.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第2部 3課 · 文の組み立て-3 接続に注意

items.q: 中でも自分で（ ）言葉を後悔することが多い。
items.qr: Naka demo jibun de (___) kotoba o koukai suru koto ga ooi.
items.why: D-1: you can only regret words after saying them, so the saying precedes 後悔する → た. 言う would mean words still to be said.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 1課 · 時制

items.q: あんなことを言わなければ（ ）。
items.qr: Anna koto o iwanakereba (___).
items.why: B-3: the words have already been said, so this is regret about a past that can't change → 〜なければよかった. 〜なければいい is advice for the future.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 1課 · 時制

items.q: 無意識のうちに（ ）言葉だ。
items.qr: Muishiki no uchi ni (___) kotoba da.
items.why: The previous sentence asks どうして…出てしまったんだろう about one past slip; the answer must stay in the same completed past, with the same regretful てしまう. 出てきている describes something ongoing now.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 1課 · 時制

items.q: わたしの心のどこかに（ ）、我慢できなくて出てきたのだ。
items.qr: Watashi no kokoro no dokoka ni (___), gaman dekinakute dete kita no da.
items.why: The lesson's intro: distinguish an event at a point from a state over a span. The words were in a hidden state for a while before bursting out → ている. 隠れて would be a one-off action "hid and then…", a sequence that makes no sense here.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 1課 · 時制

items.q: 我慢できなくて（ ）のだ。
items.qr: Gaman dekinakute (___) no da.
items.why: The opposite of ④: bursting out is one event at one point → plain past 出てきた. 出ていた would describe a lasting state of "being out".
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 1課 · 時制

items.q: 修復できるものならすぐにそうしよう。あれは失言、言い過ぎだったと（ ）。
items.qr: Shuufuku dekiru mono nara sugu ni sou shiyou. Are wa shitsugen, iisugi datta to (___).
items.why: そうしよう sets up what the writer intends to do (not yet done) — 謝る spells out that plan. 謝った would report a past apology that never happened in the story.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 1課 · 時制

items.q: 体裁が悪いが後悔を引きずるよりはずっと（ ）。
items.qr: Teisai ga warui ga koukai o hikizuru yori wa zutto (___).
items.why: A general judgement inside the present-tense "advice" part (忘れること、気をつけることだ follow). 良かった would turn it into past regret and break the time flow.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 1課 · 時制

items.q: （ ）仕事を断って、いいチャンスを逃したことも多い。
items.qr: (___) shigoto o kotowatte, ii chansu o nogashita koto mo ooi.

opts.en: (work I) will be asked to do

items.why: D-1: you must be asked before you can refuse — 頼まれる precedes 断る → た.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 1課 · 時制

items.q: こちらの事態が（ ）ときはもう遅い。
items.qr: Kochira no jitai ga (___) toki wa mou osoi.
items.why: D-1 with とき: "it's too late" is judged once the improvement is complete → 改善したとき, even though the main clause 遅い is present.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 1課 · 時制

items.q: ああ、あのときちょっと無理をすれば（ ）のに、…
items.qr: Aa, ano toki chotto muri o sureba (___) noni, ...
items.why: B-3: あのとき + 〜ば + 〜のに = counterfactual past. The result must be past (できた) to mean "could have, but didn't".
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 1課 · 時制

items.q: あの仕事を（ ）、今は充実した仕事を持って、…
items.qr: Ano shigoto o (___), ima wa juujitsu shita shigoto o motte, ...
items.why: C-1: 〜ていれば makes the contrary-to-fact past clear ("had I accepted that job back then"). Plain 受ければ reads as a general or future condition.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 1課 · 時制

items.q: 今は充実した仕事を持って、バリバリ（ ）だろうなどとひどく後悔する。
items.qr: Ima wa juujitsu shita shigoto o motte, baribari (___) darou nado to hidoku koukai suru.
items.why: C-1: the result of a counterfactual takes 〜ていただろう ("would (now) be doing") — even with 今は, because the whole situation is imaginary. やるだろう would be a real prediction.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 1課 · 時制

items.q: サイクロトロン（加速器）が科学を象徴し、原爆が技術を（ ）ことを示している。
items.qr: Saikurotoron (kasokuki) ga kagaku o shouchou shi, genbaku ga gijutsu o (___) koto o shimeshite iru.
items.why: The title's meaning is a current, lasting fact (示している is present) — "X stands for Y" is a state → 〜ている; the first half 象徴し is the same verb in 連用 form and is read with the same tense. Past forms 1/3 would say the symbolism has ended; 4 adds a future development the title doesn't claim.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 1課 · 時制

items.q: もし科学者や技術者がいなく、科学の発展もなかったなら、あのように恐ろしい兵器も（ ）にちがいない。
items.qr: Moshi kagakusha ya gijutsusha ga inaku, kagaku no hatten mo nakatta nara, ano you ni osoroshii heiki mo (___) ni chigai nai.
items.why: B-3: もし…なかったなら sets up a contrary-to-fact past (scientists did exist). Its result must be past and negative → 生まれなかったにちがいない. 1 is positive (contradicts the logic); 3 is a general/future statement; 2 describes a continuing state, which makes no sense for a weapon that does exist.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 1課 · 時制

items.q: ——だれもが考える素朴な疑問である。しかし、本当に（ ）。
items.qr: — Daremo ga kangaeru soboku na gimon de aru. Shikashi, hontou ni (___).
items.why: しかし introduces doubt about the "naive" assumption just stated, and the text then answers 答えは否である — so the blank must be a rhetorical question about that claim (そう) → そうだろうか. 1 agrees (contradicts しかし); 3 and 4 ask "how" about nothing specific, and 4's past tense breaks the essay's present-tense argument.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 1課 · 時制

items.q: たとえ…プルトニウムが生成できたとしても、長崎に投下された原爆が（ ）。
items.qr: Tatoe ... purutoniumu ga seisei dekita to shite mo, Nagasaki ni touka sareta genbaku ga (___).

opts.en: that's why it could be built

opts.t: つくれないわけではない
opts.en: it's not that it can't be built
opts.hi: ऐसा नहीं कि नहीं बन सकता
opts.gu: એવું નથી કે ન બની શકે

opts.t: つくれるわけではない
opts.en: that doesn't mean it can be built
opts.hi: इसका मतलब यह नहीं कि बन सकता है
opts.gu: તેનો અર્થ એ નથી કે બની શકે

opts.t: つくれなかったわけである
opts.en: that's why it couldn't be built

items.why: たとえ〜としても ("even if") needs a denial of the expected consequence, and the next sentence says せいぜい…できるだけ ("at most you can only…") → つくれるわけではない (present: a general claim about what is possible). 2 is a double negative = "it can be built", the opposite. 1 and 4 are past-tense conclusions (〜わけである) that don't fit after たとえ〜としても.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 1課 · 時制

items.q: 本書の目的は、この現代科学の（ ）過程を歴史的に捉えかえすことにある。
items.qr: Honsho no mokuteki wa, kono gendai kagaku no (___) katei o rekishiteki ni toraekaesu koto ni aru.

opts.en: that had been feeling a contradiction
opts.hi: जो विरोधाभास महसूस कर रही थी

items.why: 〜に満ちた before a noun describes a state ("full of"), the same as 〜に満ちている — not a finished event. 2 (〜ていた) would push the state into a closed past, odd for "modern" science that is still going on. 3 and 4 need a person who feels; a 過程 (process) can't 感じる.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 1課 · 時制

items.q: （ ）、会社の経営も成り立たないと言ってもいいくらいだ。
items.qr: (___), kaisha no keiei mo naritatanai to itte mo ii kurai da.
items.en: Without sales activity, you could almost say the company couldn't even be run.
items.hi: बिक्री के काम के बिना, कहा जा सकता है कि कंपनी चल ही नहीं सकती।
items.gu: વેચાણના કામ વગર, કહી શકાય કે કંપની ચાલી જ ન શકે.

opts.t: 営業活動を抜きにしては
opts.r: eigyou katsudou o nuki ni shite wa

opts.t: 営業活動をしないとあれば
opts.r: eigyou katsudou o shinai to areba
opts.en: if it's a matter of not doing sales
opts.hi: अगर बात बिक्री न करने की हो
opts.gu: જો વાત વેચાણ ન કરવાની હોય

items.why: A general claim: "without X, Y can't work" → 〜を抜きにしては + negative (same family as 〜なしには, A-4). 〜とあれば (A-1) needs a special circumstance followed by the speaker's resolve ("if it's for…, I'll even…"), not a general negative statement.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 2課 · 条件を表す文

items.q: 結果を（ ）、評価してもらえない。
items.qr: Kekka o (___), hyouka shite moraenai.
items.en: Unless you produce results, you won't be rated.
items.hi: जब तक नतीजे न दिखाओ, तब तक तुम्हारी क़द्र नहीं होती।
items.gu: જ્યાં સુધી પરિણામ ન બતાવો, ત્યાં સુધી તમારી કદર થતી નથી.

opts.en: once you produce them, that's it

items.why: "Unless A, not B" → 〜ないことには + negative (第1部 9課). 〜たら最後 (A-2) predicts an irreversible bad result after A; producing results is good, so it makes no sense.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 2課 · 条件を表す文

items.q: 上司に、1週間で注文が1件も（ ）営業マンとは言えないと言われてしまった。
items.qr: Joushi ni, isshuukan de chuumon ga ikken mo (___) eigyouman to wa ienai to iwarete shimatta.
items.en: My boss told me that if I can't get a single order in a week, I can't call myself a salesman.
items.hi: बॉस ने मुझसे कहा कि अगर एक हफ़्ते में एक भी ऑर्डर नहीं ला सकते, तो तुम सेल्समैन कहलाने लायक़ नहीं।
items.gu: બૉસે મને કહ્યું કે જો એક અઠવાડિયામાં એક પણ ઑર્ડર ન લાવી શકો, તો તમે સેલ્સમેન કહેવાવાને લાયક નથી.

opts.en: if you're the kind who can't get

items.why: 確定: he really did fail to get orders, and the boss is criticising that → 〜ようでは + negative judgement (A-3). 〜としたら is a pure hypothesis ("supposing"), which doesn't fit criticism of a fact that has already happened.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 2課 · 条件を表す文

items.q: 「詰め込みは良くない。子供たちに自分で考えさせるようにしなければ（ ）」という意見がある。
items.qr: "Tsumekomi wa yoku nai. Kodomotachi ni jibun de kangaesaseru you ni shinakereba (___)" to iu iken ga aru.
items.en: There is the opinion: "Cramming is bad. We must get children to think for themselves."
items.hi: एक राय है: "रटाना ठीक नहीं। बच्चों को ख़ुद सोचने देना ज़रूरी है।"
items.gu: એક મત છે: "ગોખાવવું સારું નથી. બાળકોને જાતે વિચારવા દેવા જરૂરી છે."

opts.en: it would have been no good

items.why: 仮定 about the present/future: the opinion is a current proposal → 〜なければだめだ ("must"). だめだっただろう is a counterfactual about the past (B), which doesn't fit a live debate (議論が起きている).
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 2課 · 条件を表す文

items.q: これに対して、一定の知識をきちんと（ ）子供たちの基本的な力はつかないという意見もある。
items.qr: Kore ni taishite, ittei no chishiki o kichinto (___) kodomotachi no kihonteki na chikara wa tsukanai to iu iken mo aru.
items.en: Against this, there is also the opinion that without properly teaching a set body of knowledge, children won't develop basic ability.
items.hi: इसके विपरीत, यह राय भी है कि निश्चित ज्ञान ठीक से सिखाए बिना बच्चों में बुनियादी क्षमता नहीं आती।
items.gu: તેની સામે, એવો મત પણ છે કે ચોક્કસ જ્ઞાન બરાબર શીખવ્યા વગર બાળકોમાં મૂળભૂત ક્ષમતા આવતી નથી.
items.why: A general claim "without X, Y doesn't happen" → 〜ことなしには + negative (A-4, 仮定 reading). 〜なかったのなら refers to a specific past fact someone has just mentioned, but nobody said teaching didn't happen.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 2課 · 条件を表す文

items.q: いずれにしても、今の公教育を真剣に（ ）日本の将来が心配だ、という危機感から発した議論であろう。
items.qr: Izure ni shite mo, ima no koukyouiku o shinken ni (___) Nihon no shourai ga shinpai da, to iu kikikan kara hasshita giron de arou.
items.en: Either way, it's probably a debate born of the sense of crisis that unless we think seriously about today's public education, Japan's future is in doubt.
items.hi: जो भी हो, यह शायद उस संकट-भावना से उठी बहस है कि अगर आज की सरकारी शिक्षा पर गंभीरता से न सोचा, तो जापान का भविष्य चिंताजनक है।
items.gu: ગમે તે હોય, આ કદાચ એ કટોકટીની લાગણીમાંથી ઊઠેલી ચર્ચા છે કે જો આજના જાહેર શિક્ષણ પર ગંભીરતાથી ન વિચારીએ, તો જાપાનનું ભવિષ્ય ચિંતાજનક છે.

opts.en: if it's a matter of not thinking
opts.hi: अगर बात न सोचने की हो

items.why: A plain hypothesis → 〜なければ + 心配だ. 〜とあれば (A-1) needs a special reason followed by a resolve or willingness ("if it's for X, I'll even…"), so it can't lead into 心配だ.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 2課 · 条件を表す文

items.q: 大人になってから、若いときもっと勉強して（ ）と後悔する人が多い。
items.qr: Otona ni natte kara, wakai toki motto benkyou shite (___) to koukai suru hito ga ooi.
items.en: Many people, once grown up, regret "I should have studied more when I was young."
items.hi: बहुत से लोग बड़े होकर पछताते हैं कि "जवानी में और पढ़ लेना चाहिए था।"
items.gu: ઘણા લોકો મોટા થઈને પસ્તાય છે કે "યુવાનીમાં વધુ ભણી લેવું જોઈતું હતું."
items.why: 後悔する + 若いとき → regret about the past → 〜んだった (B ending; 第3部 1課 B-2). 〜ばいい is advice for the future, which can't be regretted.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 2課 · 条件を表す文

items.q: わたしも、勉強しろとうるさい親の言うことを（ ）と思うことがある。
items.qr: Watashi mo, benkyou shiro to urusai oya no iu koto o (___) to omou koto ga aru.
items.en: I too sometimes think I should have listened to my parents, who kept nagging me to study.
items.hi: मुझे भी कभी-कभी लगता है कि "पढ़ो!" कहकर टोकने वाले माता-पिता की बात सुन ली होती तो अच्छा था।
items.gu: મને પણ ક્યારેક લાગે છે કે "ભણ!" કહીને ટોકતાં માતા-પિતાની વાત સાંભળી હોત તો સારું હતું.

opts.t: 聞いていればよかった

items.why: 反実仮想 (B): he didn't listen, and regrets it → 〜ていれば + 〜ばよかった. 〜ばいい is present/future advice.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 2課 · 条件を表す文

items.q: 成績の問題ではなく、難しい（ ）一定時間取り組んでいられる我慢強さは、子供のときに養われるものかもしれないのだ。
items.qr: Seiseki no mondai de wa naku, muzukashii (___) ittei jikan torikunde irareru gamanzuyosa wa, kodomo no toki ni yashinawareru mono kamoshirenai no da.
items.en: It isn't about grades: the perseverance to keep working at a task for a while, however difficult it is, may be something nurtured in childhood.
items.hi: बात अंकों की नहीं: काम चाहे कितना भी कठिन हो, उसमें कुछ समय तक जुटे रहने का धैर्य शायद बचपन में ही पनपता है।
items.gu: વાત ગુણની નથી: કામ ભલે ગમે તેટલું અઘરું હોય, તેમાં થોડો સમય લાગ્યા રહેવાની ધીરજ કદાચ બાળપણમાં જ ઘડાય છે.
items.why: "Regardless of how hard the task is, you keep at it" → 〜であろうと (A-6). 〜としたら would introduce a single supposition whose consequence must follow; here the clause just modifies 我慢強さ ("patience that holds even with hard tasks").
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 2課 · 条件を表す文

items.q: もっと早くから始めれば（ ）、10月にはもういい就職先はない。
items.qr: Motto hayaku kara hajimereba (___), juugatsu ni wa mou ii shuushokusaki wa nai.
items.en: If I'd started earlier there would have been chances, but by October there are no good employers left.
items.hi: अगर पहले शुरू करता तो मौक़े थे, पर अक्टूबर तक कोई अच्छी कंपनी बचती ही नहीं।
items.gu: જો વહેલું શરૂ કર્યું હોત તો તકો હતી, પણ ઑક્ટોબર સુધીમાં કોઈ સારી કંપની બચતી જ નથી.

opts.t: チャンスがあったものを
