items.why: He did not start early (活動を開始したのが遅かった) → counterfactual with the B ending 〜ものを (regret). a) states a real present fact, contradicting "there are no good jobs".
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 2課 · 条件を表す文

items.q: 面接で、「日本語が上手に（ ）接客業は無理だ。」と言われた。
items.qr: Mensetsu de, "Nihongo ga jouzu ni (___) sekkyakugyou wa muri da." to iwareta.
items.en: At an interview I was told: "If you can't speak Japanese well, customer service is out of the question."
items.hi: इंटरव्यू में कहा गया: "अगर तुम ठीक से जापानी नहीं बोल पाते, तो ग्राहक-सेवा का काम नामुमकिन है।"
items.gu: ઇન્ટરવ્યૂમાં કહેવાયું: "જો તમે બરાબર જાપાનીઝ ન બોલી શકો, તો ગ્રાહક-સેવાનું કામ અશક્ય છે."
items.why: 確定: the interviewer is judging his actual, weak Japanese → 〜ようでは + negative judgement (無理だ) (A-3). 〜としたら is a neutral supposition, not a criticism of a real shortcoming.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 2課 · 条件を表す文

items.q: 君たちはまだ時間がある。日本語能力試験にも（ ）。頑張ってください。
items.qr: Kimitachi wa mada jikan ga aru. Nihongo nouryoku shiken ni mo (___). Ganbatte kudasai.
items.en: You still have time. You'd better pass the JLPT too. Good luck.
items.hi: तुम्हारे पास अभी समय है। जापानी भाषा प्रवीणता परीक्षा भी पास कर लेना बेहतर है। मेहनत करो।
items.gu: તમારી પાસે હજી સમય છે. જાપાનીઝ ભાષા પ્રાવીણ્ય પરીક્ષા પણ પાસ કરી લેવી સારી. મહેનત કરો.
items.why: まだ時間がある and 頑張ってください address the juniors' future → advice 〜たほうがいい. 〜ばよかった is regret about a past that can't change — it would fit the writer, not the listeners.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 2課 · 条件を表す文

items.q: いかなる組織においても、最も重要な判断は人事である。（ ）、有能な人間が集まれば、あとは自然に良い方向へ流れて行く。
items.qr: Ikanaru soshiki ni oite mo, mottomo juuyou na handan wa jinji de aru. (___), yuunou na ningen ga atsumareba, ato wa shizen ni yoi houkou e nagarete iku.
items.en: In any organisation, the most important judgement is personnel. As long as personnel goes well and capable people gather, the rest naturally flows in a good direction.
items.hi: किसी भी संस्था में सबसे अहम फ़ैसला नियुक्ति का है। बस नियुक्तियाँ ठीक हों और योग्य लोग जुटें, तो बाक़ी अपने-आप अच्छी दिशा में चलता है।
items.gu: કોઈ પણ સંસ્થામાં સૌથી મહત્ત્વનો નિર્ણય નિમણૂકનો છે. બસ નિમણૂકો બરાબર થાય અને સક્ષમ લોકો ભેગા થાય, તો બાકીનું આપમેળે સારી દિશામાં ચાલે છે.

opts.en: as long as personnel goes well, and

opts.t: 人事がうまく行かないとしても
opts.r: jinji ga umaku ikanai to shite mo
opts.en: even if personnel doesn't go well

opts.t: 人事さえうまく行ったとしても
opts.r: jinji sae umaku itta to shite mo
opts.en: even if only personnel went well
opts.hi: भले केवल नियुक्ति ठीक हुई हो
opts.gu: ભલે ફક્ત નિમણૂક બરાબર થઈ હોય

items.why: The blank is linked to 〜集まれば and leads to a good result, so it must be a positive condition joined in 連用 form: 〜さえ〜ば pattern ("as long as… and…, then…") → 人事さえうまく行き. 2 is negative and contradicts the good outcome; 3 and 4 are concessive (〜としても = "even if"), which would need a contrary result.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 2課 · 条件を表す文

items.q: この二つを兼ね備えた人間が（ ）、その人に人事を一任するのが最もよい。
items.qr: Kono futatsu o kanesonaeta ningen ga (___), sono hito ni jinji o ichinin suru no ga mottomo yoi.
items.en: If there is someone who has both qualities, it's best to leave personnel entirely to that person.
items.hi: अगर कोई ऐसा व्यक्ति हो जिसमें ये दोनों गुण हों, तो नियुक्ति पूरी तरह उसी को सौंप देना सबसे अच्छा है।
items.gu: જો કોઈ એવી વ્યક્તિ હોય જેમાં આ બંને ગુણ હોય, તો નિમણૂક પૂરેપૂરી તેને જ સોંપી દેવી શ્રેષ્ઠ છે.

opts.en: once it turns out there was

items.why: 仮定 + the writer's recommendation (〜のが最もよい) → 〜ば is the standard condition for "if X, the best thing is Y". 〜と expresses a natural/automatic consequence and doesn't go well with a judgement like 最もよい; 3 and 4 are past-tense suppositions that don't match the general present-tense argument.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 2課 · 条件を表す文

items.q: この二つを備えた人間を探すのは、考えるほど容易でない。（ ）、民主主義花盛りの現今では、その人間に一任とはなりにくい。
items.qr: Kono futatsu o sonaeta ningen o sagasu no wa, kangaeru hodo youi de nai. (___), minshushugi hanazakari no genkon de wa, sono ningen ni ichinin to wa narinikui.
items.en: Finding someone with both is not as easy as you might think. And even if there were such a person, in today's age of flourishing democracy it is hard to leave everything to them.
items.hi: ये दोनों गुण रखने वाला व्यक्ति ढूँढना उतना आसान नहीं जितना लगता है। और अगर ऐसा व्यक्ति हो भी, तो लोकतंत्र के इस बोलबाले वाले दौर में सब कुछ उसी पर छोड़ना मुश्किल है।
items.gu: આ બંને ગુણ ધરાવતી વ્યક્તિ શોધવી એટલી સહેલી નથી જેટલી લાગે છે. અને જો આવી વ્યક્તિ હોય તોય, લોકશાહીના આ બોલબાલાવાળા યુગમાં બધું તેના પર છોડવું મુશ્કેલ છે.

opts.t: そもそもいないことには
opts.en: unless there is one in the first place
opts.hi: जब तक कोई हो ही नहीं
opts.gu: જ્યાં સુધી કોઈ હોય જ નહીં

items.why: The result (一任とはなりにくい) goes against what you'd expect from finding such a person, so a concessive "even if" is needed → たとえ〜としても (A-6 family). 1 sets up a supposition with an expected (not contrary) result. 2 contradicts the logic (no person → obviously no entrusting). 3 〜ないことには needs "unless X, Y can't happen", but the writer is adding an extra obstacle, not a precondition.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 2課 · 条件を表す文

items.q: そこで通常は、学問的業績の高い人とか政治能力の高い人、人格の高い人、派閥の長などが民主的会議の場で実権を（ ）。
items.qr: Soko de tsuujou wa, gakumonteki gyouseki no takai hito to ka seiji nouryoku no takai hito, jinkaku no takai hito, habatsu no chou nado ga minshuteki kaigi no ba de jikken o (___).
items.en: So usually it ends up that people with strong academic records, high political ability or fine character, or faction leaders, hold real power at democratic meetings.
items.hi: इसलिए आमतौर पर ऐसा होता है कि ऊँची अकादमिक उपलब्धि, राजनीतिक कौशल या अच्छे चरित्र वाले लोग, या गुटों के मुखिया, लोकतांत्रिक बैठकों में असली सत्ता अपने हाथ में ले लेते हैं।
items.gu: તેથી સામાન્ય રીતે એવું થાય છે કે ઊંચી શૈક્ષણિક સિદ્ધિ, રાજકીય કુશળતા કે સારા ચારિત્ર્યવાળા લોકો, કે જૂથોના વડા, લોકશાહી બેઠકોમાં અસલી સત્તા પોતાના હાથમાં લઈ લે છે.

opts.hi: हाथ में ले लेते हैं (ऐसा हो जाता है)
opts.gu: હાથમાં લઈ લે છે (એવું થઈ જાય છે)

items.why: そこで ("so, as a result") + 通常は describes what usually comes about as a consequence → 〜ことになる. The next sentence (ところが、このような人々が…資質を持っているとは限らない) presupposes these people do hold power, ruling out 2 and 4; 1 is about their wishes, not the outcome.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 2課 · 条件を表す文

items.q: 学問的業績が高いということは、細分化された現在の学問では、それだけ自らの専門への傾斜が強かったということは（ ）、すぐれた大局観を必ずしも意味しない。
items.qr: Gakumonteki gyouseki ga takai to iu koto wa, saibunka sareta genzai no gakumon de wa, sore dake mizukara no senmon e no keisha ga tsuyokatta to iu koto wa (___), sugureta taikyokukan o kanarazushimo imi shinai.
items.en: In today's highly specialised scholarship, high academic achievement may mean that someone leaned that much more heavily into their own speciality, but it does not necessarily mean excellent broad vision.
items.hi: आज की बेहद बँटी हुई विद्वत्ता में, ऊँची अकादमिक उपलब्धि का मतलब यह भले हो कि व्यक्ति अपनी विशेषज्ञता की ओर उतना ही ज़्यादा झुका रहा, पर इसका मतलब ज़रूरी नहीं कि उसकी दृष्टि व्यापक है।
items.gu: આજની અત્યંત વિભાજિત વિદ્વત્તામાં, ઊંચી શૈક્ષણિક સિદ્ધિનો અર્થ ભલે એ હોય કે વ્યક્તિ પોતાની વિશેષતા તરફ એટલી જ વધુ ઢળેલી રહી, પણ તેનો અર્થ જરૂરી નથી કે તેની દૃષ્ટિ વ્યાપક છે.

opts.en: even if it meant, it's useless

items.why: Contrast "A は意味しても、B は意味しない" — it may mean A, but not B. 〜ても is the plain concessive that pairs the two objects. 2 〜たところで (A-7) means "it's pointless even if…", which needs a futility conclusion. 3 and 4 deny the first meaning, but the writer accepts it (specialisation is exactly what high achievement implies).
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 2課 · 条件を表す文

items.q: 政権の交代は我々国民にとっても大きな問題だ。影響を（ ）人は少なくない。
items.qr: Seiken no koutai wa wareware kokumin ni totte mo ookina mondai da. Eikyou o (___) hito wa sukunaku nai.
items.en: A change of government is a big issue for us citizens too. Not a few people are affected by it.
items.hi: सरकार बदलना हम नागरिकों के लिए भी बड़ी बात है। इससे प्रभावित होने वाले लोग कम नहीं।
items.gu: સરકાર બદલાવી એ આપણા નાગરિકો માટે પણ મોટી વાત છે. તેનાથી અસર પામનારા લોકો ઓછા નથી.
items.why: The viewpoint is 我々国民 (A-1): influence comes from the change of government to the people, so the people are the subject of 受ける.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 3課 · 視点を動かさない手段-1

items.q: 新政権には政治的影響を（ ）責任をしっかり考えて政治を行ってほしい。
items.qr: Shin-seiken ni wa seijiteki eikyou o (___) sekinin o shikkari kangaete seiji o okonatte hoshii.
items.en: I want the new government to govern while thinking hard about its responsibility for the political influence it has exerted.
items.hi: मैं चाहता हूँ कि नई सरकार अपने डाले गए राजनीतिक असर की ज़िम्मेदारी गंभीरता से सोचकर शासन करे।
items.gu: હું ઇચ્છું છું કે નવી સરકાર પોતે કરેલી રાજકીય અસરની જવાબદારી ગંભીરતાથી વિચારીને શાસન કરે.
items.why: The subject of this clause is the new government (新政権には…てほしい). The government is the source of influence, and its responsibility is for the influence it gave.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 3課 · 視点を動かさない手段-1

items.q: （ ）困っていたら、友達が薬をくれた。
items.qr: (___) komatte itara, tomodachi ga kusuri o kureta.
items.en: When I was suffering from an upset stomach, a friend gave me some medicine.
items.hi: जब मैं पेट ख़राब होने से परेशान थी, तब एक सहेली ने मुझे दवा दी।
items.gu: જ્યારે હું પેટ બગડવાથી પરેશાન હતી, ત્યારે એક સખીએ મને દવા આપી.
items.why: B-1 慣用的表現: the fixed idiom is おなかを壊す (transitive). おなかが壊れる is not used, even though Hindi/Gujarati/English say it intransitively.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 3課 · 視点を動かさない手段-1

items.q: 「ありがとう。（ ）。」とお礼を言った。
items.qr: "Arigatou. (___)." to orei o itta.
items.en: "Thank you. That really helped," I said.
items.hi: "धन्यवाद। बहुत मदद हुई।" मैंने कहा।
items.gu: "આભાર. બહુ મદદ થઈ." મેં કહ્યું.

opts.en: that helped me / I was saved

items.why: The speaker (the one who received help) is the implied subject → intransitive 助かった ("I was helped"), from the speaker's side (A + B-2 result). 助けた would make the speaker the helper — the wrong way round.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 3課 · 視点を動かさない手段-1

items.q: （ ）いろいろな悩みを打ち明けている。大切な友達である。
items.qr: (___) iroiro na nayami o uchiakete iru. Taisetsu na tomodachi de aru.
items.en: I confide all kinds of worries to her. She is a precious friend.
items.hi: मैं उससे अपनी हर तरह की परेशानियाँ कहती हूँ। वह मेरी प्यारी दोस्त है।
items.gu: હું તેને મારી દરેક પ્રકારની ચિંતાઓ કહું છું. તે મારી વહાલી મિત્ર છે.
items.why: The viewpoint stays with the speaker, so the speaker is the (omitted) subject of 打ち明けている and the friend is the target → 彼女には. If the friend confided in the speaker, Japanese would add 〜てくる／〜てくれる (わたしに打ち明けてくれる), which is not here.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 3課 · 視点を動かさない手段-1

items.q: 雑誌『生活の友』の8月号にわたしの（ ）から原稿を書いてほしいという出版社の依頼で、原稿を書き始めた。
items.qr: Zasshi "Seikatsu no tomo" no hachigatsu-gou ni watashi no (___) kara genkou o kaite hoshii to iu shuppansha no irai de, genkou o kakihajimeta.
items.en: At the publisher's request — "we'll run your work in the August issue of 'Seikatsu no Tomo', so please write a manuscript" — I began writing.
items.hi: प्रकाशक के अनुरोध पर — "हम 'सेइकात्सु नो तोमो' पत्रिका के अगस्त अंक में आपकी रचना छापेंगे, इसलिए लेख लिखिए" — मैंने लिखना शुरू किया।
items.gu: પ્રકાશકની વિનંતી પર — "અમે 'સેઇકાત્સુ નો તોમો' સામયિકના ઑગસ્ટ અંકમાં તમારી કૃતિ છાપીશું, એટલે લેખ લખો" — મેં લખવાનું શરૂ કર્યું.
items.why: This clause is the publisher's request (〜てほしいという出版社の依頼), so its subject is the publisher, who deliberately runs the piece → 他動詞 載せる (B-1, the action that causes the change).
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 3課 · 視点を動かさない手段-1

items.q: 今日、（ ）という新聞広告を見たので、さっそく買ってきた。
items.qr: Kyou, (___) to iu shinbun koukoku o mita node, sassoku katte kita.
items.en: Today I saw a newspaper ad saying that August issue was out, so I went straight out and bought it.
items.hi: आज अख़बार में विज्ञापन देखा कि वह अगस्त अंक आ गया है, तो तुरंत जाकर ख़रीद लाया।
items.gu: આજે છાપામાં જાહેરાત જોઈ કે એ ઑગસ્ટ અંક આવી ગયો છે, તો તરત જઈને ખરીદી લાવ્યો.
items.why: From the writer's viewpoint, what matters is the result — the issue is out (B-2). 出した would bring the publisher in as an unmentioned agent and shift the viewpoint away from the writer.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 3課 · 視点を動かさない手段-1

items.q: 家事や育児は、夫婦の共同作業が望ましいということに（ ）、多くの場合、女性の負担の方が大きいのが現状だろう。
items.qr: Kaji ya ikuji wa, fuufu no kyoudou sagyou ga nozomashii to iu koto ni (___), ooku no baai, josei no futan no hou ga ookii no ga genjou darou.
items.en: It's accepted that housework and childcare should ideally be shared by the couple, but in most cases the reality is that women carry the bigger burden.
items.hi: माना तो यह जाता है कि घर का काम और बच्चों की देखभाल पति-पत्नी मिलकर करें, पर ज़्यादातर मामलों में असलियत यह है कि बोझ महिलाओं पर ज़्यादा है।
items.gu: માનવામાં તો એમ આવે છે કે ઘરકામ અને બાળઉછેર પતિ-પત્ની સાથે મળીને કરે, પણ મોટા ભાગે વાસ્તવિકતા એ છે કે ભાર સ્ત્રીઓ પર વધુ છે.
items.why: 〜ことになっている = "it is the accepted rule/norm" (自動詞 なる, B-2: a state, no agent). 〜ことにしている is a person's own habit or decision ("I make it a rule to…"), which needs a person as subject.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 3課 · 視点を動かさない手段-1

items.q: 特に（ ）時期は、社会とのつながりが薄くなってしまい、どうしても孤立感を持ちやすい。
items.qr: Toku ni (___) jiki wa, shakai to no tsunagari ga usuku natte shimai, doushite mo koritsukan o mochiyasui.
items.en: Especially in the period when you're raising small children, your ties with society weaken and you easily feel isolated.
items.hi: ख़ासकर जब छोटे बच्चों को पाल रहे हों, उस दौर में समाज से रिश्ता कमज़ोर पड़ जाता है और अकेलापन महसूस होना स्वाभाविक है।
items.gu: ખાસ કરીને જ્યારે નાનાં બાળકોને ઉછેરતાં હોઈએ, એ સમયગાળામાં સમાજ સાથેનો સંબંધ નબળો પડી જાય છે અને એકલતા અનુભવવી સ્વાભાવિક છે.

opts.t: 小さい子供が育っている
小さい子供を育てている

items.why: The viewpoint is the mother (わたしの場合); she is the one losing touch with society. Keep her as subject → 他動詞 育てる. 子供が育つ would switch the subject to the children.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 3課 · 視点を動かさない手段-1

items.q: 主婦たちの間で次第に（ ）。
items.qr: Shufutachi no aida de shidai ni (___).
items.en: It is gradually spreading among housewives.
items.hi: यह गृहिणियों के बीच धीरे-धीरे फैल रही है।
items.gu: તે ગૃહિણીઓમાં ધીમે ધીમે ફેલાઈ રહી છે.
items.why: The subject is the system itself (これは…システムである), and 次第に describes its natural change → 自動詞 広まる (B-2). No one is named as spreading it.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 3課 · 視点を動かさない手段-1

items.q: 仕事のゴールはもうすぐだ、頑張れとわたしは自分に（ ）。
items.qr: Shigoto no gooru wa mou sugu da, ganbare to watashi wa jibun ni (___).
items.en: "The goal is close — keep going," I told myself.
items.hi: "लक्ष्य बस क़रीब है — लगे रहो," मैंने ख़ुद को समझाया।
items.gu: "લક્ષ્ય હવે નજીક છે — લાગ્યા રહો," મેં પોતાને સમજાવ્યું.
items.why: わたしは…自分に: the speaker does the action to himself → active 言い聞かせる. The passive would need someone else as the doer (A-2).
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 3課 · 視点を動かさない手段-1

items.q: （ ）としたら、チームワークの結晶だと言いたい。
items.qr: (___) to shitara, chiimuwaaku no kesshou da to iitai.
items.en: If our research results win a prize, I'd like to say it's the fruit of teamwork.
items.hi: अगर हमारे शोध के नतीजों को पुरस्कार मिले, तो मैं कहना चाहूँगा कि यह टीमवर्क का फल है।
items.gu: જો અમારા સંશોધનનાં પરિણામોને પુરસ્કાર મળે, તો હું કહેવા માગીશ કે આ ટીમવર્કનું ફળ છે.

opts.t: 研究成果が賞を受ける
opts.r: kenkyuu seika ga shou o ukeru

opts.t: 研究成果に賞を与える
opts.r: kenkyuu seika ni shou o ataeru

items.why: A-1: keep the viewpoint on the speaker's side — "our" results are the receiver → 受ける. 与える would make the (unmentioned) prize committee the subject and shift the viewpoint away.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 3課 · 視点を動かさない手段-1

items.q: いまから17年ぐらい前に、ユネスコ・アジア文化センター（ACCU）から、「識字教育のための（ ）のですが、やってくれませんか」という話がきました。
items.qr: Ima kara juunana-nen gurai mae ni, Yunesuko Ajia Bunka Sentaa (ACCU) kara, "Shikiji kyouiku no tame no (___) no desu ga, yatte kuremasen ka" to iu hanashi ga kimashita.
items.en: About 17 years ago, ACCU approached me: "We'd like to make an animation for literacy education — would you do it for us?"
items.hi: लगभग 17 साल पहले ACCU से प्रस्ताव आया: "हम साक्षरता शिक्षा के लिए एक एनिमेशन बनाना चाहते हैं, क्या आप यह करेंगे?"
items.gu: આશરે 17 વર્ષ પહેલાં ACCU તરફથી પ્રસ્તાવ આવ્યો: "અમે સાક્ષરતા શિક્ષણ માટે એક ઍનિમેશન બનાવવા માગીએ છીએ, શું તમે આ કરશો?"
items.why: Inside the quote the speaker is ACCU, and 〜のですが、やってくれませんか is the standard "state your wish, then ask" pattern → アニメを作りたい (ACCU's own wish, from ACCU's viewpoint). 1 has no agent and no wish; 3 is odd because the request comes next anyway (やってくれませんか); 4 puts ACCU on the receiving end, the wrong direction.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 3課 · 視点を動かさない手段-1

items.q: ACCUは、アジア地域において、有形・無形文化遺産の保護や、平和や教育の（ ）活動をしていて、…
items.qr: ACCU wa, Ajia chiiki ni oite, yuukei・mukei bunka isan no hogo ya, heiwa ya kyouiku no (___) katsudou o shite ite, ...
items.en: In the Asian region, ACCU carries out activities to protect tangible and intangible cultural heritage and to spread awareness of the importance of peace and education…
items.hi: एशिया क्षेत्र में ACCU मूर्त और अमूर्त सांस्कृतिक धरोहर की रक्षा, और शांति व शिक्षा के महत्व को फैलाने का काम करता है…
items.gu: એશિયા ક્ષેત્રમાં ACCU મૂર્ત અને અમૂર્ત સાંસ્કૃતિક વારસાના રક્ષણનું, અને શાંતિ તથા શિક્ષણનું મહત્ત્વ ફેલાવવાનું કામ કરે છે…

opts.t: 大切さが広まっている

items.why: An 活動 (activity) is something ACCU deliberately does, parallel to 保護 (protection) → 他動詞 広める with ACCU as the implied subject (B-1). The 自動詞 and passive options (2–4) describe what happens to "importance", which can't describe an organisation's activity.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 3課 · 視点を動かさない手段-1

items.q: …特に識字に（ ）。それは、アジア地域に6億もの字が読めない人がいて、その中の3分の2は女性だったからです。
items.qr: ...toku ni shikiji ni (___). Sore wa, Ajia chiiki ni rokuoku mo no ji ga yomenai hito ga ite, sono naka no sanbun no ni wa josei datta kara desu.
items.en: …and it was putting particular effort into literacy. That was because there were as many as 600 million people in Asia who couldn't read, two-thirds of them women.
items.hi: …और ख़ास तौर पर साक्षरता पर ज़ोर दे रहा था। क्योंकि एशिया में 60 करोड़ लोग पढ़ नहीं सकते थे, जिनमें दो-तिहाई महिलाएँ थीं।
items.gu: …અને ખાસ કરીને સાક્ષરતા પર ભાર આપતું હતું. કારણ કે એશિયામાં 60 કરોડ લોકો વાંચી શકતા નહોતા, જેમાંથી બે-તૃતીયાંશ સ્ત્રીઓ હતી.

opts.t: 力が入れてありました

items.why: Same subject as before (ACCU は…活動をしていて), so keep it: ACCU deliberately focused → 他動詞 力を入れる; ていました matches the ongoing past state explained by the following から sentence. 1 and 2 are 自動詞 with no agent (力が入る usually means "tense up / get excited"); 4 〜てある describes a prepared state of an object, not an organisation's policy.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 3課 · 視点を動かさない手段-1

items.q: ぼくはこのような活動をきっかけにして、アニメーションが世界に（ ）のもいいんじゃないかな、と思ったので、その仕事をお引き受けすることにしました。
items.qr: Boku wa kono you na katsudou o kikkake ni shite, animeeshon ga sekai ni (___) no mo ii n ja nai ka na, to omotta node, sono shigoto o ohikiuke suru koto ni shimashita.
items.en: I thought it might be nice if, through such activities, animation spread out into the world, so I decided to accept the job.
items.hi: मैंने सोचा कि ऐसे कामों के ज़रिए अगर एनिमेशन दुनिया भर में फैलता जाए तो अच्छा होगा, इसलिए मैंने वह काम स्वीकार कर लिया।
items.gu: મેં વિચાર્યું કે આવાં કામો દ્વારા જો ઍનિમેશન દુનિયાભરમાં ફેલાતું જાય તો સારું, એટલે મેં એ કામ સ્વીકારી લીધું.
items.why: アニメーションが is the subject (が) → 自動詞 広がる. The movement is away from the speaker (Japan) out into the world → 〜ていく (preview of 4課). 3 〜てくる would mean spreading toward the speaker; 1 and 2 are 他動詞 and clash with が.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 3課 · 視点を動かさない手段-1

items.q: アニメと関係のなさそうな一般の人たちのために、日本が得意とするアニメで（ ）のなら、こんなうれしいことはないと思いました。
items.qr: Anime to kankei no nasasou na ippan no hitotachi no tame ni, Nihon ga tokui to suru anime de (___) no nara, konna ureshii koto wa nai to omoimashita.
items.en: I thought nothing could make me happier than being of use, through anime — something Japan excels at — to ordinary people who seem to have nothing to do with anime.
items.hi: मैंने सोचा कि जिन आम लोगों का एनिमेशन से कोई लेना-देना नहीं लगता, उनके लिए जापान की ख़ूबी — एनिमेशन — से अगर मैं काम आ सकूँ, तो इससे बड़ी ख़ुशी नहीं।
items.gu: મેં વિચાર્યું કે જે સામાન્ય લોકોને ઍનિમેશન સાથે કોઈ લેવાદેવા નથી લાગતી, તેમના માટે જાપાનની ખૂબી — ઍનિમેશન — થી જો હું કામ આવી શકું, તો તેનાથી મોટી ખુશી નથી.
items.why: Fixed expression 役に立つ (自動詞, "be useful"), in plain dictionary form because it is a hoped-for, not-yet-realised event in a 〜のなら condition (the speaker is deciding whether to accept). 3 and 4 describe something already happening, which contradicts the hypothetical のなら; 2 is not a natural form of this idiom.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 3課 · 視点を動かさない手段-1

items.q: 遠くに明かりが見えたので、足を引きずって（ ）民家だった。
items.qr: Tooku ni akari ga mieta node, ashi o hikizutte (___) minka datta.
items.en: I saw a light in the distance, and when I dragged my leg over there, it turned out to be a farmhouse.
items.hi: दूर एक रोशनी दिखी, तो पैर घसीटते हुए वहाँ गया — वह एक घर था।
items.gu: દૂર એક પ્રકાશ દેખાયો, તો પગ ઘસડતાં ત્યાં ગયો — તે એક ઘર હતું.
items.why: The viewpoint is where the speaker was when he saw the light (far away); he moves away from that spot toward the light → 〜ていく. The discovery (民家だった) is made on arrival, seen from the starting point.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 4課 · 〜てくる・〜ていく

items.q: 辺りは暗かったが、この山小屋までやっとの思いで歩いて（ ）。今日はここに泊めてもらうことにした。
items.qr: Atari wa kurakatta ga, kono yamagoya made yatto no omoi de aruite (___). Kyou wa koko ni tomete morau koto ni shita.
items.en: It was dark all around, but I managed with great effort to walk to this mountain hut. I've decided to stay here tonight.
items.hi: चारों ओर अँधेरा था, पर बड़ी मुश्किल से चलकर इस पहाड़ी झोंपड़ी तक आ पहुँचा। आज यहीं रुकने का तय किया।
items.gu: ચારે બાજુ અંધારું હતું, પણ માંડ માંડ ચાલીને આ પહાડી ઝૂંપડી સુધી આવી પહોંચ્યો. આજે અહીં જ રોકાવાનું નક્કી કર્યું.
items.why: この山小屋 and ここ show the speaker is now at the hut, so the walk ends at the speaker's position → 〜てきた.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 4課 · 〜てくる・〜ていく

items.q: ベルトコンベアで部品が運ばれて（ ）。わたしのアルバイトはこの部品を箱に詰める仕事だ。
items.qr: Beruto konbea de buhin ga hakobarete (___). Watashi no arubaito wa kono buhin o hako ni tsumeru shigoto da.
items.en: Parts come along to me on the conveyor belt. My part-time job is packing these parts into boxes.
items.hi: कन्वेयर बेल्ट पर पुर्ज़े मेरी ओर आते हैं। मेरा पार्ट-टाइम काम इन पुर्ज़ों को डिब्बों में भरना है।
items.gu: કન્વેયર બેલ્ટ પર ભાગો મારી તરફ આવે છે. મારું પાર્ટ-ટાઇમ કામ આ ભાગોને ખોખામાં ભરવાનું છે.
items.why: The speaker packs these parts, so they arrive at the speaker's station → 〜てくる.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 4課 · 〜てくる・〜ていく

items.q: 工場ででき上がった商品は、出荷のためにベルトコンベアで運ばれて（ ）。これからあの電気製品は、日本から遠く離れた国の人たちにも使われるのだ。
items.qr: Koujou de dekiagatta shouhin wa, shukka no tame ni beruto konbea de hakobarete (___). Kore kara ano denki seihin wa, Nihon kara tooku hanareta kuni no hitotachi ni mo tsukawareru no da.
items.en: The finished products were carried off on the conveyor belt for shipping. From now on those appliances will be used by people in countries far from Japan.
items.hi: फ़ैक्टरी में बने सामान को भेजने के लिए कन्वेयर बेल्ट पर ले जाया गया। अब वे बिजली के उपकरण जापान से दूर के देशों के लोग भी इस्तेमाल करेंगे।
items.gu: ફૅક્ટરીમાં બનેલા માલને રવાના કરવા કન્વેયર બેલ્ટ પર લઈ જવાયો. હવે એ વીજ ઉપકરણો જાપાનથી દૂરના દેશોના લોકો પણ વાપરશે.
items.why: The goods leave the speaker's place for far-off countries (あの電気製品 — "those", now distant) → 〜ていく.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 4課 · 〜てくる・〜ていく

items.q: 食事に出かけたと伝えているちょうどそのとき、本人が帰って（ ）。
items.qr: Shokuji ni dekaketa to tsutaete iru choudo sono toki, honnin ga kaette (___).
items.en: Just as I was telling the caller he'd gone out to eat, Tanaka himself came back.
items.hi: ठीक जब मैं बता रहा था कि वे खाना खाने गए हैं, उसी समय तनाका जी ख़ुद लौट आए।
items.gu: બરાબર જ્યારે હું કહી રહ્યો હતો કે તેઓ જમવા ગયા છે, એ જ વખતે તનાકાજી પોતે પાછા આવ્યા.
items.why: Tanaka returns to the office where the speaker is → 帰ってきた.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 4課 · 〜てくる・〜ていく

items.q: ちょうど事務所を出て（ ）ばかりだったので、伝言を聞いておいた。
items.qr: Choudo jimusho o dete (___) bakari datta node, dengon o kiite oita.
items.en: He had only just left the office, so I took a message.
items.hi: वे अभी-अभी दफ़्तर से निकले थे, इसलिए मैंने संदेश ले लिया।
items.gu: તેઓ હમણાં જ ઑફિસમાંથી નીકળ્યા હતા, એટલે મેં સંદેશો લઈ લીધો.
items.why: The speaker stays in the office; Tanaka moves away from it → 出ていった.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 4課 · 〜てくる・〜ていく

items.q: 一緒にお茶を飲みながら、近況や、見て（ ）土器のことを話した。
items.qr: Issho ni ocha o nominagara, kinkyou ya, mite (___) doki no koto o hanashita.
items.en: Over tea we talked about how we'd been and about the earthenware we had just seen.
items.hi: साथ चाय पीते हुए हमने हाल-चाल और अभी देखे मिट्टी के बर्तनों के बारे में बातें कीं।
items.gu: સાથે ચા પીતાં અમે ખબરઅંતર અને હમણાં જોયેલાં માટીનાં વાસણો વિશે વાતો કરી.
items.why: 見てくる = "go and see, then come back" — the speaker is now back (at the café). The seeing is completed up to the speaker's present position/time → 〜てきた.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 4課 · 〜てくる・〜ていく

items.q: 博物館の入り口のところに「歴史的に古いものから順番に土器が並べられていますから、順番に見て（ ）、自然に出口に出ます。」と書いてあった。
items.qr: Hakubutsukan no iriguchi no tokoro ni "Rekishiteki ni furui mono kara junban ni doki ga naraberarete imasu kara, junban ni mite (___), shizen ni deguchi ni demasu." to kaite atta.
items.en: At the museum entrance a sign said: "The earthenware is arranged from oldest onward, so if you go along looking in order, you will naturally arrive at the exit."
items.hi: संग्रहालय के प्रवेश पर लिखा था: "मिट्टी के बर्तन सबसे पुराने से क्रम में रखे हैं, इसलिए क्रम से देखते चलेंगे तो अपने-आप बाहर निकलने के रास्ते पर पहुँच जाएँगे।"
items.gu: સંગ્રહાલયના પ્રવેશદ્વારે લખ્યું હતું: "માટીનાં વાસણો સૌથી જૂનાંથી ક્રમમાં ગોઠવ્યાં છે, એટલે ક્રમથી જોતાં જશો તો આપોઆપ બહાર નીકળવાના રસ્તે પહોંચી જશો."
items.why: The sign stands at the entrance; visitors move away from it, onward through the rooms to the exit → 〜ていけば (progress away from the starting point).
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 4課 · 〜てくる・〜ていく

items.q: 昨年、昔住んでいた家を訪ねてみた。懐かしい家に近づいて（ ）、昔のままの空気が感じられた。
items.qr: Sakunen, mukashi sunde ita ie o tazunete mita. Natsukashii ie ni chikazuite (___), mukashi no mama no kuuki ga kanjirareta.
items.en: Last year I visited the house where I used to live. As I approached that dear old house, I could feel the same air as before.
items.hi: पिछले साल मैं उस घर गई जहाँ पहले रहती थी। उस प्यारे पुराने घर के पास जाते हुए, पहले जैसा ही माहौल महसूस हुआ।
items.gu: ગયા વર્ષે હું એ ઘરે ગઈ જ્યાં પહેલાં રહેતી હતી. એ વહાલા જૂના ઘરની નજીક જતાં, પહેલાં જેવું જ વાતાવરણ અનુભવાયું.
items.why: B-2 視点の移動: now the narrator is the adult visitor walking up to the house, so she moves away from her own position toward it → 近づいていく. Contrast ①–③, where the old house itself was "home".
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 4課 · 〜てくる・〜ていく

items.q: 昔から日本人は山からの恵みを得て（ ）。
items.qr: Mukashi kara Nihonjin wa yama kara no megumi o ete (___).
items.en: Since long ago, the Japanese have lived on the bounty of the mountains.
items.hi: पुराने समय से जापानी लोग पहाड़ों की देन के सहारे जीते आए हैं।
items.gu: જૂના સમયથી જાપાની લોકો પહાડોની દેણના આધારે જીવતા આવ્યા છે.
items.why: 昔から ("from long ago") + the writer's present = a continuation from the past up to now → 〜てきた (time use of くる). 2 looks forward from now, contradicting 昔から; 4 would place the starting point in the past and move away from it; 1 (dictionary form) can't express a completed span up to now.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 4課 · 〜てくる・〜ていく

items.q: こんなに多くの森林があるのに、林業をする人や山村に（ ）人が減って、森林の手入れが行き届かなくなっている。
items.qr: Konna ni ooku no shinrin ga aru noni, ringyou o suru hito ya sanson ni (___) hito ga hette, shinrin no teire ga ikitodokanaku natte iru.
items.en: Despite so much forest, the number of people working in forestry or living in mountain villages has fallen, and forests are no longer properly looked after.
items.hi: इतने सारे जंगल होने के बावजूद, वन-कार्य करने वाले और पहाड़ी गाँवों में रहने वाले लोग घट गए हैं, और जंगलों की देखभाल ठीक से नहीं हो पा रही।
items.gu: આટલાં બધાં જંગલો હોવા છતાં, વનકાર્ય કરનારા અને પહાડી ગામોમાં રહેનારા લોકો ઘટી ગયા છે, અને જંગલોની સંભાળ બરાબર થતી નથી.
items.why: A plain category of people, parallel to 林業をする人 (dictionary form) → 住む人 (see 1課 D-2: no specific time point → present). The sentence isn't about direction or change, so ていく／てくる add a meaning that isn't there; 住んでいた would mean former residents, but the point is that today's residents are few.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 4課 · 〜てくる・〜ていく

items.q: 森林の手入れとは、木の下に（ ）草を取ったり、…植え方を調節することである。
items.qr: Shinrin no teire to wa, ki no shita ni (___) kusa o tottari, ... uekata o chousetsu suru koto de aru.
items.en: Looking after a forest means removing the weeds that keep growing under the trees and adjusting how the trees are planted…
items.hi: जंगल की देखभाल का मतलब है पेड़ों के नीचे उगते आने वाले घास-फूस को हटाना और पेड़ों के लगाने के तरीक़े को ठीक करना…
items.gu: જંગલની સંભાળ એટલે ઝાડ નીચે ઊગતું આવતું ઘાસ દૂર કરવું અને ઝાડ રોપવાની રીત ગોઠવવી…
items.why: 〜てくる for something appearing into the observer's view or world (生えてくる・出てくる): weeds keep coming up and must be removed. This is a general definition, so past forms 3 and 4 don't fit; 生えていく describes continued growth away from a starting point, not the emergence that 手入れ responds to.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 4課 · 〜てくる・〜ていく

items.q: また、最近ではもともと日本にはない、外国から（ ）植物によって、森林のバランスが崩れてきている。
items.qr: Mata, saikin de wa motomoto Nihon ni wa nai, gaikoku kara (___) shokubutsu ni yotte, shinrin no baransu ga kuzurete kite iru.
items.en: Also, recently, plants that came in from abroad, not originally found in Japan, have been upsetting the balance of the forests.
items.hi: साथ ही, हाल में जापान में मूल रूप से न पाए जाने वाले, विदेश से आए पौधों के कारण जंगलों का संतुलन बिगड़ता जा रहा है।
items.gu: ઉપરાંત, તાજેતરમાં જાપાનમાં મૂળ ન મળતા, વિદેશથી આવેલા છોડને કારણે જંગલોનું સંતુલન બગડતું જાય છે.
items.why: The writer's psychological position is Japan (B-1). 外国から ("from abroad") + movement into Japan → 入ってきた. 出る would need "out of" a place; 入っていった would mean going in somewhere away from the writer.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 4課 · 〜てくる・〜ていく

items.q: どうすれば豊かで元気な森林を（ ）ことができるか、民間レベルでも真剣に考えるべきときが来ていると思う。
items.qr: Dou sureba yutaka de genki na shinrin o (___) koto ga dekiru ka, minkan reberu demo shinken ni kangaeru beki toki ga kite iru to omou.
items.en: I think the time has come when we, at the citizens' level too, should seriously consider how we can go on protecting rich, healthy forests.
items.hi: मुझे लगता है कि अब समय आ गया है जब आम नागरिकों के स्तर पर भी गंभीरता से सोचना चाहिए कि समृद्ध और स्वस्थ जंगलों की रक्षा आगे कैसे करते रहें।
items.gu: મને લાગે છે કે હવે સમય આવી ગયો છે જ્યારે સામાન્ય નાગરિકોના સ્તરે પણ ગંભીરતાથી વિચારવું જોઈએ કે સમૃદ્ધ અને તંદુરસ્ત જંગલોનું રક્ષણ આગળ કેવી રીતે કરતા રહીએ.
items.why: どうすれば…ことができるか looks to the future from now → continuing an action from the present onward → 〜ていく. 4 is past; 3 is just a present state; 〜てくる (1) would look back toward now, which can't follow どうすれば.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 4課 · 〜てくる・〜ていく

items.q: 静かに（ ）子どものじぶんは、押し入れの中で、うらみがましい目で、大人のじぶんを見ているかもしれない。
items.qr: Shizuka ni (___) kodomo no jibun wa, oshiire no naka de, uramigamashii me de, otona no jibun o mite iru kamoshirenai.
items.en: The child-self that was made to keep quiet may be watching the adult-self with resentful eyes from inside the closet.
items.hi: चुप कराया गया बचपन वाला "मैं" शायद अलमारी के अंदर से शिकायत भरी नज़रों से बड़े "मैं" को देख रहा हो।
items.gu: ચૂપ કરાવાયેલું બાળપણનું "હું" કદાચ કબાટની અંદરથી ફરિયાદભરી નજરે મોટા "હું"ને જોઈ રહ્યું હોય.
items.why: The sentence before says the adult made the child-self quiet (子どものじぶんを静かにさせて). Now 子どものじぶん is the subject, so the same event seen from its side is the causative-passive (C-1) 静かにさせられた. 1/2 would mean it chose to be quiet by itself; 3 静かにされた is the passive of 静かにする, not of 静かにさせる, so it doesn't match the previous sentence.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 5課 · 受身・使役・使役受身

items.q: 押し入れに（ ）、さるぐつわをかまされて［3］、そいつは生きて足をばたばたさせている。
items.qr: Oshiire ni (___), sarugutsuwa o kamasarete [3], soitsu wa ikite ashi o batabata sasete iru.
items.en: Even if it is shut up in the closet, even if it is gagged and silenced, that fellow is alive, kicking its legs.
items.hi: भले उसे अलमारी में बंद कर दिया जाए, भले मुँह बाँधकर चुप करा दिया जाए, वह बंदा ज़िंदा है और पैर पटक रहा है।
items.gu: ભલે તેને કબાટમાં પૂરી દેવાય, ભલે મોં બાંધીને ચૂપ કરાવી દેવાય, એ જણ જીવતું છે અને પગ પછાડે છે.

opts.en: even if it shuts itself in
opts.hi: भले ख़ुद को बंद कर ले

opts.en: even if it is shut in
even if (someone) shuts themselves in on you
opts.hi: भले कोई (तुम पर) ख़ुद को बंद कर ले
opts.gu: ભલે કોઈ (તારા પર) પોતાને પૂરી રાખે

items.why: The subject is そいつ (the child-self), and the parallel clause さるぐつわをかまされて is passive — it is a victim of the adult's action. Transitive 閉じこめる ("lock someone in") → passive 閉じこめられる (A-1). 1 makes it the jailer; 2 閉じこもる means it hid away voluntarily, which contradicts being gagged; 4 is a suffering passive of an intransitive verb, told from a third person's viewpoint.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 5課 · 受身・使役・使役受身

items.q: 押し入れに［2］、さるぐつわをかまされて（ ）、そいつは生きて足をばたばたさせている。
items.qr: Oshiire ni [2], sarugutsuwa o kamasarete (___), soitsu wa ikite ashi o batabata sasete iru.
items.en: (Same sentence.) Gagged and forced into silence, it is still alive, kicking its legs.
items.hi: (वही वाक्य) मुँह बाँधकर ज़बरदस्ती चुप करा दिए जाने पर भी, वह ज़िंदा है और पैर पटक रहा है।
items.gu: (એ જ વાક્ય) મોં બાંધીને પરાણે ચૂપ કરાવી દેવાયા છતાં, તે જીવતું છે અને પગ પછાડે છે.

opts.en: even if (someone) goes silent on you
opts.hi: भले कोई (तुम पर) चुप्पी साध ले
opts.gu: ભલે કોઈ (તારા પર) ચૂપ થઈ જાય

opts.en: even if it is forced to be silent
opts.hi: भले ज़बरदस्ती चुप करा दिया जाए

items.why: Still the child-self's viewpoint, and the gag is someone else's doing: it is made silent → causative-passive (C-1) 黙らされる (short form of 黙らせられる), matching ［1］ 静かにさせられた. 1 is voluntary silence; 2 makes it the one silencing; 3 is a suffering passive ("someone fell silent on me").
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 5課 · 受身・使役・使役受身

items.q: 理屈の得意なおじさんは、口を（ ）大声を出して笑われているやつだったり、気取った女性は、見栄っ張りのおませさんだったり……
items.qr: Rikutsu no tokui na ojisan wa, kuchi o (___) oogoe o dashite warawarete iru yatsu dattari, kidotta josei wa, miepari no omase-san dattari……
items.en: The uncle who loves to argue turns out to be the kid who pouts, shouts and gets laughed at; the affected woman, a vain little know-it-all…
items.hi: बहस में माहिर अंकल असल में वह बच्चा निकलता है जो मुँह फुलाकर ज़ोर से चिल्लाता है और जिस पर सब हँसते हैं; बनावटी महिला, दिखावा करने वाली नकचढ़ी लड़की……
items.gu: દલીલમાં પાવરધા કાકા ખરેખર એ છોકરો નીકળે છે જે મોં ફુલાવીને જોરથી બૂમો પાડે છે અને જેના પર સૌ હસે છે; દેખાડો કરતી સ્ત્રી, વટ મારતી નખરાળી છોકરી……
items.why: B-5 他動詞化: 尖る is intransitive and has no transitive partner, so with the object 口を you need the causative 口を尖らせる ("pout"). 1 can't take 口を; 3 and 4 make no sense — nobody else is involved in pouting.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 5課 · 受身・使役・使役受身

items.q: ……なんか中学生の姿で（ ）んです。
items.qr: ……nanka chuugakusei no sugata de (___) n desu.
items.en: …somehow they start to appear to me in the form of junior-high kids.
items.hi: ……न जाने क्यों वे मुझे मिडिल-स्कूल के बच्चों के रूप में दिखने लगते हैं।
items.gu: ……કોણ જાણે કેમ તેઓ મને માધ્યમિક શાળાનાં બાળકોના રૂપમાં દેખાવા લાગે છે.
items.why: The viewpoint is ぼく, and the change happens as he imagines them in the classroom: a picture gradually coming to the speaker → 〜てくる (第3部 4課). 1 is a static state with no sense of change; 2 moves away from the speaker; 4 is the volitional "go and look", but the adults are the ones who appear, not something ぼく does.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 5課 · 受身・使役・使役受身

items.q: 隣の市の人たちも手伝って（ ）。
items.qr: Tonari no shi no hitotachi mo tetsudatte (___).
items.en: People from the neighbouring city helped us too.
items.hi: पड़ोसी शहर के लोगों ने भी (हमारी) मदद की।
items.gu: પડોશી શહેરના લોકોએ પણ (અમને) મદદ કરી.
items.why: The subject is 隣の市の人たち (outsiders) and the benefit comes to "our" city → 〜てくれた. もらった would need our side as the subject (隣の市の人たちに手伝ってもらった); あげた sends the favour away from us.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 6課 · てあげる・てもらう・てくれる

items.q: しかし、だれも気がつかず、席を譲って（ ）。
items.qr: Shikashi, dare mo ki ga tsukazu, seki o yuzutte (___).
items.en: But nobody noticed, and nobody gave up a seat for her.
items.hi: लेकिन किसी का ध्यान नहीं गया, और किसी ने (उसे) सीट नहीं दी।
items.gu: પણ કોઈનું ધ્યાન ન ગયું, અને કોઈએ (તેને) સીટ ન આપી.
items.why: A (viewpoint): the friend is on "my side" compared with strangers; the subject だれも (strangers) gives → くれなかった, which also carries the writer's disappointment. あげなかった would treat the strangers as "my side"; もらわなかった needs the friend as subject.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 6課 · てあげる・てもらう・てくれる

items.q: 図書館から借りた本は期日までには必ず（ ）いけません。
items.qr: Toshokan kara karita hon wa kijitsu made ni wa kanarazu (___) ikemasen.
items.en: Books borrowed from the library must be returned by the due date.
items.hi: पुस्तकालय से ली गई किताबें नियत तारीख़ तक ज़रूर लौटानी चाहिए।
items.gu: પુસ્તકાલયમાંથી લીધેલાં પુસ્તકો નિયત તારીખ સુધીમાં જરૂર પાછાં આપવાં જોઈએ.

opts.t: 返してもらわなければ

items.why: B-1: a rule stated neutrally — returning a book is an obligation, not a favour → plain 返さなければ. あげる would sound as if you're doing the library a kindness; もらう means having someone else return it.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 6課 · てあげる・てもらう・てくれる

items.q: 会社側は従業員の給料を（ ）ということになった。
items.qr: Kaisha-gawa wa juugyouin no kyuuryou o (___) to iu koto ni natta.
items.en: The company decided to raise employees' wages.
items.hi: कंपनी की ओर से कर्मचारियों का वेतन बढ़ाने का तय हुआ।
items.gu: કંપની તરફથી કર્મચારીઓનો પગાર વધારવાનું નક્કી થયું.
items.why: B-1: a news-like report of a board decision → neutral アップしよう. あげよう sounds patronising (恩着せがましい); もらおう would mean the company gets someone else to do it.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 6課 · てあげる・てもらう・てくれる

items.q: 人がいなくても自動で庭の掃除をして（ ）掃除ロボットがほしい。
items.qr: Hito ga inakute mo jidou de niwa no souji o shite (___) souji robotto ga hoshii.
items.en: I want a cleaning robot that will clean the garden for me automatically, even when nobody's there.
items.hi: मुझे ऐसा सफ़ाई रोबोट चाहिए जो कोई न हो तब भी अपने-आप मेरे लिए बगीचा साफ़ कर दे।
items.gu: મારે એવો સફાઈ રોબોટ જોઈએ છે જે કોઈ ન હોય તોય આપમેળે મારા માટે બગીચો સાફ કરી આપે.

opts.hi: किसी और के लिए साफ़ करे

items.why: The robot (the doer) modifies ロボット, and the benefit comes to me → 〜てくれる. In a relative clause the doer is the subject, so もらう (receiver as subject) doesn't fit.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 6課 · てあげる・てもらう・てくれる

items.q: そのちらしを持っていけば20%割引して（ ）ようだ。
items.qr: Sono chirashi o motte ikeba nijuu-paasento waribiki shite (___) you da.
items.en: It seems that if you take the flyer along, you can get 20% off.
items.hi: लगता है वह पर्चा ले जाने पर 20% छूट मिल जाती है।
items.gu: લાગે છે કે એ પત્રિકા લઈ જઈએ તો 20% છૂટ મળે છે.
items.why: B-2: this is a state ("you're in a position to receive"), not an act of asking → 〜てもらえる (= 割引してくれる). もらう is an action you request.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 6課 · てあげる・てもらう・てくれる

items.q: 患者さん本人によく説明し、この病気の原因や治療法をよくわかって（ ）上で、今後の治療方針を決めていきたい。
items.qr: Kanja-san honnin ni yoku setsumei shi, kono byouki no gen'in ya chiryouhou o yoku wakatte (___) ue de, kongo no chiryou houshin o kimete ikitai.
items.en: I want to explain things carefully to the patient and, once they fully understand the cause and treatment, decide on the treatment plan.
items.hi: मैं मरीज़ को अच्छी तरह समझाकर, जब वे बीमारी का कारण और इलाज ठीक से समझ लें, उसके बाद आगे का इलाज तय करना चाहता हूँ।
items.gu: હું દર્દીને સારી રીતે સમજાવીને, તેઓ બીમારીનું કારણ અને સારવાર બરાબર સમજી લે, પછી આગળની સારવાર નક્કી કરવા માગું છું.
items.why: The doctor (speaker) is the subject throughout (説明し…決めていきたい). Having the patient understand is something the doctor seeks → 患者に…わかってもらった上で. くれた would switch the subject to the patient mid-sentence.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 6課 · てあげる・てもらう・てくれる

items.q: 川田さんに頼めばきっとやって（ ）。
items.qr: Kawada-san ni tanomeba kitto yatte (___).
items.en: If you ask Mr Kawada, I'm sure he'll do it for you.
items.hi: कावादा जी से कहोगे तो वे ज़रूर कर देंगे।
items.gu: કાવાદાને કહેશો તો તેઓ જરૂર કરી આપશે.
items.why: The implied subject of やって is 川田さん (the one asked) and the benefit goes to the listener's side → くれるだろう. もらう would need the asker as subject; with 頼めば it would be redundant ("if you ask, you'll get him to"). あげる is the wrong direction.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 6課 · てあげる・てもらう・てくれる

items.q: 津波の怖さを知って（ ）、自分の体験談を話すつもりだ。
items.qr: Tsunami no kowasa o shitte (___), jibun no taikendan o hanasu tsumori da.
items.en: I intend to tell my own experience so that people learn how frightening tsunamis are.
items.hi: लोगों को सुनामी का डर समझाने के लिए मैं अपना अनुभव सुनाने वाला हूँ।
items.gu: લોકોને સુનામીનો ડર સમજાવવા માટે હું મારો અનુભવ કહેવાનો છું.

opts.en: in order to know (as a favour to them)

items.why: The speaker wants others to learn something → 〜てもらう with the speaker as subject. ために needs a volitional verb, so the potential もらえる can't go before it (you'd need もらえるように). あげる would mean the speaker learns.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 6課 · てあげる・てもらう・てくれる

items.q: 山中さんが怒るのももっともだけど、高橋君の気持ちも（ ）。
items.qr: Yamanaka-san ga okoru no mo mottomo da kedo, Takahashi-kun no kimochi mo (___).
items.en: It's understandable that Ms Yamanaka is angry, but I'd like her to understand how Takahashi feels too.
items.hi: यामानाका जी का ग़ुस्सा होना ठीक है, पर मैं चाहता हूँ कि वे तकाहाशी की भावना भी समझें।
items.gu: યામાનાકા ગુસ્સે થાય એ વાજબી છે, પણ હું ઇચ્છું છું કે તેઓ તાકાહાશીની લાગણી પણ સમજે.

opts.t: わかってあげてほしい
わかってもらってほしい
わかってくれてほしい

items.why: 〜てほしい = "I want someone to ~". The action wanted is Yamanaka doing a kindness for Takahashi (neither is "me") → わかってあげる + てほしい. もらう／くれる can't be followed by てほしい in this way (you'd just say わかってほしい).
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 6課 · てあげる・てもらう・てくれる

items.q: ある日わが家にどっさり（ ）。
items.qr: Aru hi wagaya ni dossari (___).
items.en: One day a huge bunch of flowers was sent to our house.
items.hi: एक दिन हमारे घर ढेर सारे फूल भेजे गए (आ पहुँचे)।
items.gu: એક દિવસ અમારા ઘરે ઢગલો ફૂલો મોકલાઈને આવ્યાં.
items.why: At this point the sender is unknown to the reader and arrives at "my" house: passive + 〜てくる (toward the speaker, 第3部 4課) → 花が贈られてきた. 4 would imply the writer asked for them; 3 moves away from the speaker; 1 makes the writer the sender.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 6課 · てあげる・てもらう・てくれる

items.q: わたしにこの花々を（ ）友人には実はまだお目にかかったことがない。
items.qr: Watashi ni kono hanabana o (___) yuujin ni wa jitsu wa mada ome ni kakatta koto ga nai.
items.en: In fact I have never yet met the friend who sent me these flowers.
items.hi: असल में, जिस दोस्त ने मुझे ये फूल भेजे, उससे मैं अब तक मिली ही नहीं।
items.gu: ખરેખર, જે મિત્રે મને આ ફૂલો મોકલ્યાં, તેને હું હજી મળી જ નથી.

opts.en: sent (as a favour, away from me)

items.why: The friend (the giver) is the subject of the relative clause, and the receiver is わたしに → 〜てくれた, which also shows the writer's gratitude. Plain 送った loses the "for me" feeling; もらった needs わたし as subject; あげた goes the wrong way.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 6課 · てあげる・てもらう・てくれる

items.q: この美しさをぜひ田中さんにも（ ）と思いました。
items.qr: Kono utsukushisa o zehi Tanaka-san ni mo (___) to omoimashita.
items.en: I thought I'd really like you, Ms Tanaka, to enjoy this beauty too.
items.hi: मैंने सोचा कि तनाका जी भी इस सुंदरता का आनंद ज़रूर लें।
items.gu: મેં વિચાર્યું કે તનાકાજી પણ આ સુંદરતાનો આનંદ જરૂર માણે.

opts.t: 楽しんでいただきたい
opts.hi: चाहती हूँ कि आप आनंद लें
opts.gu: ઇચ્છું છું કે આપ આનંદ માણો

opts.t: 楽しんでさしあげたい
opts.en: I'd like to enjoy for you
opts.hi: आपके लिए आनंद लेना चाहती हूँ
opts.gu: આપના માટે આનંદ માણવા માગું છું

opts.en: I'd like to let you enjoy (patronising)
opts.hi: आपको आनंद दिलाना चाहती हूँ (एहसान जताना)
opts.gu: આપને આનંદ અપાવવા માગું છું (ઉપકાર જતાવવો)

items.why: B-3 b): a wish about someone else's action → 〜てもらいたい, in humble form 〜ていただきたい for a polite email (田中さんに marks who should enjoy). 2 says the sender enjoys; 3 is a command and can't go before と思いました; 4 uses あげる toward the reader, which sounds condescending (B-1).
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 6課 · てあげる・てもらう・てくれる

items.q: 明日、春の花の香りがお宅に（ ）。
items.qr: Ashita, haru no hana no kaori ga otaku ni (___).
items.en: Tomorrow, the scent of spring flowers will arrive at your home.
items.hi: कल, बसंत के फूलों की ख़ुशबू आपके घर पहुँचेगी।
items.gu: કાલે, વસંતનાં ફૂલોની સુગંધ આપના ઘરે પહોંચશે.
items.why: The subject is 香り (a thing), so the intransitive 届く fits: 香りが…届きます. 1 and 2 need a person as subject and an object (を); 2 is also patronising; 4 attaches あげる to an inanimate subject.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 6課 · てあげる・てもらう・てくれる

items.q: わたしはすぐに（ ）。
items.qr: Watashi wa sugu ni (___).
items.en: I replied straight away.
items.hi: मैंने तुरंत जवाब भेजा।
items.gu: મેં તરત જવાબ મોકલ્યો.
items.why: わたし replies: a plain action told neutrally → 返信した. 2 and 3 make me the receiver of a reply, which is wrong; 4 さしあげた puts a "favour" on your own simple reply, which is patronising (B-1).
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 6課 · てあげる・てもらう・てくれる

items.q: たとえこの計画に失敗したとしても、（a この b その）責任はわたし一人で負うわけではない。
items.qr: Tatoe kono keikaku ni shippai shita to shite mo, (a kono / b sono) sekinin wa watashi hitori de ou wake de wa nai.
items.en: Even if this plan fails, I won't bear the responsibility for it alone.
items.hi: भले यह योजना नाकाम हो जाए, उसकी ज़िम्मेदारी मैं अकेले नहीं उठाऊँगा।
items.gu: ભલે આ યોજના નિષ્ફળ જાય, તેની જવાબદારી હું એકલો નહીં ઉપાડું.
items.why: Section 2 a): その here means "the failure's" (その責任 = 失敗の責任) — only その can point back as a possessive like this. この責任 would point to some responsibility right in front of the writer, not to the failure.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 7課 · 指示表現「こ・そ・あ」

items.q: もし汚れがついたら、（a この b その）部分にこの液体を少し付けるといい。
items.qr: Moshi yogore ga tsuitara, (a kono / b sono) bubun ni kono ekitai o sukoshi tsukeru to ii.
items.en: If you get a stain, put a little of this liquid on that spot.
items.hi: अगर दाग़ लग जाए, तो उस जगह पर यह तरल थोड़ा-सा लगा दें।
items.gu: જો ડાઘ પડી જાય, તો એ જગ્યાએ આ પ્રવાહી થોડું લગાવો.
items.why: Section 2 a): その部分 = 汚れの部分, "the part with the stain". The stain is hypothetical (もし), so there's nothing "here" to point at with この. (この液体 is fine — the speaker is holding it.)
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 7課 · 指示表現「こ・そ・あ」

items.q: 「人間は考える葦である」……（a この b その）言葉の意味が小学生にわかるだろうか。
items.qr: "Ningen wa kangaeru ashi de aru"…… (a kono / b sono) kotoba no imi ga shougakusei ni wakaru darou ka.
items.en: "Man is a thinking reed"… could an elementary-school child understand the meaning of these words?
items.hi: "मनुष्य एक सोचने वाला सरकंडा है"…… क्या प्राथमिक स्कूल का बच्चा इस वाक्य का अर्थ समझ पाएगा?
items.gu: "માણસ એક વિચારતું બરુ છે"…… શું પ્રાથમિક શાળાનું બાળક આ વાક્યનો અર્થ સમજી શકશે?
items.why: 「この」-2: the specific quotation is restated with the broader word 言葉 → この言葉. その is not used for this kind of category restatement.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 7課 · 指示表現「こ・そ・あ」

items.q: （a この b その）建築方法は、2インチ×4インチの決まった形の木材で壁の構造を作るやり方です。
items.qr: (a Kono / b Sono) kenchiku houhou wa, ni-inchi kakeru yon-inchi no kimatta katachi no mokuzai de kabe no kouzou o tsukuru yarikata desu.
items.en: This construction method builds the wall structure from timber of a fixed 2-inch × 4-inch size.
items.hi: यह निर्माण-पद्धति 2 इंच × 4 इंच के तय आकार की लकड़ी से दीवार का ढाँचा बनाने का तरीक़ा है।
items.gu: આ બાંધકામ પદ્ધતિ 2 ઇંચ × 4 ઇંચના નક્કી માપના લાકડાથી દીવાલનું માળખું બનાવવાની રીત છે.
items.why: 「この」-2: the specific name 「ツーバイフォー」 is restated with the broader 建築方法 → この. It's also the company's own method (この-1, close to the speaker).
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 7課 · 指示表現「こ・そ・あ」

items.q: （a この b その）田中氏が病気になったというのだ。
items.qr: (a Kono / b Sono) Tanaka-shi ga byouki ni natta to iu no da.
items.en: And yet that same Mr Tanaka has apparently fallen ill.
items.hi: और वही तनाका जी बीमार पड़ गए, ऐसा सुना।
items.gu: અને એ જ તનાકા બીમાર પડ્યા, એવું સાંભળ્યું.
items.why: 「その」: something unexpected from the previous sentence (the healthiest man fell ill), followed by 本当に驚いた → その田中氏. この is not used for this surprise contrast.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 7課 · 指示表現「こ・そ・あ」

items.q: わたしもさっそく（a こうして b そうして）みよう。
items.qr: Watashi mo sassoku (a kou shite / b sou shite) miyou.
items.en: I'll try doing that right away too.
items.hi: मैं भी तुरंत ऐसा करके देखूँगा।
items.gu: હું પણ તરત એવું કરી જોઈશ.
items.why: Section 4: pointing back to the previous sentence in a 〜する sentence → そうする. こう is not used.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 7課 · 指示表現「こ・そ・あ」

items.q: ちょうど（a そんな b そういう）ときだった。
items.qr: Choudo (a sonna / b sou iu) toki datta.
items.en: It was just at that moment (that someone behind me held out an umbrella).
items.hi: ठीक उसी समय (पीछे से किसी ने छाता आगे कर दिया)।
items.gu: બરાબર એ જ વખતે (પાછળથી કોઈએ છત્રી ધરી).
items.why: Section 5: one specific, limited moment → そんなとき (cf. そんなとき思いがけないニュースが流れた). そういう describes the content/type of something, which doesn't fit a single moment.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 7課 · 指示表現「こ・そ・あ」

items.q: （a この b その）地図は、ある決まった目的のために使われる地図です。
items.qr: (a Kono / b Sono) chizu wa, aru kimatta mokuteki no tame ni tsukawareru chizu desu.
items.en: This kind of map (a thematic map) is a map used for one particular purpose.
items.hi: यह नक़्शा (विषय-आधारित नक़्शा) किसी एक तय उद्देश्य के लिए इस्तेमाल होने वाला नक़्शा है।
items.gu: આ નકશો (વિષય-આધારિત નકશો) કોઈ એક નક્કી હેતુ માટે વપરાતો નકશો છે.
items.why: 「この」-2: the specific term 主題地図 (asked about in the previous sentence) is restated with the broader word 地図 → この地図. The writer is also introducing their own topic to the reader (この-1).
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 7課 · 指示表現「こ・そ・あ」

items.q: わたしたちがよく目にする名所案内の地図、食べ歩きやショッピングのための地図、町の文化施設や公園、避難場所を示した地図などが（a この b その）例です。
items.qr: Watashitachi ga yoku me ni suru meisho annai no chizu, tabearuki ya shoppingu no tame no chizu, machi no bunka shisetsu ya kouen, hinan basho o shimeshita chizu nado ga (a kono / b sono) rei desu.
items.en: The maps we often see — sightseeing maps, maps for food tours and shopping, maps showing a town's cultural facilities, parks and evacuation sites — are examples of it.
items.hi: जो नक़्शे हम अक्सर देखते हैं — दर्शनीय स्थलों के, खाने-पीने और ख़रीदारी के, शहर की सांस्कृतिक जगहें, पार्क और आपात-शरण स्थल दिखाने वाले — वे इसके उदाहरण हैं।
items.gu: જે નકશા આપણે ઘણી વાર જોઈએ છીએ — જોવાલાયક સ્થળોના, ખાણીપીણી અને ખરીદીના, શહેરની સાંસ્કૃતિક જગ્યાઓ, બગીચા અને આશ્રયસ્થાનો બતાવતા — તે તેનાં ઉદાહરણ છે.
items.why: Section 2 a): その例 = 主題地図の例 — その works as "its". この例 would mean "this example", but no single example has been given yet.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 7課 · 指示表現「こ・そ・あ」

items.q: （a この b その）団体は山歩きのグループとして出発しましたが、今では地図作りが主な活動です。
items.qr: (a Kono / b Sono) dantai wa yamaaruki no guruupu to shite shuppatsu shimashita ga, ima de wa chizuzukuri ga omo na katsudou desu.
items.en: This group started as a hiking group, but now map-making is its main activity.
items.hi: यह संगठन पहाड़ी सैर के समूह के रूप में शुरू हुआ था, पर अब नक़्शे बनाना इसकी मुख्य गतिविधि है।
items.gu: આ સંસ્થા પહાડી પ્રવાસના જૂથ તરીકે શરૂ થઈ હતી, પણ હવે નકશા બનાવવા તેની મુખ્ય પ્રવૃત્તિ છે.
items.why: 「この」-2: the proper noun さくらクラブ is restated with the broader word 団体 → この団体 (like クリスマスローズ → この花).
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 7課 · 指示表現「こ・そ・あ」

items.q: メンバーも最初は（a こう b そう）思っていたようですが、今ではいろいろな主題に挑戦しています。
items.qr: Menbaa mo saisho wa (a kou / b sou) omotte ita you desu ga, ima de wa iroiro na shudai ni chousen shite imasu.
items.en: The members seem to have thought so at first too, but now they take on all sorts of themes.
items.hi: लगता है सदस्य भी शुरू में ऐसा ही सोचते थे, पर अब वे तरह-तरह के विषयों पर हाथ आज़माते हैं।
items.gu: લાગે છે કે સભ્યો પણ શરૂઆતમાં એવું જ વિચારતા હતા, પણ હવે તેઓ જાતજાતના વિષયો અજમાવે છે.
items.why: Section 4: pointing back to the previous sentence with 思う → そう思う. こう is not used here.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 7課 · 指示表現「こ・そ・あ」

items.q: 写真の場合、同じ森を見ても、（a この b その）美しさに感動して撮る人と、環境悪化を心配して撮る人がいるように、地図のテーマ選びにもその人らしさが表れます。
items.qr: Shashin no baai, onaji mori o mite mo, (a kono / b sono) utsukushisa ni kandou shite toru hito to, kankyou akka o shinpai shite toru hito ga iru you ni, chizu no teema erabi ni mo sono hito rashisa ga arawaremasu.
items.en: Just as, in photography, some people looking at the same forest are moved by its beauty and photograph it while others photograph it out of worry about environmental damage, a person's character shows in their choice of map theme too.
items.hi: जैसे फ़ोटोग्राफ़ी में, एक ही जंगल देखकर कोई उसकी सुंदरता से प्रभावित होकर फ़ोटो लेता है और कोई पर्यावरण बिगड़ने की चिंता में, वैसे ही नक़्शे का विषय चुनने में भी व्यक्ति की अपनी छाप दिखती है।
items.gu: જેમ ફોટોગ્રાફીમાં, એક જ જંગલ જોઈને કોઈ તેની સુંદરતાથી પ્રભાવિત થઈને ફોટો લે છે અને કોઈ પર્યાવરણ બગડવાની ચિંતામાં, તેમ નકશાનો વિષય પસંદ કરવામાં પણ વ્યક્તિની પોતાની છાપ દેખાય છે.
items.why: Section 2 a): その美しさ = 森の美しさ — the possessive "its" needs その. この美しさ would point to some beauty in front of the writer.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 7課 · 指示表現「こ・そ・あ」

items.q: （ ）不自然な生活習慣で歪んでいる。
items.qr: (___) fushizen na seikatsu shuukan de yugande iru.
items.en: That (original form) is distorted by unnatural habits.
items.hi: वही (मूल रूप) अस्वाभाविक आदतों से बिगड़ गया है।
items.gu: એ જ (મૂળ રૂપ) અકુદરતી આદતોથી બગડી ગયું છે.
items.why: The blank needs a subject for 歪んでいる that points back to "the originally sound form" in the previous sentence → それが (normal backward reference, and a contrast: that sound form is now bent). 1 これ would usually point forward or to something the writer is holding up. 3/4 make the previous sentence the cause of distortion, but the cause is 不自然な生活習慣.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 7課 · 指示表現「こ・そ・あ」

items.q: 現代人はことに（ ）。
items.qr: Gendaijin wa koto ni (___).
items.en: Modern people are especially so (distorted). (Next the text says this is why we must restore the natural form.)
items.hi: आधुनिक लोग तो ख़ास तौर पर ऐसे (बिगड़े हुए) हैं।
items.gu: આધુનિક લોકો તો ખાસ કરીને એવા (બગડેલા) છે.
items.why: Section 4: pointing back to the previous sentence (歪んでいる) in a 〜だ／である sentence → そうである. こう isn't used for this. 3 and 4 raise doubt, which contradicts the next sentence (だから…もどしてやらなければならない).
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 7課 · 指示表現「こ・そ・あ」

items.q: （ ）は、明るく、前向きで、気持ちがいい。
items.qr: (___) wa, akaruku, maemuki de, kimochi ga ii.
items.en: This way of thinking is bright, positive and pleasant.
items.hi: यह सोच उजली, सकारात्मक और सुखद है।
items.gu: આ વિચારસરણી ઉજળી, સકારાત્મક અને સુખદ છે.
items.why: 「この」-1/-2: the writer sums up the idea just described (the previous sentence already uses これが…思想である) under the broader word 考え方, and is discussing it closely → この考え方. あ- is not used in a text (lesson intro); すべての is not a reference word and overgeneralises; その would not carry on the writer's own これ-summary.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 7課 · 指示表現「こ・そ・あ」

items.q: 迷惑するというより、あまりのエネルギーに、ただただ驚き呆れて、（ ）泣きつづけられるだろうと興味をおぼえたほどだった。
items.qr: Meiwaku suru to iu yori, amari no enerugii ni, tada tada odorokiakirete, (___) nakitsuzukerareru darou to kyoumi o oboeta hodo datta.
items.en: Rather than being annoyed, I was simply amazed at all that energy, and even got curious how long it could keep on crying.
items.hi: परेशान होने से ज़्यादा, उस भारी ऊर्जा पर मैं बस हैरान रह गया, और यह जानने की उत्सुकता भी हुई कि वह कब तक रोता रह सकता है।
items.gu: પરેશાન થવા કરતાં, એ ભારે ઊર્જાથી હું બસ દંગ રહી ગયો, અને એ જાણવાની ઉત્સુકતા પણ થઈ કે તે ક્યાં સુધી રડતું રહી શકે.
items.why: 興味をおぼえた ("I got curious") needs an indirect question: どこまで…られるだろう ("how far could it go on"). ここまで／そこまで are statements, not questions, and don't fit 興味. どうして asks for a reason, but the curiosity is about the limit of its energy.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 7課 · 指示表現「こ・そ・あ」

items.q: しかし、赤ん坊の呼吸を天然自然の見事な呼吸法として、（ ）、といわれても、どうだろうか。
items.qr: Shikashi, akanbou no kokyuu o tennen shizen no migoto na kokyuuhou to shite, (___), to iwarete mo, dou darou ka.
items.en: But even if we're told to take a baby's breathing as a splendid natural method and go back to that, I wonder.
items.hi: लेकिन अगर कहा जाए कि बच्चे की साँस को प्रकृति का शानदार तरीक़ा मानकर वहीं लौट जाओ, तो भी पता नहीं।
items.gu: પણ જો કહેવાય કે બાળકના શ્વાસને કુદરતની ઉત્તમ પદ્ધતિ માનીને ત્યાં પાછા જાઓ, તોય ખબર નહીં.
items.why: The health books' message is "return to the natural form", and the place to return to (the baby's breathing) was just mentioned in the text → そこ (backward reference, そ-series). ここ would be the writer's own position; あそこ is not used in a text and, like 4, the negative command contradicts the books' message that the writer then questions (どうだろうか).
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 7課 · 指示表現「こ・そ・あ」

items.q: 人間には、生きていくうえでどうしても必要なエネルギー（ ）。
items.qr: Ningen ni wa, ikite iku ue de doushite mo hitsuyou na enerugii (___).
items.en: Humans have a certain amount of energy that they absolutely need in order to live.
items.hi: मनुष्य के लिए एक ऐसी ऊर्जा होती है जो जीने के लिए हर हाल में ज़रूरी है।
items.gu: માણસ માટે એક એવી ઊર્જા હોય છે જે જીવવા માટે ગમે તે રીતે જરૂરી છે.

opts.hi: नाम की एक चीज़ होती है

items.why: A: the opening sentence introduces a new concept, matching 〜には〜がある ("X has Y") → というものがある, with が for first mention. ことはある means "it sometimes happens"; 3 and 4 are definitions, which need a は-topic, not 人間には.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 8課 · 「は・が」の使い分け

items.q: （ ）、基礎代謝量以上のエネルギーを摂取した場合である。
items.qr: (___), kiso taisharyou ijou no enerugii o sesshu shita baai de aru.
items.en: The problem is when you take in more energy than your basal metabolism.
items.hi: समस्या तब है जब आधारभूत चयापचय से ज़्यादा ऊर्जा ली जाए।
items.gu: સમસ્યા ત્યારે છે જ્યારે મૂળભૂત ચયાપચય કરતાં વધુ ઊર્જા લેવાય.
items.why: B-2: 問題 is related to what was just discussed ("the problem with this"), and the sentence is an identification 「XはYである」 → 問題は. 問題が would need a predicate like ある／起こる; 3 and 4 leave 〜場合である without a subject.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 8課 · 「は・が」の使い分け

items.q: やっと食物にありついたとしても、次にいつ必要量の（ ）は保証の限りではない。
items.qr: Yatto shokumotsu ni aritsuita to shite mo, tsugi ni itsu hitsuyouryou no (___) wa hoshou no kagiri de wa nai.
items.en: Even if they finally found food, there was no guarantee when the next source of the energy they needed would be found.
items.hi: भले आख़िरकार खाना मिल जाए, अगली बार ज़रूरत भर ऊर्जा का स्रोत कब मिलेगा, इसकी कोई गारंटी नहीं थी।
items.gu: ભલે આખરે ખોરાક મળી જાય, આવતી વખતે જરૂર પૂરતો ઊર્જાનો સ્રોત ક્યારે મળશે, તેની કોઈ ખાતરી નહોતી.

opts.t: エネルギー源が見つかるか
opts.en: whether an energy source would be found

opts.t: エネルギー源は見つかるか
エネルギー源を見つけるか
エネルギー源は見つけるか

items.why: The blank is inside an embedded question (いつ〜か) that is itself the topic of 〜は保証の限りではない. Inside such a clause the subject takes が, not は (2, 4 out). Intransitive 見つかる fits "an energy source turns up"; 3 needs a doer who isn't named, and 4 mixes は with a transitive verb.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 8課 · 「は・が」の使い分け

items.q: （ ）当然と言わねばならない。
items.qr: (___) touzen to iwaneba naranai.
items.en: That the human body adapted to this must be called only natural.
items.hi: मानव शरीर का इसके अनुसार ढल जाना स्वाभाविक ही कहना होगा।
items.gu: માનવ શરીર એ પ્રમાણે ઢળી ગયું એ સ્વાભાવિક જ કહેવું પડે.

opts.t: ヒトの身体が、それに対応したのが
opts.r: hito no karada ga, sore ni taiou shita no ga

opts.t: ヒトの身体は、それに対応したのが
opts.r: hito no karada wa, sore ni taiou shita no ga

opts.t: ヒトの身体が、それに対応したのは
opts.r: hito no karada ga, sore ni taiou shita no wa
opts.en: that the human body adapted to it is …

opts.t: ヒトの身体は、それに対応したのは
opts.r: hito no karada wa, sore ni taiou shita no wa

items.why: Two choices: (a) inside the nominalised clause 〜したの, the subject must be が → ヒトの身体が; (b) the whole clause is the topic being judged (〜のは当然だ "that ~ is natural") → のは. Only 3 has both.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 8課 · 「は・が」の使い分け

items.q: （ ）皆さんのお腹のまわりに付いている脂肪のベルトというわけだ。
items.qr: (___) minasan no onaka no mawari ni tsuite iru shibou no beruto to iu wake da.
items.en: And that is what the belt of fat around your bellies is.
items.hi: और यही है आप सबके पेट के चारों ओर जमी चर्बी की पट्टी।
items.gu: અને એ જ છે તમારા સૌના પેટની આસપાસ જામેલો ચરબીનો પટ્ટો.
items.why: The punch line identifies the stored energy as the belly fat: "that is (exactly) what the fat belt is" — が picks out それ as the answer, and the sentence brings a new, striking point (C-1/C-3). それは would just comment on a topic and lose the "so that's what it is!" effect; 3 and 4 are conditions, which don't go with 〜というわけだ.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 8課 · 「は・が」の使い分け

items.q: （ ）、個人の労働時間は減っていないように思われる。
items.qr: (___), kojin no roudou jikan wa hette inai you ni omowareru.
items.why: B-b: with many people out of work you'd expect each worker's hours to fall; they don't. A result the fact failed to prevent → にもかかわらず. ゆえに would make "hours don't fall" a logical consequence of unemployment (nonsense); それはさておき would drop the topic, but the text keeps discussing employment.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 9課 · 接続表現

items.q: （ ）、単純に人員を増やしても、同一の生産性が得られるとは限らない。
items.qr: (___), tanjun ni jin'in o fuyashite mo, douitsu no seisansei ga erareru to wa kagiranai.

opts.hi: फिर भी / इसका मतलब यह नहीं

items.why: B-b: the natural idea "people are overworked, so hire more" is rejected, and the sentence ends in 〜とは限らない (a negative) → かといって. その反面 needs an opposite evaluation of the same thing; ちなみに would add a minor side fact, but this is the main argument.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 9課 · 接続表現

items.q: （ ）、心配なのは天気である。
items.qr: (___), shinpai na no wa tenki de aru.
items.why: B-b: "I'm going" is accepted, but a reservation follows ("the weather worries me") — partly taking back the confident plan → とはいえ. それに反して would need an opposite fact about a different thing; おまけに would add a further point in the same direction, not a worry.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 9課 · 接続表現

items.q: （ ）、次に皆既月食が見られるのは3年後である。
items.qr: (___), tsugi ni kaiki gesshoku ga mirareru no wa sannengo de aru.
items.why: C-b: "the next eclipse is in three years" is a side fact on the same topic (eclipses) → ちなみに. It also hints why today matters. もしくは offers an alternative, which makes no sense; それはさておき would announce a new direction, but we are still on the eclipse.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 9課 · 接続表現

items.q: （ ）、社会の中では何らかの規範がなければ皆が生活しにくい。
items.qr: (___), shakai no naka de wa nanraka no kihan ga nakereba mina ga seikatsu shinikui.
items.why: B-b: "free to do anything" → you'd expect life to be easy; instead "without norms life is hard" — an unexpected turn → しかしながら (硬, matches the である style). すなわち would claim the two sentences say the same thing; それゆえ would make the difficulty a result of freedom, which isn't the writer's logic.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 9課 · 接続表現

items.q: （ ）、自分で規範を作り出すのは難しいことである。
items.qr: (___), jibun de kihan o tsukuridasu no wa muzukashii koto de aru.
items.why: B-b: "we need norms" suggests "so make your own"; that natural step is denied ("making them yourself is hard") → さりとて (硬). おまけに piles on in the same direction (too casual and wrong logic); いってみれば needs a figurative rephrasing.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 9課 · 接続表現

items.q: （ ）、伝統的な規範を見直そうという動きも出てきているようだ。
items.qr: (___), dentouteki na kihan o minaosou to iu ugoki mo dete kite iru you da.
items.why: B-a: making norms yourself is hard, so people turn back to traditional ones — a logical result → それゆえに. にもかかわらず would mean "despite the difficulty", which isn't contrastive here; その反面 needs the other side of an evaluation.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 9課 · 接続表現

items.q: （ ）、通学コースは夜も開校されているから、大学の授業が終わった後で行くことも可能だ。
items.qr: (___), tsuugaku koosu wa yoru mo kaikou sarete iru kara, daigaku no jugyou ga owatta ato de iku koto mo kanou da.
items.why: A-b: correspondence course vs classroom course — a second option → もしくは. Neither にもかかわらず nor さりとて fits: there is no expectation being contradicted, and さりとて would need a negative conclusion.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 9課 · 接続表現

items.q: （ ）、夜アルバイトをすることを考えると、やっぱり通信講座の方がいいだろうか。
items.qr: (___), yoru arubaito o suru koto o kangaeru to, yappari tsuushin kouza no hou ga ii darou ka.
items.why: B-b: "evening classes are possible" → expectation "so choose them"; but the night job makes that hard → sentence-initial が (= しかし). それはさておき would leave the topic of choosing a course; それに反して contrasts two facts/trends, not a reconsideration.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 9課 · 接続表現

items.q: （ ）、勉強を始めたら忙しくてアルバイトどころではないかもしれない。
items.qr: (___), benkyou o hajimetara isogashikute arubaito dokoro de wa nai kamoshirenai.

opts.hi: फिर भी / यह कहने के बावजूद

items.why: B-b: the writer questions the reasoning just given ("I'll keep my night job, so correspondence…") — maybe there won't be time for the job at all, ending in 〜どころではない (negative) → そうはいっても. もしくは adds an option; いってみれば rephrases figuratively.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 9課 · 接続表現

items.q: （ ）、初めから土の中に農薬を入れればよかったのか。
items.qr: (___), hajime kara tsuchi no naka ni nouyaku o irereba yokatta no ka.
items.why: Two alternative self-questions, "should I have done X? Or Y?" → あるいは (≈ もしくは, A-b). いわば／すなわち rephrase (the two methods are different, not equal); おまけに adds a further point, not an alternative.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 9課 · 接続表現

items.q: （ ）、人間が食べる野菜に生物を殺す薬を使ったのでは人間にも不利益だろう。
items.qr: (___), ningen ga taberu yasai ni seibutsu o korosu kusuri o tsukatta no de wa ningen ni mo furieki darou.
items.why: B-b: the writer half-accepts "I should have used pesticide", then takes it back — poison on food harms people too → とはいえ. ところが introduces an unexpected event (a fact that happened), not the writer's own reconsideration; それに反して contrasts two facts; それはさておき would abandon the pesticide question, which the rest of the text continues.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 9課 · 接続表現

items.q: （ ）、好んでそうしているわけではない。
items.qr: (___), kononde sou shite iru wake de wa nai.
items.why: B-b: "farmers end up using chemicals" might suggest they are happy to; that inference is denied with 〜わけではない (negative) → さりとて. それなのに expresses the speaker's frustration at an unexpected result (not a denial of an inference); しかも／したがって add or conclude in the same direction.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 9課 · 接続表現

items.q: （ ）、そうせざるを得ないというこのジレンマ。
items.qr: (___), sou sezaru o enai to iu kono jirenma.
items.why: B-b: they know it is harmful, and still must do it — the knowledge doesn't stop the action → にもかかわらず. だからこそ／そこで would make the knowledge the reason for spraying (illogical); そればかりか adds a further point, killing the "dilemma".
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 9課 · 接続表現

items.q: （ ）、効率的な食糧増産への努力は不可欠である。
items.qr: (___), kouritsuteki na shokuryou zousan e no doryoku wa fukaketsu de aru.
items.why: B-a: raising self-sufficiency is the goal, so efficient production is indispensable — a logical conclusion in a である essay → それゆえ (硬). そうはいっても needs a denial; ただし adds a condition/exception; もしくは an alternative. The contrast comes only in the next sentence (その一方で).
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 9課 · 接続表現

items.q: 老人は村人から離れて一人で暮らしていた。
items.qr: Roujin wa murabito kara hanarete hitori de kurashite ita.
items.why: A-3 / A-1: 老人 was just introduced with が and is the only person in the story; taking it up as the topic of the next sentence, it is fully identifiable, so 老人は can go.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 10課 · 省略・繰り返し・言い換え

items.q: また、この論文は引用文献も古い。
items.qr: Mata, kono ronbun wa in'you bunken mo furui.
items.why: A-2: both sentences have the same topic この論文は, and また／も confirm we are still listing its weaknesses.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 10課 · 省略・繰り返し・言い換え

items.q: 渡辺さんは専門外のことだからたぶんわからないだろう。
items.qr: Watanabe-san wa senmongai no koto da kara tabun wakaranai darou.
items.why: B-2 / B-3: two people were mentioned (渡辺さん and 山田さん). Without the name the reader can't tell who "probably won't know", and the natural reading would even be 山田さん, the person just recommended.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 10課 · 省略・繰り返し・言い換え

items.q: ストックホルムは古い建物がたくさんあり、絵のような町並みだった。いつかもう一度ストックホルムに行きたい。
items.u: ストックホルムは / ストックホルムに
items.qr: Sutokkuhorumu wa furui tatemono ga takusan ari, e no you na machinami datta. Itsuka mou ichido Sutokkuhorumu ni ikitai.

opts.t: （ストックホルムは）（ストックホルムに）

items.why: A-3 then A-1: Stockholm is the only place in the text, so topicalising it (〜は) and repeating it as a destination (〜に) are both recoverable.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 10課 · 省略・繰り返し・言い換え

items.q: 佐藤氏は先日この病院の理事長に就任したやる気満々の医師である。
items.qr: Satou-shi wa senjitsu kono byouin no rijichou ni shuunin shita yaruki manman no ishi de aru.
items.why: B-5: an action sentence (giving a greeting) is followed by a sentence saying who he is (〜医師である) — the subject must be restated. The reverse order would allow omission.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 10課 · 省略・繰り返し・言い換え

items.q: 不景気は、何が原因で、いつまで続くのだろうか。
items.qr: Fukeiki wa, nani ga gen'in de, itsu made tsuzuku no darou ka.
items.why: B-3: in the previous sentence 不景気 was only a cause inside 〜のため; the main subject was "people forced to retire". Making it the new topic without naming it would leave the reader thinking the question is about those people.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 10課 · 省略・繰り返し・言い換え

items.q: 昔から桜は日本にあったのだが、それはヤマザクラという別の種類の桜のことである。
items.qr: Mukashi kara sakura wa Nihon ni atta no da ga, sore wa Yamazakura to iu betsu no shurui no sakura no koto de aru.
items.why: B-4: same word, different referent — before, 桜 effectively meant Somei-Yoshino; here it means cherry trees in general (including Yamazakura). Dropping it would make the sentence claim Somei-Yoshino existed long ago.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 10課 · 省略・繰り返し・言い換え

items.q: 魚はもちろん泳いでいったわけではない。秋田県の湖には酸性の温泉水が流れ込むので、卵を移したのである。
items.u: 魚は / 秋田県の湖には
items.qr: Sakana wa mochiron oyoide itta wake de wa nai. Akita-ken no mizuumi ni wa sansei no onsensui ga nagarekomu no de, tamago o utsushita no de aru.

opts.t: （魚は）・秋田県の湖には＝省略できない
opts.r: (sakana wa) / Akita-ken no mizuumi ni wa = shouryaku dekinai
opts.en: 魚は can go; 秋田県の湖には must stay
opts.hi: 魚は छोड़ा जा सकता है; 秋田県の湖には नहीं
opts.gu: 魚は છોડી શકાય; 秋田県の湖には નહીં

items.why: 魚は: A-1/A-3 — the fish is the obvious topic. 秋田県の湖には: B-2/B-3 — two places are in play (Akita and Yamanashi) and the lake was mentioned only as a modifier; without it, the reader can't tell which water is acidic.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 10課 · 省略・繰り返し・言い換え

items.q: 小学校だけで、宇都宮、東京、鹿児島、四国の高松と四回（ ）。
items.qr: Shougakkou dake de, Utsunomiya, Toukyou, Kagoshima, Shikoku no Takamatsu to yonkai (___).
items.why: The omitted subject is the writer (her school): 学校が変わる is the natural intransitive for "change schools", and 〜ている here is the record-of-experience use ("have changed four times"). 変化する is for a thing's nature or state changing, not for switching schools; 変えている (transitive) needs an agent changing something else.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 10課 · 省略・繰り返し・言い換え

items.q: 「先に（ ）。みんなが頭を下げるのを見渡してから、ゆっくりと頭を下げなさい」
items.qr: "Saki ni (___). Minna ga atama o sageru no o miwatashite kara, yukkuri to atama o sagenasai."
items.why: C-2 rewording: お辞儀 = 頭を下げる. The next sentence says bow slowly after watching everyone else bow, so the first instruction must be "don't bow first" → お辞儀をするな. 1 contradicts the advice; 3/4 talk about raising the head, which is not the point.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 10課 · 省略・繰り返し・言い換え

items.q: （3-a）と一緒で、（3-b）も新しく支店長として乗り込むのである。
items.qr: (3-a) to issho de, (3-b) mo atarashiku shitenchou to shite norikomu no de aru.
items.why: The person "arriving as new branch manager" (支店長として) can only be the father → b = 父. Explaining the grandmother's joke, the children are facing a new school just as he faces a new office → a = 子供たち. Option 3 makes the children branch managers.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 10課 · 省略・繰り返し・言い換え

items.q: 母にはスリッパが出されるが、（ ）靴下のまま廊下を歩く。
items.qr: Haha ni wa surippa ga dasareru ga, (___) kutsushita no mama rouka o aruku.
items.why: B-1: the actor changes — Mother gets slippers, but someone else walks in socks — so the new subject must be stated, and contrastive は marks it: 子どもは. 母は contradicts the slippers; みんなは includes Mother; 自分たちは has no clear antecedent in this narrative voice.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 10課 · 省略・繰り返し・言い換え

items.q: 下げてから（ ）を思い出すのだが、これは役に立ったためしがなかった。
items.qr: Sagete kara (___) o omoidasu no da ga, kore wa yaku ni tatta tameshi ga nakatta.
items.why: C-1 repetition: earlier the passage describes the father's breakfast advice with the word 演説 (父が演説をする). What she remembers only after bowing — and what "never helped" (役に立った) — is that advice → 父の演説. 父のこと is too vague to be "useful or not"; the grandmother gave no advice.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 10課 · 省略・繰り返し・言い換え

items.q: 5歳という差が世代を分ける基準になっていると（⑤a 思った b 思われる）。
items.qr: Go-sai to iu sa ga sedai o wakeru kijun ni natte iru to (5 a omotta / b omowareru).
items.why: B-1: the conclusion of a report is stated impersonally with 〜と思われる. 思った is a personal past thought — wrong both in register and in tense (a conclusion holds now).
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 11課 · 文体の一貫性

items.q: 現在行われている医療費の補助や介護制度の確立だけでは充実した福祉政策とは（③a 言えない b 言うわけにはいかない）。
items.qr: Genzai okonawarete iru iryouhi no hojo ya kaigo seido no kakuritsu dake de wa juujitsu shita fukushi seisaku to wa (3 a ienai / b iu wake ni wa ikanai).

opts.t: 言うわけにはいかない
opts.en: I can't very well say (personal constraint)
opts.hi: मैं ऐसा कह नहीं सकता (निजी मजबूरी)
opts.gu: હું એમ કહી ન શકું (અંગત મજબૂરી)

items.why: B-3: the book lists 〜わけにはいかない among forms showing the speaker's feelings (social/moral constraint on me). The objective judgement is simply 〜とは言えない.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 11課 · 文体の一貫性

items.q: 精神面でのケアやコミュニティーの一員としての社会参加の方法などが（④a 必要でなくてなんだろう b 必要だと思われる）。
items.qr: Seishinmen de no kea ya komyunitii no ichiin to shite no shakai sanka no houhou nado ga (4 a hitsuyou de nakute nan darou / b hitsuyou da to omowareru).

opts.t: 必要でなくてなんだろう
opts.en: if these aren't necessary, what is? (rhetorical)
opts.hi: ये ज़रूरी नहीं तो और क्या? (भावुक)

items.why: 〜でなくてなんだろう (18課, ☆☆☆) is an emotional rhetorical assertion — the A-table pairs it with 絶対に〜だ. B-1: a report concludes with 〜と思われる.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 11課 · 文体の一貫性

items.q: また、医療事故で訴えられるリスクが高く、さらに労働環境も厳しいとされる（ ）、産婦人科医や小児科医を志す学生が減っていることが挙げられる。
items.qr: Mata, iryou jiko de uttaerareru risuku ga takaku, sara ni roudou kankyou mo kibishii to sareru (___), sanfujinkai ya shounikai o kokorozasu gakusei ga hette iru koto ga agerareru.
items.why: B-2/B-3: ものだから／もので are spoken excuse-giving forms; せいで blames (negative feeling). An objective cause in a report → 〜ことから.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 11課 · 文体の一貫性

items.q: また、…厳しいとされることから、産婦人科医や小児科医を志す学生が減っている（ ）。
items.qr: Mata, … kibishii to sareru koto kara, sanfujinkai ya shounikai o kokorozasu gakusei ga hette iru (___).

opts.hi: को कारण के रूप में गिनाया जा सकता है

items.why: B-1: the passage lists causes (一つには…、また…); the impersonal passive 〜ことが挙げられる keeps the writer out of the sentence. 1 and 3 put "I" in as the actor; 4 makes it someone's future action.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 11課 · 文体の一貫性

items.q: これらの施策が医師不足の解消につながるか（ ）、医師の労働環境や訴訟リスクの問題が解消されないため、医師不足はますます深刻化している。
items.qr: Korera no shisaku ga ishi busoku no kaishou ni tsunagaru ka (___), ishi no roudou kankyou ya soshou risuku no mondai ga kaishou sarenai tame, ishi busoku wa masumasu shinkokuka shite iru.
items.why: B-1/B-3: と思いきや and と期待したら describe the writer's own surprise or hope (subjective, and たら for a past single event is narrative). The report needs the impersonal passive + contrast: 〜と期待されたが. と思われたら is ungrammatical here.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 11課 · 文体の一貫性

items.q: …医師の労働環境や訴訟リスクの問題が解消されないため、医師不足は（ ）深刻化している。
items.qr: … ishi no roudou kankyou ya soshou risuku no mondai ga kaishou sarenai tame, ishi busoku wa (___) shinkokuka shite iru.
items.why: A: a worsening trend in a written report → ますます. どんどん is onomatopoeic and conversational; とても is colloquial and odd with a change verb (深刻化する); なかなか needs a negative or means "quite".
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 11課 · 文体の一貫性

items.q: こうした状況は、今後極めて深刻になると（ ）、実効性のある対策が求められている。
items.qr: Kou shita joukyou wa, kongo kiwamete shinkoku ni naru to (___), jikkousei no aru taisaku ga motomerarete iru.
items.why: B-1: impersonal 考えられる + the written connective form 〜ており (= 〜ていて in formal style). 1 puts the writer in as thinker; 2 uses the casual listing し; 4 (causative-passive) expresses the writer being moved to reflect — subjective.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 11課 · 文体の一貫性

items.q: （ ）ということだ。
items.qr: (___) to iu koto da.

opts.t: 飲み方を間違ってはいけない
opts.en: you mustn't drink the wrong way
opts.hi: ग़लत ढंग से नहीं पीना चाहिए

items.why: Pattern 1 (statement → rewording): 〜ということだ restates the first sentence. "Medicine or poison" means it depends on how you drink → a. b would only follow from "alcohol is poison".
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 12課 · 話の流れを考える

items.q: （ ）何を考えているのか完全に理解することはできない。
items.qr: (___) nani o kangaete iru no ka kanzen ni rikai suru koto wa dekinai.
items.why: Pattern 1 (statement → example): 〜ですら picks the most extreme case — the people closest to you. "Even family" makes the point about "other people" strongest; teachers are not a natural extreme of closeness.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 12課 · 話の流れを考える

opts.t: 締め切りは明日なのだ
opts.r: shimekiri wa ashita na no da

opts.hi: (बात यह है कि) मैं रुकना चाहता हूँ
opts.gu: (વાત એ છે કે) મારે અટકવું છે

items.why: Pattern 2 (statement → reason, ending のだ): the blank explains why stopping is impossible → the deadline. b contradicts "I can't stop" and gives no reason.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 12課 · 話の流れを考える

items.q: 中でもまねの上手な鳥が（ ）。
items.qr: Naka demo mane no jouzu na tori ga (___).

opts.t: 話し方をまねています
opts.en: are imitating the way of speaking
opts.hi: बोलने के ढंग की नक़ल कर रहे हैं

opts.t: おうむたちだというわけです
opts.r: oumutachi da to iu wake desu
opts.en: are parrots and their kind — that's why
opts.hi: तोते आदि हैं — यही कारण है
opts.gu: પોપટ વગેરે છે — એ જ કારણ છે

items.why: Pattern 3 (question → answer): the opening question (なぜでしょうか) needs a conclusion; 〜というわけです wraps up the explanation and links back to おうむ in the question. a just repeats the general fact and never answers "why parrots?".
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 12課 · 話の流れを考える

items.q: しかし一方でそれは、（ ）。
items.qr: Shikashi ippou de sore wa, (___).

opts.t: 壁を乗り越えられるのである
opts.r: kabe o norikoerareru no de aru
opts.hi: दीवार पार की जा सकती है

opts.t: 世界を広げるための重要な機会である
opts.r: sekai o hirogeru tame no juuyou na kikai de aru
opts.en: is an important chance to broaden one's world
opts.hi: दुनिया बड़ी करने का अहम मौक़ा है
opts.gu: દુનિયા મોટી કરવાની મહત્ત્વની તક છે

items.why: しかし一方で gives the other evaluation of the same thing (それ = changing yourself): painful ↔ valuable. b is an evaluation of それ. a doesn't fit それは as subject (the "process" can't get over a wall) and is not a contrasting evaluation.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 12課 · 話の流れを考える

opts.hi: बेशक ऐसा कहा जा सकता है

opts.t: 残念だがそうは言えない
opts.r: zannen da ga sou wa ienai
opts.hi: अफ़सोस, ऐसा नहीं कहा जा सकता

opts.r: jitsu wa sono hantai de aru

opts.t: やはりそのようである

items.why: Pattern 3: the answer to the question must lead into "you need well-designed practice", i.e. "practice alone doesn't guarantee progress" → b. a/d agree with the question (no need for the next sentence); c ("practice makes you worse") is too strong.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 12課 · 話の流れを考える

opts.t: 今年の夏も猛暑だった
opts.r: kotoshi no natsu mo mousho datta
opts.hi: इस साल की गर्मी भी भीषण थी
opts.gu: આ વર્ષનો ઉનાળો પણ આકરો હતો

opts.t: 自然災害も問題である
opts.r: shizen saigai mo mondai de aru
opts.en: natural disasters are also a problem

items.why: Pattern 1 (statement → rewording → data): "not only domestic" is restated positively as "global", and the next sentence gives worldwide evidence. b is domestic, c is a sudden appeal, d jumps ahead without the global link.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 12課 · 話の流れを考える

items.q: そう考えるときに忘れてはならないのは、（ ）ということだ。
items.qr: Sou kangaeru toki ni wasurete wa naranai no wa, (___) to iu koto da.

opts.t: 1円というお金には大きな価値がない
opts.r: ichi-en to iu okane ni wa ookina kachi ga nai
opts.hi: 1 येन का कोई बड़ा मूल्य नहीं

opts.t: 1円というお金でも大きな価値を生み出す
opts.r: ichi-en to iu okane demo ookina kachi o umidasu
opts.hi: 1 येन भी बड़ा मूल्य पैदा करता है
opts.gu: 1 યેન પણ મોટું મૂલ્ય સર્જે છે

opts.t: 1円使う額を減らせば1億円の損失になる
opts.r: ichi-en tsukau gaku o heraseba ichioku-en no sonshitsu ni naru
opts.en: if spending falls by 1 yen, it's a ¥100m loss
opts.hi: 1 येन ख़र्च घटे तो 10 करोड़ का घाटा
opts.gu: 1 યેન ખર્ચ ઘટે તો 10 કરોડની ખોટ

opts.t: 1億円は個人にとってはとてつもなく大きい
opts.r: ichioku-en wa kojin ni totte wa totetsumonaku ookii
opts.hi: व्यक्ति के लिए 10 करोड़ बहुत बड़ी रक़म है
opts.gu: વ્યક્તિ માટે 10 કરોડ બહુ મોટી રકમ છે

items.why: Pattern 4/5 (one view → the other side): 忘れてはならないのは introduces the flip side of the optimistic calculation, and the next sentence calls it the "toughness" (厳しさ) of business — only a loss fits. b repeats the optimistic view; a/d don't connect to 厳しさ.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 12課 · 話の流れを考える

items.q: しかし、それに時間を割くことによって、体験しなければ得られない、においや感触などの情報や経験といったものは（ ）とも言えよう。
items.qr: Shikashi, sore ni jikan o saku koto ni yotte, taiken shinakereba erarenai, nioi ya kanshoku nado no jouhou ya keiken to itta mono wa (___) to mo ieyou.

opts.t: 必要なくなっているのだ
opts.r: hitsuyou naku natte iru no da

opts.t: 得る機会が減っているのだ
opts.r: eru kikai ga hette iru no da
opts.en: the chances to gain them are decreasing
opts.hi: पाने के मौक़े घट रहे हैं

opts.t: 重要度を増しているのだ
opts.r: juuyoudo o mashite iru no da

opts.t: 手軽に得られるようになったのだ
opts.r: tegaru ni erareru you ni natta no da

items.why: Pattern 5 (確かに…便利だ → しかし): the rebuttal must be a downside of media use. Time spent online = less time for first-hand experience → b. d repeats the advantage; a is the writer's opposite point; c doesn't follow from "spending time on them".
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 12課 · 話の流れを考える

items.q: …——（ ）、会社に対して忠誠心を示したほうが何かとトクをするから、そうしているだけにすぎない。
items.qr: … — (___), kaisha ni taishite chuuseishin o shimeshita hou ga nanika to toku o suru kara, sou shite iru dake ni suginai.

opts.t: 分かりやすく言うならば

opts.en: looking at it the other way

opts.t: 確かにそう言えるのだが
opts.r: tashika ni sou ieru no da ga
opts.hi: बेशक ऐसा कहा जा सकता है, पर

items.why: Pattern 1 (statement → rewording): the abstract claim ("best-adapted behaviour") is restated in plain words ("it just pays to be loyal") → 分かりやすく言うならば. It isn't an example (2), the opposite view (3), or a concession before a rebuttal (4).
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 12課 · 話の流れを考える

items.q: （ ）、いつまでも会社から帰らずに残業していたほうが、会社にアピールできるというものだし、…
items.qr: (___), itsu made mo kaisha kara kaerazu ni zangyou shite ita hou ga, kaisha ni apiiru dekiru to iu mono da shi, …
items.why: The blank links a goal (raise your evaluation) to the means (stay late, work holidays) → そのためには. Working late is not a rewording (1) or a reason for the previous sentence (3); 4 would make overtime a consequence rather than a method.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 12課 · 話の流れを考える

items.q: だからこそ、日本のサラリーマンたちは（ ）を選択した——…
items.qr: Dakara koso, Nihon no sarariiman-tachi wa (___) o sentaku shita — …

opts.t: キャリアアップをすること

items.why: 10課 C-1 repetition: the first paragraph ended with 日本人は会社人間になった, and だからこそ now draws that conclusion again → 会社人間であること. 1 and 4 contradict the argument; 2 is the goal, not the "choice" being explained.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 12課 · 話の流れを考える

items.q: 江戸時代の武士たちが滅私奉公であったというのも、（ ）。
items.qr: Edo jidai no bushi-tachi ga messhi houkou de atta to iu no mo, (___).

opts.t: 実は別の理由があります
opts.r: jitsu wa betsu no riyuu ga arimasu

opts.en: is ultimately for the same reason

opts.t: 事実とは言えないのです
opts.r: jijitsu to wa ienai no desu

items.why: 〜というのも signals another case explained the same way, and the following sentences give the samurai version of the salaryman logic (couldn't change lords → loyalty paid) → 結局は同じ理由です. 1 contradicts what follows; 3/4 judge truth, but the passage explains why.
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 12課 · 話の流れを考える

items.q: （ ）、江戸時代の武士たちはお家大事、殿様大事で働いていたというわけです。
items.qr: (___), Edo jidai no bushi-tachi wa oie daiji, tonosama daiji de hataraite ita to iu wake desu.
items.why: The sentence is the result of the reason just given, and it mirrors the salaryman paragraph (だからこそ…会社人間) → だからこそ. なぜなら would introduce a reason; 確かに a concession; つまり is possible in isolation but loses the "precisely for this reason" link the parallel structure needs (official answer 4).
items.unit: 新完全マスター 第3部 12課 · 話の流れを考える
